1.name: Efficient Draw
1.description: Multishot costs less mana.

2.name: Strong Pull
2.description: Multishot deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Bodkin Points
3.description: Multishot has a chance to apply armor shred on hit.

4.name: Readied Arrows
4.description: Multishot has a chance to be shot when you use another bow attack with increased chance to stun, but it costs significantly more mana.

5.name: Hang Loose
5.description: Multishot has increased attack speed and chance to gain {Haste} when you use or proc Multishot.

6.name: Point Blank
6.description: Multishot deals more hit damage to close targets (multiplicative with other modifiers) falling off rapidly, but deals less hit damage to far away targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Back to Back
7.description: Every 8 attacks with Multishot is a double shot.

8.name: Repeater Bow
8.description: Reduce the amount of attacks to double shoot with Multishot.

9.name: Quick Draw
9.description: Multishot has increased attack speed.

10.name: Piercing Shots
10.description: Multishot arrows pierce enemies (continue through enemies hit) up to a limit.

11.name: Critical Arrows
11.description: Multishot's critical strikes deal more damage.

12.name: Stand My Ground
12.description: Multishot deals more damage if you haven't moved in the past second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Hit 'n' Run
13.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when {Stand My Ground} is activated.

14.name: True Strikes
14.description: Multishot has increased critical strike chance.

15.name: Large Quiver
15.description: Multishot has additional arrows, but costs more mana.

16.name: Heavy Arrows
16.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hits in a smaller cone and can only shoot a maximum of 3 arrows.

17.name: Toxic Gift
17.description: Multishot has a chance to poison on hit, but can no longer cause slow.

18.name: Rain of Arrows
18.description: Multishot hits in a wider cone.

19.name: No Easy Way Out
19.description: Multishot has a chance to slow on hit.

20.name: Pinning Shots
20.description: Multishot deals more hit damage to slowed targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: The Maj'Elkan Grasp
21.description: Multishot has increased slow and bleed duration per point of Dexterity.

22.name: Pincushion
22.description: Multishot has a chance to reset slow and chill duration on hit.

23.name: Keep Pushing 'em Around
23.description: Multishot has a chance to knock enemies on hit.

24.name: Won't Back Down
24.description: When you are out of mana Multishot is free to use, but you can only shoot a maximum of 1 arrow. Other bonuses still apply.

26.name: Sniping
26.description: Multishot deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and arrows travel faster.

28.name: Giant Slayer
28.description: Multishot arrows from the same attack can hit the same target and have an increased chance to stun enemies, but {Multishot} deals significantly less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Toxic Envelopment
2.description: Root Wave hits have a chance to poison enemies.

3.name: Venomous Briar
3.description: Entangling Roots' base physical damage over time is converted to poison and it now has the poison tag. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

4.name: Kobra Vines
4.description: Rooted enemies are also blinded.

5.name: Poisonous Seeds
5.description:
Entangling Roots now creates seeds in the area. When an enemy draws too close to a seed it bursts, releasing a burst of spores that slow and poison enemies.

If you have taken the {Winternid Thorns} node, the seed bursts inflict {Frostbite} and {Chill} instead of slow and poison.

6.name: Renewing Pollen
6.description:
The spores from {Seeds} now heal you and your allies. 

This effect is tripled for minions.

7.name: Nectar of Rejuvenation
7.description: Seeds now burst when an ally draws close to them which grants you and your allies the {Haste} buff, granting you 30% increased movement speed.

8.name: Earthy Puffball
8.description: Seeds now burst when you hit them with {Upheaval} and deal damage in a larger area when detonated this way.

9.name: Rampant Growth
9.description: Seeds will now grow {Vines} when they burst.

10.name: Entrapped
10.description: Root Wave immobilizes enemies for a longer duration.

11.name: Inescapable Thicket
11.description: Root Wave cannot be dodged.

12.name: Frenzying Thorns
12.description: Entanging Roots now wraps around your totems and vines for twice the duration as enemies, granting them additional armor and increased attack and cast speed.

13.name: Bramblewood Wardens
13.description: Entangling Roots now also wraps around your Spriggans for twice the duration as enemies, granting them all buffs from {Frenzying Thorns} as well as additional projectiles with their {Thorn Volley}.

14.name: Reclamation
14.description: Entangling Roots leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

15.name: Noxious Grasp
15.description: Entangling Roots deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Lethal Spines
16.description: Entangling Roots damage accelerates over time, dealing more damage each second (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Overgrown Garden
17.description: You now cause Entangling Roots to expand in a circle around you rather than a cone in front, but it now has a cooldown.

18.name: Rooted System
18.description: Entangling Roots is now cast from the nearest totem to your cursor.

19.name: Briarthorn's Wrath
19.description:
When you are stunned, you now cast Entangling Roots. 

This effect has a 20 seconds cooldown, which doesn't affect Entangling Root's cooldown.

20.name: Shredding Vines
20.description: Root Wave hits shred enemy physical resistance.

21.name: Thick Growth
21.description: Root Wave's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have a higher chance to stun enemiess.

22.name: Winternid Thorns
22.description:
Entangling Roots' base damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Physical Resistance Shred from all sources is converted to Cold Resistance Shred ch…

23.name: Iceshard Roots
23.description:
Root Wave has a chance to inflict {Frostbite}. 

Poison chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite for Root Wave and effects related to poison now depend on Frostbite instead.

24.name: Thicket of Frost
24.description: Root Wave gains additional freeze rate per character level.

25.name: Nourishment Surge
25.description:
Root Wave now heals other allies it hits. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

This effect is tripled for minions.

26.name: Wild Weapons
26.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional physical damage with spells and attacks for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

27.name: Blooming Magic
27.description: Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to deal additional damage with spells for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

28.name: Bush Stalkers
28.description: Root Wave causes your Wolves and Bear it hits to have improved base critical strile chance and deal more damage with critical strikes for 8 seconds. This effect does not stack.

29.name: Venomsting
29.description:
Root Wave causes your minions and other allies it hits to have additional chance to poison on hit. This buff lasts 8 seconds and does not stack.

The effect is tripled for Scorpions and Serpents.

0.name: Upheaval
0.description: Sunders the ground in a line in front of you, dealing damage to enemies along the path.

2.name: Tremblor
2.description: When you directly use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Shattering} up to a maximum, causing your next {Fury Leap} or {Earthquake} to consume all stacks to gain additional physical penetration and increased area per stack consumed.

3.name: Excavating Blow
3.description:
Upheaval now splits up into 3 fault lines in front of you, but Upheaval costs additional mana. Enemies can only be hit by 1 Fault Line at a time.

Upheaval Totems now have 50% less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Erupting Earth
4.description: Upheaval now travels in 5 fault lines in a star around you.

5.name: Glacial Cascade
5.description:
Upheaval's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Upheaval has a chance to freeze enemies on hit.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and slo…

6.name: Sundering Strike
6.description: When Upheaval hits an enemy it has a chance to release a {Shockwave}, a melee physical subskill. The Shockwave cannot hit enemies already hit by Upheaval and vice versa.

7.name: Inexhaustible
7.description: Upheaval costs less mana and has a chance to shred enemy armor.

8.name: Mantle Strike
8.description: Improves Upheaval's base critical strike chance and it cannot be dodged.

9.name: Crust Rupture
9.description: Upheaval critical strikes deal more damage.

10.name: Stonethorn Pillars
10.description: Creating an Upheaval Totem consumes all active {Thorn Totems} to grant it more damage per totem consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers). You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval totem and you have an additional charge.

11.name: Mountain Fortress
11.description: You can now create an additional maximum Upheaval Totem and you have an additional charge.

12.name: Frozen Collision
12.description: Upheaval deals additional melee cold damage, and also deals more melee damage to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Cold Front
13.description: Upheaval has additional freeze rate.

14.name: Sublimation
14.description: You cast {Shatter} on enemies you kill with Upheaval, a spell subskill dealing cold damage in an area.

15.name: Quarry Maker
15.description: Upheaval now creates additional fault lines, but costs more mana.

16.name: Maiming Rubble
16.description:
Upheaval hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and have a chance to slow them.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

17.name: Terrain Delving
17.description: Upheaval deals damage in a wider area.

18.name: Primal Bulwark
18.description: When you use Upheaval and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Earth Armor} for 6 seconds up to a maximum amount of stacks, granting you additional armor and endurance threshold per stack of Attunement.

19.name: Through Muck and Clay
19.description: While you have {Earth Armor}, if you fall below 6 stacks of {Maelstrom} you consume all stacks of Earth Armor to cast Maelstrom once per stack consumed.

20.name: Terraforming Clash
20.description: Upheaval travels further.

21.name: Earthbreaker
21.description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer scales with increases to attack speed.

22.name: Glacial Crash
22.description:
Upheaval penetrates enemy physical and cold resistance.

This effect is doubled while using a two handed weapon.

23.name: Natural Weapons
23.description: Upheaval has increased area while using a mace, additional bleed chance while using an axe and additional cold penetration while using a staff.

24.name: Unstoppable Strength
24.description: Upheaval deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to stun enemies.

25.name: Brutish Engagement
25.description: Upheaval deals more melee damage to enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on how close they are to you, up to a maximum.

26.name: Hindering Tremors
26.description: Upheaval hits have a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies and it penetrates enemy physical resistance, but travels a shorter distance.

27.name: Rock Upsurge
27.description: When Upheaval hits your totems it has a chance to release a {Shockwave} from the totem.

28.name: Master of the Totem
28.description: Upheaval hits grant your totems increased armor and more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 4 seconds. This effect can stack an unlimited about of times.

29.name: Rejuvenating Splinters
29.description: Upheaval and {Shockwave} hits from the {Sundering Strikes} node now {Shatter} totems, releasing shards of rock and debris dealing spell physical damage and heals you per point of Attunement.

30.name: Upheaval Totems
30.description: You now create an {Upheaval Totem} that attacks with Upheaval from it rather than yourself. You are limited to 1 of these totems. Upheaval now has a cooldown and costs significantly more mana.

2.name: Empowered Drain
2.description: Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Soul Blast
3.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life you cast Soul Blast at their location, dealing spell necrotic damage to enemies in an area around them.

4.name: Malignant Discharge
4.description: {Soul Blast} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

6.name: Hecatomb
6.description: Drain Life can now target your minions. You gain 10 mana per second for each minion you are draining.

7.name: Necrotic Feast
7.description: Drain Life can now only target minions. Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health.

8.name: Lay Waste
8.description: Drain Life deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the health leech from its base effect and nodes on this tree is removed.

9.name: Soul Bond
9.description: Drain Life has a chance to summon a {Soul Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion that deals necrotic damage to enemies.

10.name: Virulence
10.description:
Drain Life's base necrotic damage is converted to poison damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Swaps Drain Life's {Necrotic} tag for a {Poison} tag.

11.name: Blood Pact
11.description: Drain Life no longer costs mana. Instead, you lose 10% of your current health per second while channelling. Nodes that modify mana drain now modify this health drain instead.

12.name: Death's Barrier
12.description: You are granted ward when Drain Life kills an enemy.

13.name: Horrify
13.description: Drain Life has a chance to slow and fear its targets each second.

14.name: Shadowy Tendril
14.description: Drain Life can drain an additional target.

15.name: Contempt
15.description:
You gain a stack of {Contempt} when you have channelled on the same enemy for 2 seconds.

Contempt grants more armour (multiplicative with other modifiers) and adds to all resistances. All stacks of Contempt are lost when you stop channelling.

16.name: Enduring Contempt
16.description: {Contempt} stacks last for a duration after you stop channelling Drain Life.

17.name: Stagger
17.description: When Drain Life has channelled on the same target for 2 seconds, it stuns them for 2 seconds.

18.name: Stupefy
18.description: The stun inflicted by {Stagger} lasts longer and Drain Life deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

19.name: Thoughtsteal
19.description: Drain Life costs less mana per second.

20.name: Condemnation
20.description: Drain Life applies stacks of {Damned} each second. {Damned} is an ailment that deals necrotic damage over time.

21.name: Word Of Conviction
21.description: {Damned} inflicted by Drain Life lasts longer.

22.name: Eternal Servitude
22.description: If {Wandering Spirits} is active when you start channeling Drain Life it does not expire until you stop channeling.

23.name: Ravenous
23.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to targets that are on low health.

24.name: Insatiable
24.description: Drain Life leeches a higher percentage of damage as health, but costs more mana per second.

25.name: Dark Shackles
25.description: Drain Life is now cast instead of channelled. Lasts for 3 seconds. Adds an up-front mana cost, and this cost is affected by modifiers to mana drain, except for the {Blood Pact} node.

26.name: Enduring Night
26.description: {Dark Shackles} lasts longer, but Drain Life costs more mana.

27.name: Grasp Of The Damned
27.description: {Dark Shackles} can hit up to 10 additional targets, and slows enemies hit each second, but Drain Life costs significantly more mana.

28.name: Chilling Demise
28.description: When a target is killed by Drain Life, you chill enemies in an area around them for a duration.

30.name: Unholy Mass
30.description: Drain Life deals 3% more damage per stack of {Damned} on enemies affected by {Damned}, up to a cap (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.name: Circle of Sacrifice
32.description:
You gain ward over time while channelling based on your maximum mana.

Drain Life can affect enemies in a wider area. This does not affect the maximum number of enemies you can drain from at a time.

33.name: Cloak of Solitude
33.description: Increased Area stats from this tree and other sources has no effect on Drain Life's area of effect, but instead grants you additional Ward Retention while channelling Drain Life.

3.name: Hunter's Restoration
3.description: You have increased health and every 3 seconds your next hit restores your health.

4.name: Primal Medicine
4.description: Your minions deal increased damage, and using a potion also heals your minions for a percentage of the amount it heals you.

7.name: Tempest Bond
7.description: You deal increased physical, cold, and lightning damage. These bonuses are doubled while you have an active minion.

8.name: Hunter's Emanation
8.description: The healing from {Hunter's Restoration} also applies to your minions, and when you trigger Hunter's Restoration, your minions gain increased damage for 3 seconds.

10.name: Harmony of Blades
10.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping an axe or sword in your off hand. You take more damage while dual wielding (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Ursine Strength
12.description: You have additional strength and take less damage from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Artor's Loyalty
14.description:
You are limited to a single companion.

Your companion is larger and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Ambush
15.description: Every 5 seconds, your next melee attack deals increased damage and grants {Aspect of the Shark} for 3 seconds, a buff that increases melee damage by 75% and melee attack speed by 10%.

18.name: Tusk Warrior
18.description: {Aspect of the Boar} also grants increased physical damage and a chance for attacks and spells to cause enemies to bleed.

19.name: Boar Heart
19.description: You are granted {Aspect of the Boar} for a duration when hit by a melee attack, a buff that reduces damage taken by 15%. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

20.name: Hawk Wings
20.description: You and your minions have increased dodge rating, and you and your minions have a chance to gain {Haste} on hit.

21.name: Cry of the Lynx
21.description:
You and your companions have an increased chance to critically strike. 

When you use a companion ability, you and your companions are granted {Aspect of the Lynx} for a duration, a buff that grants 100% increased critical strike chance and 100% increased stun chance.

24.name: Call of the Pack
24.description: You and your companions have additional health, and you and your companions are healed whenever you use a companion ability.

25.name: Rending Maw
25.description: {Aspect of the Shark} also grants attacks and spells a chance to reduce enemy armor.

26.name: Rattlesnake Rattlesnake
26.description: {Aspect of the Viper} lasts longer and grants you Poison Penetration.

27.name: Life in the Wilderness
27.description: You have additional vitality and a higher endurance threshold. Your endurance and endurance threshold from all sources also apply to your companions.

28.name: Serrated Claws
28.description: You and your companions' critical strikes deal more damage, and {Aspect of the Lynx} now also grants critical strike damage.

29.name: Avian Shelter
29.description: You have a higher endurance threshold and you and your minions have additional physical resistance.

30.name: Feeding Frenzy
30.description: {Aspect of the Shark} can now stack up to 10 times, but it is significantly less effective (multiplicative with other modifiers).

31.name: Critical Bite
31.description: {Aspect of the Lynx} also grants a percentage of damage leeched as health when you critically strike.

32.name: Natural Bond
32.description:
You are limited to only one companion.

Your companion is granted more health and deals more damage (both effects are multiplicative with other modifiers).

33.name: Primal Aspects
33.description: All {Aspect} buffs from this tree last longer.

37.name: Ancestral Speed
37.description: Your totems have increased cast speed and you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 3 seconds when you directly summon a totem.

38.name: Totemic Fury
38.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have an active totem.

39.name: Rhythm of Thunder
39.description: Every 3 seconds, your next melee attack deals additional lightning damage.

40.name: Silent Protector
40.description: You have additional armour and increased mana regen while you have an active totem.

41.name: Shamanic Infusion
41.description: You have additional attunement. You and your minions penetrate enemy physical, cold, and lightning resistances.

43.name: Storm Bringer
43.description: You and your minions have increased lightning damage and additional lightning resistance.

48.name: Protective Circle
48.description: You have additional physical and elemental resistance for each active totem.

49.name: Swirling Maelstrom
49.description:
You have additional health and mana, and have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when hit. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

53.name: Ascendant Circle
53.description: You deal increased spell damage for each active totem.

55.name: Deep Wounds
55.description: {Aspect of the Boar} also grants Bleed you inflict additional Physical Penetration.

56.name: Porcine Constitution
56.description: {Aspect of the Boar} grants additional damage reduction, and now also grants increased health regeneration.

57.name: The Circle Of Life
57.description: You gain health and have a chance to be granted {Aspect Of The Shark} for 3 seconds whenever you kill an enemy.

58.name: Viper Fangs
58.description:
You and your companions have increased melee attack speed.

When you hit an enemy, you have a chance for you and your companions to be granted {Aspect of the Viper} for 3 seconds, a buff that grants 100% chance to poison on hit and 100% increased damage over time.

59.name: Dragon Slayer
59.description: The On Kill effects of {Circle Of Life} also have an equal chance to trigger when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

64.name: Shattered Heavens
64.description: You deal additional cold damage with spells and attacks.

66.name: Storm Blade
66.description: You have increased melee damage for each active totem.

67.name: Hunters of the Deep
67.description: Your companions are granted {Aspect of the Shark} whenever you are, and Aspect of the Shark lasts longer.

68.name: Thunder Strike
68.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} on hit.

69.name: Lagon's Answer
69.description:
Your direct spell casts have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt}.
While channeling, you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} every second.

70.name: Conflux
70.description: Your area skills have increased area, and you take less damage from shocked enemies.

72.name: Blossoming Garden
72.description: Increases healing effectiveness for you and your minions.

74.name: Fetid Resilience
74.description: You deal increased damage over time while transformed and take less damage over time in human form (multiplicative with other modifiers).

76.name: Nightshade Fangs
76.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to inflict Bleed on hit and your spells have a chance to inflict Poison on hit.

77.name: Thicket of Thorns
77.description: You have a chance to cast {Thorn Shield} on yourself when you are hit and you have increased armor and reflect damage back to attackers.

78.name: Natural Duality
78.description: You are limitted to one companion, but that companion has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). If you control a companion you deal increased damage and have additional armour.

79.name: Wind in the Leaves
79.description: Increases the attack and cast speed of you and your minions.

81.name: Focused Wrath
81.description: You deal increased damage while transformed and your rage decays slower.

85.name: Reincarnation
85.description: You and your minions are healed when you transform. This scales with increases to healing effectiveness.

90.name: Force of Nature
90.description: You and your minions deal additional physical damage with spells and melee attacks.

91.name: Eternal Nature
91.description: You and your companions have additional spell damage.

92.name: Tiger Spirit
92.description: You have increased critical strike chance and multiplier while you have the {Shapeshifter} buff.

93.name: Primal Shifter
93.description: You gain the {Shapeshifter} buff for a limited duration when you transform, granting you increased armor and damage.

94.name: Impervious
94.description: Your melee hits have a 20% chance to grant you a stack of {Impervious} causing you to take less damage from hits (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you lose a stack when you are hit and you lose all stacks after 10 seconds of not gaining any stacks.

98.name: Blessed Springs
98.description: Increases cold damage and healing effectiveness for you and your minions.

100.name: Toxic Reach
100.description: Your and your minions' hits have a chance to poison.

104.name: Hideskin
104.description: You have additional health and gain a percentage of your maximum health as endurance threshold.

106.name: Eternal Storm
106.description:
When you kill a frozen enemy, a random totem is healed to full, has its duration refreshed, and its damage is permanently increased. 

This damage increase is doubled for cold damage.

109.name: Ocean Maw
109.description: {Aspect of the Shark} is more effective and lasts longer.

110.name: Rancour
110.description: Your rage only decays if you have used an ability recently (past 4 seconds).

112.name: Piercing Gale
112.description: You and your minions have additional cold penetration.

114.name: Berserker
114.description: While on low health (below 35%) you take less damage and deal more melee damage.

115.name: Elder Branch
115.description: You and your totems deal additional spell damage. This bonus is tripled while using an axe.

116.name: Ancestral Weaponry
116.description: You deal additional melee damage with most two handed weapons. The amount and damage type depend on the type of weapon used.

0.name: Warcry
0.description: Unleash a mighty roar that stuns and knocks back nearby enemies.

2.name: Deep Roar
2.description: Warcry affects a larger area.

3.name: Battle Cry
3.description: You and allies affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance for 4 seconds.

4.name: Ferocity
4.description:
While Warcry is on cooldown, your critical strikes have a chance to use Warcry for you. 

This effect can only happen once per direct Warcry use, and it will reset the cooldown.

5.name: Jormun's Wrath
5.description:
Warcry now freezes enemies instead of stunning them, but it no longer knocks enemies back.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to {Frostbite} chance and effects related to bleed now depend on Frostbite instead.

6.name: Frost Claw
6.description: You and allies affected by Warcry deal increased cold damage for 4 seconds.

7.name: Bringer of Winter
7.description: You and your cold minions affected by Warcry gain increased crit chance and additional chill chance for 4 seconds.

8.name: Heart of Rime
8.description: Warcry inflicts stacks of {Frostbite} to affected enemies.

9.name: Frigid Breath
9.description: Enemies frozen by Warcry take increased damage from hits.

10.name: Debilitating Shout
10.description: Warcry applies one stack of {Frailty} to affected enemies for a short duration.

11.name: Toxic Companions
11.description: For 4 seconds after using Warcry, your {Wolves} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed and your {Scorpion} has a chance to poison enemies.

12.name: Juggernaut
12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after using Warcry.

13.name: Breath of Eterra
13.description:
Warcry now also restores your health. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

14.name: Whirlpool
14.description:
You now cast {Maelstrom} when you use Warcry. 

Maelstrom cast this way costs less mana.

15.name: Purging Shout
15.description: Warcry now cleanses negative ailments on you.

16.name: Invigorate
16.description:
Warcry now also restores ally health for the same amount as from {Breath of Eterra}. 

The amount of healing is increased by healing effectiveness and is doubled if used while on low health.

17.name: Hastily Advance
17.description: If Warcry hits at least one enemy, you gain {Haste} for 1 second.

18.name: Energized Charge
18.description: Warcry costs less mana and {Haste} gained from {Hastily Advance} lasts longer.

19.name: Raging Frenzy
19.description: You gain {Frenzy} for the same duration as you have Haste from {Hastily Advance}.

20.name: Frightful Presence
20.description: Warcry now fears enemies for 2 seconds instead of stunning them.

21.name: Horrifying Cry
21.description: Fear inflicted by Warcry lasts longer and each stack of the {Berserk} buff from the Berserker node now also causes you to deal more damage to Feared enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.name: Berserker
22.description:
You gain the {Berserk} buff for 1 second when you use Warcry, granting you additional melee damage.

While you have Berserk, you gain additional stacks of Berserk on melee hit up to a maximum, and melee hits refresh all stacks.

24.name: Brutality
24.description: {Berserk} has increased duration and additional maximum stacks.

25.name: Bloodthirst
25.description: {Berserk} now also affects your Raptor and Bear.

26.name: Fury Strikes
26.description: {Berserk} now also grants you increased attack speed per stack of Berserk up to a maximum.

27.name: Staggering Roar
27.description: Warcry knocks enemies further back.

28.name: Apprehend
28.description: Warcry now pulls enemies instead of knocking them back.

29.name: Challenging Might
29.description: Warcry now also taunts affected enemies for a short duration.

30.name: Kinetic Scream
30.description: Warcry now hits enemies and deals spell physical damage.

31.name: Eviscerating Howl
31.description: Warcry causes enemies to bleed.

32.name: Shallow Breath
32.description: Warcry has a significantly shorter cooldown, but no longer has a guaranteed stun, freeze, or fear.

33.name: Totemic Heart
33.description: You now place down a totem for 3 seconds that repeatedly uses Warcry instead of you, but Warcry costs more mana.

2.name: Unbridled Ruin
2.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Rune} consumed.

3.name: Stride to Safety
3.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation you leap backwards a short distance, hovering in the air for a moment. In this state you take less damage and directly casting Runic Invocation deals more damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers). 

The effect of {Enigma} no lon…

4.name: Warmage's Initiative
4.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation now leap forwards instead of backwards. 

The effect of {Enigma} no longer works when taking this node.

Runic Invocation gains the {Movement} tag.

5.name: Interlude
5.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first two {Runes}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least two runes for this effect to occur.

6.name: Prologue
6.description:
During the leap you also cast the Invocation corresponding to your first {Rune}, consuming its mana cost.

Your Invocation must have at least one rune for this effect to occur.

7.name: Attuned Approach
7.description: Runic Invocation grants ward per {Rune} consumed and on direct casts you refund a portion of its mana cost.

8.name: Rune Slinger
8.description: Runic Invocation has increased cast speed and when directly casting an {Invocation} you gain ward equal to a portion of your current mana.

9.name: Elementalist's Call
9.description: When you directly cast Runic Invocation, the next non-channelled elemental spell you cast penetrates enemy elemental resistance and deals damage in a larger area.

10.name: Mastery of the Invoker
10.description: When you consume {Runes} with a skill other than Runic Invocation you have a chance to also cast the corresponding {Invocation} for those runes.

11.name: Glyphcarver's Dominance
11.description: {Invocations} that deal damage in an area now deal damage in a larger area.

12.name: Word of Rahyeh
12.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Rah Rune} have a chance to ignite enemies and deal additional spell fire damage.

13.name: Inscribed Patterns
13.description:
Runes now provide you with passive effects while you have them.

{Rah Rune}: Grants increased mana regeneration per {Rune} of this type.
{Gon Rune}: Grants ward per second per {Rune} of this type.
{Heo Rune}: Grants a higher chance to freeze enemies per {Rune} of this type.

14.name: Runic Energy
14.description: Every second you go without casting a Runic Invocation you gain a stack of {Runic Energy} up to a maximum. {Invocations} consume all {Runic Energy} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Runic Energy}.

15.name: Spell Cascade
15.description:
When you directly cast Runic Invocation with at least 12 {Runic Energy} you also proc a random equipped non-channeling skill of the same element as each of the {Runes} consumed.

This effect consumes these skills' mana costs and puts them on cooldown (excluding movement skills…

16.name: Copied Scrolls
16.description: Runic Invocation now has a chance to be repeated per stack of {Runic Energy}.

17.name: Rune Powercore
17.description: While you have 3 runes and your combination of runes changes without casting an invocation, you gain {Runic Energy}.

18.name: Arcane Battery
18.description: Your maximum {Runic Energy} is tripled, but bonuses per {Runic Energy} are halved. When you cast a skill you gain {Runic Energy} per mana spent.

19.name: Runic Energizer
19.description: Each unique {Invocation} you directly cast causes {Runic Energy} to accumulate faster until you repeat an {Invocation}.

20.name: Word of Heorot
20.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Heo Rune} have a chance to chill enemies and have a higher chance to freeze them.

21.name: Author of Arcana
21.description: Directly casting Runic Invocation now refunds its mana cost and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it now has a cooldown when cast this way.

22.name: Immutable Order
22.description:
Whenever you gain a {Rune}, instead of it depending on the type of skill cast, it always results in your sequence of {Runes} mirroring the first three skills on your action bar from left to right.

This effect ignores skills that don't have an elemental tag.

23.name: Adept Runescribing
23.description: Runic Invocation has a shorter cooldown.

24.name: Consolidator
24.description: While you have 3 {Runes} and your combination of {Runes} changes without casting an {Invocation}, Runic Invocation's remaining cooldown is reduced.

25.name: Enigma
25.description:
Whenever you directly cast an {Invocation} you blink to the target location first, but Runic Invocation now has a cooldown. 

{Invocations} cast this way automatically targets a random nearby enemy.

Runic Invocation gains the {Traversal} tag.

26.name: Transcriber of Power
26.description:
After casting Runic Invocation you gain additional spell damage and cast speed for a short duration. 

The buff duration scales with amount of {Runes} consumed.

27.name: Word of Lagon
27.description: {Invocations} that include at least one {Gon Rune} have a chance to shock enemies and have a higher chance to critically hit enemies.

28.name: Devastating Starfall
28.description: Runic Invocation deals more damage per type of {Rune} consumed.

29.name: Cosmic Mind
29.description: When you cast an {Invocation} using a sequence of three different {Runes} you gain ward per point of intelligence.

30.name: Elemental Starfield
30.description:
Whenever you cast Runic Invocation, you also cast up to one of each type of {Elemental Nova} that you can cast directly. Each unique {Rune} you have when casting Runic Invocation represents different {Elemental Nova}. 

These {Novas} are cast with a 0.3 second interval.

This …

32.name: Scrivener's Haste
32.description:
You gain {Runes} faster while channelling.

You gain a burst of ward based on your maximum mana when your number of runes increases from channelling.

34.name: Elemental Lore
34.description: Runic Invocation penetrates elemental resistances per point of Intelligence.

1.name: Arcanist
1.description: Runebolt has increased cast speed and it has a chance to grant you the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

2.name: Cryomantic Bolt
2.description: Runebolt deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Frost Spikes
3.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend …

4.name: Ice Shard
4.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on chill inst…

5.name: Fulminating Bolt
5.description: Runebolt deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Lightning Spear
6.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Chill chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to chill now depend on sh…

7.name: Jolting Spark
7.description:
The {Fire Bolt's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to {Shock} for Runebolt and effects related to ignite now depend on …

8.name: Pyromantic Bolt
8.description: Runebolt deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Blazing Flare
9.description:
The {Lightning Bolt's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to shock now depend o…

10.name: Searing Dart
10.description:
The {Cold Bolt's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

{Frostbite} chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Runebolt and effects related to {Frostbite} now depend on i…

11.name: Efficient Experiment
11.description:
Runebolt now randomly selects the element with each cast rather than by combo order. 

Directly casting Rune Bolt now has a chance to double cast if the previous cast was a different type. The chance is based on the amount of {Glyph of Chaos} you have in your crafting inventory.

12.name: Arcane Overcharge
12.description: Runebolt has a chance to shoot additional projectiles in a volley in front of you.

13.name: Supercharged Bolt
13.description: Runebolt's chance to shoot extra projectiles from the {Arcane Overcharge} node and the amount of projectiles are doubled while standing in a {Glyph of Dominion}.

14.name: Runic Evocation
14.description: Runebolt now shoots in a cone and the projectiles seek out enemies.

15.name: Attuned Recovery
15.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you health if it was a {Fire Bolt}, ward if it was a {Lightning Bolt} and mana if it was a {Cold Bolt}.

16.name: Amplified Cascade
16.description:
If your last three direct casts were all Runebolt, then any further cast of it becomes tri-elemental (fire, lightning and cold). Tri-elemental Runebolt deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies all the effects of the {Attuned Recovery} node.

Once you…

17.name: Inscription of Momentum
17.description: When Runebolt passes through a {Frost Wall} it is intensified dealing more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and gains increased projectile speed.

18.name: Punch Through Metal
18.description: Runebolt hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

19.name: Kinetic Breach
19.description: Runebolt deals additional physical damage per point of strength of you or your nearby ally with the highest amount of strength.

20.name: Runestone
20.description:
Directly casting Runebolt now creates a {Runestone} in front of you if you do not currently have one nearby instead of casting a Runebolt. If you have a nearby {Runestone}, directly using Runebolt now casts two bolts from the {Runestone} towards the target.  

After several se…

21.name: Awakened Runestone
21.description: Every second while channeling a skill, your nearest {Runestone} has a chance to cast Runebolt towards your target.

22.name: Devastator
22.description: Runebolt now explodes when it reaches its target location or when hitting enemies or obstacles, dealing damage of the corresponding element in an area.

23.name: Wrecking Ball
23.description: The explosion from {Devastator} deals damage in a larger area per uncapped resistance of the corresponding element.

24.name: Arcane Restoration
24.description: Directly casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy has a chance to grant you mana.

25.name: Runeweaver
25.description: Casting Runebolt and hitting at least one enemy grants you a stack of {Runeweave} up to a maximum.

26.name: Dissolve and Conquer
26.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants you more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of armor shred on the target up to a maximum.

27.name: Cosmic Tapestry
27.description: Each stack of {Runeweave} also grants your {Runic Invocation} additional critical strike chance.

28.name: Orderly Conduit
28.description:
Runebolt gains additional effects for each unique {Rune} you have. Multiple {Runes} of the same type does not stack the effect.

{Rah Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to ignite enemies.
{Gon Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to shock enemies.
{Heo Rune}: Runebolt has a chance to inflic…

29.name: Torrent of Evocation
29.description: Runebolt's combo is now cast in a reversed order.

30.name: Focused Runewords
30.description: Casting Runebolt now randomizes the runes of your {Runic Invocation}.

31.name: Echomancy
31.description: Runebolt is now cast in a sequence with the same order of your most recent {Runic Invocation}

32.name: Imbued Runestone
32.description:
If you have 3 {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} when you create a {Runestone}, the {Runes} are consumed to instead create an {Imbued Runestone} that fires three bolts. An {Imbued Runestone's} explosion has 100% more area of effect and damage.

This effect has a 20 second cooldow…

2.name: Ursine Heart
2.description: You have additional endurance and endurance threshold while in Werebear Form.

3.name: Frenzied Strikes
3.description: You regain additional {Rage} if you hit at least one enemy with {Swipe}.

4.name: Relentless Thunder
4.description: For 6 seconds after you enter Werebear Form, you deal more Lightning Damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 100% of Swipe's Base Damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with lightning damage instead of physical damage.

5.name: Wisened Claws
5.description: You gain additional spell damage per point of Strength while in Werebear Form.

6.name: Ursine Storm
6.description:
You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you use Swipe or Maul and hit at least one enemy.

This consumes Maelstrom's mana cost as Rage.

7.name: Rip and Tear
7.description: Maul and Rampage deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Dauntless
8.description: Rampage has increased movement speed, a higher chance to stun enemies and stuns inflicted by Rampage last longer.

9.name: Apex Predator
9.description: Rampage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have global increased damage while Rampaging.

10.name: Eterra's Renewal
10.description: When you leave Werebear Form you cleanse all negative ailments and gain {Haste} for 3 seconds.

11.name: Voice of the Thicket
11.description:
After using Rampage, Human Form is now replaced with {Arboreal Protection}, which casts {Thorn Shield} on you and up to 5 nearby allies and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

12.name: Intimidating Cry
12.description:
After using Rampage, you now {Roar}.

This consumes Warcry's mana cost as Rage and puts it on cooldown.

13.name: Army Sunderer
13.description: Rampage and Maul hits shred enemy armor.

14.name: Unending Storm
14.description:
Rampage has no cooldown.

While using Rampage you move more slowly, but deal more lightning damage. Both of these effects are multiplicative with other modifiers.

15.name: Insatiable
15.description: Maul and Rampage have improve base critical strike chance and you have global increased critical strike chance while in Werebear Form.

17.name: Crackling Assault
17.description: You cast {Storm Bolts} from the sky a number of times each second while Rampaging.

18.name: Invigoration
18.description: You regain health and {Rage} on kill or when you hit a rare or boss enemy.

19.name: Bloodthirst
19.description:
Your hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed while in Werebear Form.

This chance is doubled for Maul.

21.name: Territorial
21.description: Maul and Roar affects a larger area.

22.name: Fury of the Maul
22.description: Maul has a shorter cooldown.

24.name: Wild Command
24.description: When you use Maul and hit at least one enemy, your minions deal increased damage for 8 seconds. This effect can stack.

25.name: Enrage
25.description: You regain {Rage} and health with Roar per enemy hit, up to a maximum number of enemies.

26.name: Bringer of Storms
26.description:
Maul and Rampage's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Armor Shred and bleed chance from all sources is converted to shock and effects related to armor shred …

27.name: Pummel and Bash
27.description: Maul deals more melee damage to stunned enemies and you regain {Rage} when you hit a stunned enemy with Maul.

29.name: Ruthless
29.description: Your {Rage} decays slower while in Werebear Form.

31.name: Skull Crusher
31.description:
Your {Fury Leap} tree now applies to Maul. 

This consumes Fury Leap's mana cost as Rage.

32.name: Tremor Slam
32.description:
After using Maul, you now use {Upheaval} towards your target.

This consumes Upheaval's mana cost.

33.name: Barrage of the Swarm
33.description:
After directly using Roar, Human Form is now replaced with {Swarm Call}, which summons a {Locust} for each nearby stunned enemy up to 6 and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

34.name: Woodland Bear
34.description:
After using Maul, you now cast {Entangling Roots}.

This consumes Entangling Roots' mana cost as Rage.

2.name: Elementalist
2.description: Increases your elemental damage

3.name: Reactive Ward
3.description: When you drop below 70% health you gain a burst of ward based on your maximum health. This effect has a 12 second cooldown.

4.name: Preparation
4.description: Every 3 seconds, your next elemental spell deals increased damage and has a chance to slow enemies on hit.

6.name: Arcane Current
6.description: When you hit an enemy with a lightning skill you cast {Arcane Lightning} at additional enemies, dealing lightning damage. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

7.name: Arcane Flames
7.description: When you hit an enemy with a fire skill you {Ignite} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

11.name: Essence of Celerity
11.description: Each stack of {Arcane Momentum} lasts longer and also increases your spell damage.

13.name: Arcane Momentum
13.description:
When you cast a spell you gain a stack of {Arcane Momentum} for 2 seconds and refreshing the duration of all existing stacks.

Each stacks of Arcane Momentum increases your cast speed.

15.name: Lost Knowledge
15.description: You gain ward based on your current mana when you use a skill that costs at least 40 mana.

21.name: Arcane Avalanche
21.description: Whenever you take a hit that leaves you below half health, you freeze nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

22.name: Crackling Precision
22.description: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells. This effect is doubled for lightning skills.

24.name: Rune of Winter
24.description:
Increases your chance to freeze and converts lightning blast and volcanic orb to cold spells, changing their base damage type to cold and giving them a chance to freeze.

Lightning Blast gains a base freeze rate of 46.

Volcanic Orb's core gains a base freeze rate of 40 and it…

27.name: Dragon Mage
27.description: You are granted increased damage with an element whenever you have casted a spell of another element recently (last 4 seconds).

28.name: Warder
28.description:
You have a chance to be granted ward whenever you hit an enemy with a fire, cold, or lightning skill.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire hit and a lightning hit within the same 10 s…

31.name: Dragon Breath
31.description: You are granted an additional chance to apply an elemental ailment with skills of the same element whenever you have casted a spell of another element recently (last 4 seconds).

32.name: Arcane Warden
32.description: You gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

34.name: Elemental Strikes
34.description: Your fire melee attacks have a chance to ignite on hit. Your cold melee attacks have a chance to chill on hit. Your lightning melee attacks have a chance to shock on hit.

35.name: Infused Weapon
35.description: Your melee attacks deal additional damage. The type of damage added depends on the damage type of the attack.

36.name: Frozen Steel
36.description: Your melee attacks deal additional cold damage and you have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

37.name: Arcane Shielding
37.description: You gain Arcane Shield for 4 seconds when you use an melee attack and hit at least one enemy. Arcane Shield is a buff that reduces damage taken and generates ward, but does not stack.

38.name: Flame Walker
38.description:
Each second if you are moving or using a melee attack you have chance to cast Fire Aura. This chance is doubled if you do not have an active Fire Aura.

You can have multiple stacks of Fire Aura active at once.

39.name: Warden's Echo
39.description: When you gain Ward from {Arcane Warden} you have a chance to create an elemental burst damaging enemies around you. The element of the burst matches the element of the melee attack you used.

41.name: Mana Reaver
41.description: You have additional health and you have a chance to regain mana when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

42.name: Incinerating Aura
42.description: Fire Aura from all sources has higher base damage and has a larger area of effect.

43.name: Shattered Aegis
43.description: Arcane Shield is much less effective, but can stack up to 4 times and also increases armour.

44.name: Crackling Aura
44.description: You deal increased lightning damage and Fire Aura's base damage is converted to lightning, unless it has already been converted to cold.

45.name: Sun and Storms
45.description:
You deal increased fire and lightning damage.

You gain ward when you use a lightning skill or a fire skill. This effect has a 7 second cooldown, but the cooldown is not shared between different elements, so you can gain ward from a fire skill and a lightning skill within the …

46.name: Burden of Knowledge
46.description: You have additional spell damage, but your spells take longer to cast.

47.name: Burning Hands
47.description: You have additional fire resistance and you have a chance to cast Fire Aura when you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

48.name: Volka's Razor
48.description: Your melee attacks deal increased elemental damage if they cost 10 or more mana. This also affects the damage dealt by all the ailments they apply and the spells they trigger from their trees.

50.name: Blade Weaver
50.description:
When you use a melee attack that costs less than 10 mana you gain a stack of {Blade Weaving}.

When you use a melee attack that costs 10 or more mana the stacks are consumed and the attack deals 15% more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack consumed.

51.name: Prodigy
51.description: You gain ward per second for each point of intelligence you have.

52.name: Blades of Fires
52.description: Each stack of Fire Aura increases your melee elemental damage.

55.name: Sphere of Protection
55.description: You have additional health and you take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) from ignited, shocked or chilled enemies.

58.name: Arcane Wind
58.description: When you hit an enemy with a cold skill you {Chill} additional nearby enemies. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

60.name: Afterglow
60.description:
You deal increased spell damage and have additional ward retention.

These effects are doubled if you have recently (in the last 4 seconds) either used a skill that costs 40 mana or started channelling a skill that costs at least 8 mana per second while channelling.

64.name: Distant Spark
64.description: When you critically strike an enemy from at least 4 meters away, you have a chance to cast {Spark Nova,} a spell that deals lightning damage to nearby enemies.

66.name: Whirling Snow
66.description: You have a chance to chill enemies when you are hit, and your skills have a chance to chill enemies on hit. This effect is doubled for cold skills.

68.name: Mirror Breath
68.description:
Cycles the effects {Dragon Mage} and {Dragon Breath}.

For example, using a fire skill now gives a bonus to cold damage and chill chance with cold skills, instead of lightning damage shock chance with lightning skills.

69.name: Arcane Insight
69.description: You have additional intelligence, and you have a chance when you hit an enemy to be granted {Insight,} a buff that grants 20% increased elemental damage and 20% ward retention for 5 seconds.

70.name: Freezing Aura
70.description: You have a higher freeze rate multiplier and Fire Aura is converted to cold. This converts its base damage and gives it a chance to freeze enemies within its area of effect.

71.name: Defender of Welryn
71.description: You have higher ward retention and Elemental Bursts from the {Warden's Echo} node deal increased damage.

72.name: Storm Blade
72.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and your lightning melee attacks have a chance to apply a Spark Charge on hit.

73.name: Molten Edge
73.description: Your melee hits have a chance to ignite on hit and the ignites they inflict have increased effect.

74.name: Flame Drinker
74.description: Each stack of Fire Aura grants you ward per second.

76.name: Elixir of Knowledge
76.description: Whenever you use a potion, you gain ward based on to your intelligence.

77.name: Essence Duel
77.description: You have increased melee attack speed, and you gain ward when you use an elemental melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

78.name: Silver Rune
78.description: Augments the ward gain effects of the {Reactive Ward} and {Sun and Storms} nodes, causing them to grant more ward and have shorter cooldowns.

80.name: Awe Strike
80.description: Your melee attacks deal additional lightning damage and the shocks they apply last longer.

82.name: Outrun and Outlast
82.description: You have additional health and your ward decays more slowly

84.name: Gemini
84.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. You take more damage while dual wielding (multiplicative with other modifiers).

87.name: Never Late
87.description: After using a traversal skill you next non-channeled spell has additional spell damage and a higher chance to critically strike.

89.name: Mental Catalysis
89.description: While using a Catalyst you have additional Intelligence and take reduced bonus damage from critical strikes.

90.name: Nimbus Walk
90.description: The spell damage and crit chance from the {Never Late} node now also apply to {Traversal} skills, and you gain ward when you use a {Traversal} skill.

92.name: Inscribed Instruments
92.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while using a wand, additional ward retention while using a sceptre, and increased cast speed while using a staff.

93.name: Decree of the Burning Wind
93.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to Bosses and Rare enemies.

95.name: Brand of Deception
95.description: Your damage over time has additional elemental penetration

98.name: Runic Fortress
98.description: You have additional armor while channeling per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

99.name: Order's Imposition
99.description: You deal more damage over time to {Branded} enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

100.name: Runeword: Avalanche
100.description:
When you directly use a Cold Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Avalanche}, a buff that grants additional Spell Cold Damage and grants additional Endurance Threshold per stack of Ignite on the attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

105.name: Rune of Dilation
105.description: After using a {Traversal} skill you gain increased cast speed and movement speed for a short duration. This buff cannot stack.

106.name: Edict of the Scion
106.description: Your area skills have increased area, and when you directly use an area skill you gain ward per active {Rune} from {Runic Invocation}.

109.name: Cerulean Runestones
109.description: You have additional endurance and maximum mana.

110.name: Runeword: Inferno
110.description:
When you directly use a Fire Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Inferno}, a buff that grants additional Spell Fire Damage and grants you more Armor per stack of Shock on the Attacker.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

112.name: Runeword: Hurricane
112.description:
When you directly use a Lightning Skill you have a chance to gain {Runeword: Hurricane}, a buff that grants additional Spell Lightning Damage and Freeze Rate Multiplier.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and does not stack.

2.name: Ignition
2.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to ignite enemies and ignites inflicted by the first attack have increased duration.

4.name: Soot and Ash
4.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to blind enemies while using a bow and a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies while using a melee weapon.

5.name: Blast Wave
5.description: Cinder Strike's first attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

6.name: Overexertion
6.description: Cinder Strike now only has the first attack, but costs significantly more mana.

7.name: Eagerness
7.description: Cinder Strike's second and third attacks have increased attack speed.

8.name: Pocket Sand
8.description: Blind chance from all sources is converted to {Critical Vulnerability} chance for Cinder Strike.

9.name: Cauterize
9.description: Cinder Strike deals more critical strike damage. This bonus is doubled for the first attack.

10.name: Tireless
10.description: Cinder Strike costs less mana.

11.name: Flame Alchemist
11.description: Cinder Strike's first attack has a chance to throw a {Volatile Flask} at targets hit.

12.name: Explosive Impact
12.description: {Volatile Flask} deals more explosion damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Explosive Lash
13.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to cause an explosion on kill. This counts as a {Volatile Flask} explosion.

14.name: Incinerate
14.description: Cinder Strike hits deals additional fire damage for each ignited enemy you have hit recently up to a maximum.

15.name: Searing Blows
15.description: Cinder Strike's first attack has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of ignite on the target up to a maximum.

16.name: Fire Walker
16.description: Cinder Strike deals increased fire damage over time per point of Dexterity.

17.name: Flammable Toxins
17.description: Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance for Cinder Strike.

18.name: Oil Coating
18.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike you are granted {Oil Coating} granting you increased fire damage. This effect can stack and lasts 4 seconds.

19.name: Combustible
19.description:
If you have at least 3 stacks of {Oil Coating} you are granted additional fire penetration.

This effect is doubled for ignites inflicted by Cinder Strike.

20.name: Fire Eater
20.description: {Oil Coating} is limited to 5 stacks. If you would gain another stack you instead regain health and mana.

21.name: Elusive
21.description: You have additional chance to dodge and additional fire resistance per stack of {Oil Coating}.

22.name: Elemental Vulnerability
22.description: {Oil Coating} now grants you increased elemental damage rather than just fire damage.

23.name: Coated Darts
23.description: {Oil Coating} now also grants additional throwing fire damage.

24.name: Kindling
24.description: Cinder Strike has a chance to shred enemy fire resistance.

25.name: Burning Dagger
25.description: If you use and hit at least one enemy with Cinder Strike it consumes 8 mana granting you a {Burning Dagger} that circles you for a second before launching at the nearest enemy.

26.name: Flaming Fury
26.description: {Burning Dagger} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and consumes less mana.

27.name: Firebreathing
27.description: You now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of you on Cinder Strike's first attack.

28.name: Umbral Conflagration
28.description: All your {Shadows} now also throw 5 {Burning Daggers} in a cone in front of them when you do. This consumes all active {Shadows}.

29.name: Inferno
29.description: Cinder Strike deals additional fire damage. This is doubled for the first attack.

2.name: Lagonian Shamanism
2.description: You now have a chance to gain a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} when you cast a {Tempest}.

3.name: Tempestuous Legend
3.description:
{Frigid Tempest} has a higher chance to freeze enemies.
{Thunder Tempest} has a chance to shock enemies.
{Wind Tempest} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Thunderous Storm
4.description: You have a chance to also cast {Thunder Tempest} when you attack with cold or physical Tempest Strike.

5.name: Grand Cyclone
5.description: You have a chance to also cast {Wind Tempest} when you attack with lightning or cold Tempest Strike.

6.name: Nature's Storm
6.description: If Tempest Strike's melee attack does not hit an enemy you consume a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} to cast a {Tempest} of the respective type.

7.name: Scheme of the Architect
7.description: {Gladiator of Lagon} has double the effect on your totems and {Storm Crows} if you have at least 50 Intelligence.

8.name: Stormriding Companions
8.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy physical resistance per active physical minion, penetrates cold resistance per cold minion and penetrates lightning resistance per lightning minion.

9.name: Bulwark of Nature
9.description: Whenever you cast a {Tempest} you also regain a portion of your Endurance Threshold as health.

10.name: Druid's Call
10.description:
While transformed and you use any melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast each {Tempest} of a matching damage type.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tempest Strike's mana cost.

11.name: Attuned Slam
11.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost, but it also costs additional mana.

12.name: Looming Gale
12.description: You now create a {Tempest Totem} that casts a {Tempest} of the corresponding strike that created the totem. You are limited to 1 of each type of totem.

13.name: Rousing Symbols
13.description: Your {Tempest Totems} gain a random amount of more cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) when summoned.

14.name: Sky Opener
14.description:
You now expend {Storm Stacks} when you use Tempest Strike and hit at least one enemy with the melee attack.

{Storm Bolts} cast this way deal more damage.

15.name: Windfury Force
15.description: Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

16.name: Heorot's Arsenal
16.description: Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per equipped axe or mace and additional spell damage while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

17.name: Firm Grip
17.description:
Tempest Strike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

These effects are doubled while wielding a 2 handed weapon.

18.name: Calm Seas
18.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Wind Tempest}, but it does not remove the physical strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

19.name: Crashing Waves
19.description:
Tempest Strike deals additional melee damage per 2 Attunement.

All the melee strikes have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

20.name: Grounded Refuge
20.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Thunder Tempest}, but it does not remove the lightning strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

21.name: Gladiator of Lagon
21.description:
The melee hits grant you a stack of {Gladiator of Lagon} for 8 seconds which grants you and your minions additional spell damage.

This effect can trigger a maximum of 3 times per second.

23.name: Resurgence of the Land
23.description: You recover mana if whenever you use Tempest Strike and it hits an enemy and it doesn't cast a {Tempest}.

24.name: Warm Shelter
24.description:
Tempest Strike can no longer cast {Frigid Tempest}, but it does not remove the cold strike from the combo.

Additioanlly, Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

25.name: Ancestral Swiftness
25.description: Tempest Strike has increased attack speed and costs less mana.

26.name: Soaring Blows
26.description: Tempest Strike penetrates enemy resistances per your uncapped resistances corresponding to a specific type.

27.name: Wind Booster
27.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you and your other allies it touches gain {Haste} for a short duration.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have Haste.

28.name: Ceaseless Tyhoon
28.description:
Whenever you cast {Wind Tempest} you have a chance to also cast {Tornado}.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Tornados mana cost.

29.name: Devastating Whirlwind
29.description: {Tornados} cast from {Wind Tempest} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

30.name: Blizzard's Wrath
30.description: You have a chance to also cast {Frigid Tempest} when you attack with lightning or physical Tempest Strike.

32.name: Coldest Night
32.description:
{Frigid Tempest} chills on enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

33.name: Wrath of the Mountain
33.description: While channeling {Avalanche} you now also cast {Frigid Tempest} every second.

34.name: Fulminating Strikes
34.description:
{Thunder Tempest} shocks enemies it hits.

Additionally, Tempest Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

35.name: Cloudburst Conduit
35.description: Whenever you cast {Thunder Tempest} you also cast it around your nearest {Storm Totem}.

2.name: Temporal Entrapment
2.description: Disintegrate has a chance to slow enemies caught within the beam.

4.name: Catalyst
4.description: Flame Energy builds up more quickly.

5.name: Searing Plasma
5.description: Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Praesidium
6.description: You gain ward each second while channeling Disintegrate.

7.name: Cascade
7.description: Disintegrate deals 20% more damage per enemy killed (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers), but Disintegrate no longer pierces.

8.name: Twinbeam
8.description:
Disintegrate now has two beams, and each beam deals damage independently, so enemies caught in both take double damage.

Disintegrate costs more mana per second to channel, and each beam deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Subvention
9.description: You gain mana every time Disintegrate kills an enemy.

10.name: Stored Power
10.description: Disintegrate deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a delay before casting. This delay is reduced by increased cast speed.

11.name: Feedback
11.description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock enemies caught within the beam.

12.name: Electrify
12.description: Disintegrate’s base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

13.name: Laser Focus
13.description: Disintegrate no longer costs mana and instead grants mana every second while damaging enemies. However it also deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and applies ailments less frequently. This does not enable mana regen while channelling Disintegrate.

14.name: Hyperfocal
14.description: Disintegrate grants more mana while damaging enemies.

15.name: Paralyze
15.description: Shock inflicted by Disintegrate lasts longer and Disintegrate deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Shock on the target.

16.name: Tendrils
16.description: You have a chance each second to cast {Lightning Blast} at a nearby enemy, which expends mana equal to Lightning Blast’s mana cost.

17.name: Escalation
17.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 2 after 2 seconds of channeling. Tier 2 Disintegrate deals more damage, but costs more mana to channel.

18.name: Amplification
18.description: Disintegrate is upgraded to tier 3 after 4 seconds of channeling. Tier 3 grants double the bonuses of tier 2.

19.name: Unbridled Power
19.description: Disintegrate has a chance to shock, ignite and slow each second while at Tier 3.

20.name: Intensify
20.description: Disintegrate upgrades to the next Tier faster.

21.name: Glass Cannon
21.description: Disintegrate deals more damage while at Tier 2, but also causes you to take more damage while at tier 2 (both multiplicative with other modifiers), and are doubled at Tier 3.

22.name: Magnify
22.description: Disintegrate has a chance to ignite enemies caught within the beam.

23.name: Infernal Ray
23.description: Disintegrate’s base lightning damage is converted to fire damage, unless you have the {Electrify} node.

24.name: Inferno
24.description: You have a chance each second to cast {Fire Aura} while channeling Disintegrate.

25.name: Extension
25.description: Disintegrate has a longer range.

26.name: Lucomancer
26.description: While channeling Disintegrate you have the Lucomancy buff, which grants increased damage and reduces all mana costs, including Disintegrate's channel cost.

28.name: Galvanized Defense
28.description: You take less damage while channeling Disintegrate (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Dragon Tongue
30.description: Disintegrate gains a chance to ignite per second equal to your chance to ignite on hit.

32.name: Backfire
32.description: Flame energy builds up on enemies within the beam, causing an explosion that deals fire damage around them after 5 seconds of taking damage.

0.name: Shield Bash
0.description:
A melee directional attack that that stuns enemies for 1 second. 100% increased stun chance against non-boss enemies.

1% more damage per 1% block chance (up to 100%, multiplicative with other modifiers).

1.name: Dazed
1.description: Stuns caused by Shield Bash last longer.

2.name: Wall of Shields
2.description: If Shield Bash is used while Ring of Shields is active, the shields form a wall which increases the width of Shield Bash, based on the number of active shields.

3.name: Refreshing Smash
3.description: You are granted health when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

4.name: Splintering Blow
4.description:
If Shield Bash is used while you have a shield equipped, it fires shield fragments in a cone in front of you.

While Shield Bash is on cooldown you cannot block.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

5.name: Survival of the Fittest
5.description: You are granted health per point of Strength, when you stun an enemy with Shield Bash.

6.name: Broadened Shield
6.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a wider area.

7.name: Disarming Blows
7.description: Shield Bash now applies {Frailty} to enemies hit.

8.name: Flame Coating
8.description:
Shield Bash deals additional melee fire damage.

If Shield Bash has a cooldown, it also deals more fire damage per block chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to 100%.

9.name: Kindling
9.description:
Shield Bash causes your next melee or throwing attack to have additional ignite chance and critical strike chance. Excludes channelled skills.

This effect is significantly reduced if Shield Bash does not have a cooldown.

10.name: Incinerating Blows
10.description:
Shield Bash no longer has a guaranteed stun, but instead applies additional stacks of ignite. All stun duration modifiers from this tree are converted to affect ignite duration instead.

Shield Bash's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales w…

11.name: Protective Impact
11.description: Shield Bash grant you additional block chance and block effectiveness for a short duration after use.

12.name: Power Rush
12.description:
After you use Shield Rush or Lunge, you Shield Bash in the direction you traveled.

Shield Bash must have a cooldown, be charged and on your action bar for this effect to work.

13.name: Perfect Bulwark
13.description:
For 4 seconds after using Shield Bash, you are guaranteed to block a limited number of hits.

Only works if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

14.name: Block Out
14.description: Shield Bash now also blinds enemies hit.

15.name: Rebounding
15.description: Your next {Shield Throw} can ricochet 5 additional times, after using Shield Bash.

16.name: Hindrance
16.description: Shield Bash now also slows enemies.

17.name: Breadth
17.description: Shield Bash deals damage in a longer area.

18.name: Conjurer
18.description: Shield Bash has a chance to cause one enemy to drop a potion, if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

19.name: Impeded Movement
19.description: Slows caused by Shield Bash last longer.

20.name: Staggering Punch
20.description: Shield Bash now also knocks enemies back, if Shield Bash has a cooldown.

21.name: Double Bash
21.description: You gain an additional charge of Shield Bash, but it has a longer cooldown.

22.name: Fusillade
22.description: Using Shield Bash consumes all charges and deals significantly more damage per extra charge consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Steel Coating
23.description: Shield Bash deals additional melee physical damage.

24.name: Juggernaut
24.description: Shield Bash no longer requires a shield to use, but costs more mana.

25.name: Cutting Edge
25.description: Shield Bash reduces enemy armor and costs less mana.

26.name: Serrating Strikes
26.description: Shield Bash causes enemies to bleed, but costs more mana.

27.name: Iron Arms
27.description: Shield Bash deals increased physical damage per point of Strength, but costs more mana.

28.name: Flurry of Blows
28.description: Shield Bash no longer has a cooldown, but costs significantly more mana and no longer has a guaranteed stun or ignite.

29.name: Invigoration
29.description: If Shield Bash hits 3 or less targets it refunds mana.

30.name: Concussive Attacks
30.description: Shield Bash has an increased chance to stun and stuns it inflicts last longer.

1.name: Dread Furnace
1.description: Ghostflame has a chance to inflict damned and ignite enemies each second.

2.name: Arteries of Malice
2.description:
Ghostflames's base necrotic and fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic or fire damage.

Damned and ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second.

Ghostfla…

3.name: Phantom Transfusion
3.description:
You leech a portion of the physical damage you deal as health while channeling Ghostflame.

A portion of your global bleed chance on hit now applies as bleed chance per second for Ghostflame.

4.name: Feast of Bones
4.description:
Damaging an enemy with Ghostflame causes you to cast {Marrow Shards} towards them.

This effect can occur a maximum number of times each second.

5.name: Fuel of Anguish
5.description:
Increases the frequency of {Marrow Shards} per second from the {Feast of Bones} node.

Improves the {Marrow Shards'} base critical strike chance cast this way.

6.name: Occult Embers
6.description: Ghostflame has increased ignite and damned duration per point of Intelligence.

7.name: Flames of Misery
7.description:
A portion of your global ignite chance on hit now applies as ignite chance per second for Ghostflame.

A portion of your global damned chance on hit now applies as damned chance per second for Ghostflame.

8.name: Decrepit Mortals
8.description:
After channelling Ghostflame for a short duration, the skull releases a terrible screech, cursing all nearby enemies with {Decrepify}.

Ghost Flame gains the {Curse} tag, but its direct damage still does not scale with increased curse damage.

9.name: Horrifying Shriek
9.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node has a shorter delay before being released and a larger area.

10.name: Banshee
