10.description: The screech from the {Decrepit Mortals} node now also fears enemies and Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to feared enemies.

11.name: Atrocity
11.description: Ghostflame deals more damage, but has a higher channel cost (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Disdain
12.description: You take less damage from ignited, damned or bleeding enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

13.name: Domain of Torment
13.description: Ghostflame deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

14.name: Enfeebled Prey
14.description:
You leech a portion of the damage you deal as health against {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

Additionally, you take less damage from {Cursed} enemies while channeling Ghostflame.

15.name: Lingering Warmth
15.description:
When you stop channeling Ghostflame after having channeled for at least 1 second, you gain the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Additionally, when you stop channeling you gain ward per {Cursed} enemy.

16.name: Memorial of Flames
16.description:
After channeling for 1.1 seconds Ghostflame detaches itself, and persists for short duration without you needing to channel.

This effect ends early if you start channeling Ghostflame again.

17.name: Unending Ruin
17.description: The duration from the {Memorial of Flames} node is longer, but Ghostflame now has an upfront mana cost.

18.name: The Burning Skull
18.description: The detached Ghostflame now slowly seeks out nearby enemies.

19.name: Silver Oblation
19.description: After channeling for 1 second, Ghostflame consumes a portion of your current ward, and it deals damage in a larger area per ward consumed.

20.name: Stygian Beams
20.description:
For each 200 ward consumed by the {Silver Oblation} node you now cast a {Stygian Beam} at a nearby enemy dealing spell necrotic damage.

Enemies cannot be hit by more than 1 beam.

21.name: Spirit Kindling
21.description:
All your {Wraiths}, {Spectres}, and {Revenants} gain a stack of {Spirit Kindling} every 0.5 seconds while they are inside Ghostflame's area of effect.

Each stack of {Spirit Kindling} lasts 5 seconds, drains health per second, and grants increased movement speed, melee attack …

22.name: Fiery Desecration
22.description: Ghostflame now deals damage in a full circle around you, but it has a higher channel cost.

23.name: Spirit of Dread
23.description: You now move towards the target location while channeling Ghostflame with increased movement speed, but it has a higher channel cost.

24.name: Harrowing Path
24.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost, but you move slower while channeling Ghostflame.

25.name: Doom Surge
25.description: You move faster while channeling Ghostflame.

26.name: Domain of Agony
26.description: Ghostflame deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second you spend channeling Ghostflame.

27.name: Spectral Menace
27.description: Ghostflame has a lower channel cost and you gain a portion of your current mana as ward each second while channeling Ghostflame.

28.name: Wraith Form
28.description: You gain additional dodge rating per intelligence while channeling Ghostflame, as well as more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channeling Ghostflame.

29.name: Ethereal Blockade
29.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while channeling Ghostflame.

2.name: Piercing Heat
2.description: Fireball now pierces enemies (continue through targets it hits), but costs more mana.

3.name: Immolated Core
3.description: Fireball hits have additional fire penetration and lightning penetration.

4.name: Orb of Destruction
4.description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance.

5.name: Plasma Ball
5.description:
Half of Fireball's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this portion of its damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fireball gains a {Lightning} tag.

Fireball also gains additional critical strike multiplier.

6.name: Winged Fire
6.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and travels faster, causing it to travel farther.

7.name: Fire Spray
7.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

8.name: Skira's Gambit
8.description: Improves Fireball's base critical strike chance, but reduces its cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Arcane Divergence
9.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles that fire in a cone when cast, but costs more mana.

10.name: Igneous Force
10.description: Nodes on this tree that add crit chance instead increase stun chance by 20 times the stated value.

11.name: Embers
11.description: Fireballs fire in sequence in the same direction and can now hit the same target, but Fireball releases fewer projectiles and has less cast speed for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Dancing Fire
12.description: Fireball releases additional projectiles. These additional projectiles are NOT reduced by the extra projectiles penalty via the {Embers} node.

13.name: Conflagration
13.description: Fireball hits have a higher chance to ignite enemies.

14.name: Spreading Inferno
14.description:
Fireball hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}, an ailment which deals fire damage over time and spreads to nearby enemies.

Additionally all damage over time ailments applied by Fireball deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifier).

15.name: Wildfire
15.description: {Spreading Flames} applied by fireball has additional fire penetration

16.name: Burning Wounds
16.description: Fireball hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Adept
17.description: Fireball has increased cast speed.

18.name: Flammability
18.description: Fireball hits have a chance to reduce enemy fire resistance.

19.name: Seeker's Ash
19.description: Fireballs now seek nearby targets.

20.name: Flame Burst
20.description: Hitting the same enemy with several fireballs triggers a {Flame Burst} around them\r.

21.name: Volatile flames
21.description: Flame Burst requires fewer hits with Fireball to trigger.

22.name: Mana Sphere
22.description: Fireball deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.name: Unchained Fire
23.description: Fireball has increased cast speed and deals more damage for each extra projectile (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer fires extra projectiles.

24.name: Flamethrower
24.description: Fireball becomes a channelled ability that rapidly spews fireballs from your hand, but rapidly drains your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

25.name: Forbidden Flames
25.description: Fireballs have a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets it hits), but {Flamethrower} costs more mana per second to channel.

26.name: Eternal Fire
26.description: {Flamethrower} costs less mana per second to channel.

27.name: Magma Shell
27.description: You have additional Armor and Fire Resistance while channeling Fireball's {Flamethrower}.

28.name: Infernal Legacy
28.description: Fireballs last longer, causing them to travel further.

2.name: Rending Wires
2.description: Net's hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.name: Advanced Engineering
3.description: Net snares enemies in a larger area.

4.name: Surprise Snare
4.description: Net's hits cannot be dodged.

5.name: Tanglewire
5.description: Net's hits slows enemies.

6.name: Tangled and Prone
6.description: Netted enemies and enemies slowed by the {Tanglewire} node cannot dodge and cannot avoid critical strikes.

7.name: Leading the Hunt
7.description: Using Net grants you the {Huntress Advantage} buff for a short duration, granting you more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against slowed or immobilized enemies.

8.name: Quick Throws
8.description: While you have {Huntress Advantage} you now also have global increased throwing attack speed.

9.name: Barbed Net
9.description: Net causes enemies to take physical damage over time and caused them to bleed each second.

10.name: Voltaic Device
10.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred for Net.

Additionally, Net deals mo…

11.name: Trapper's Crescendo
11.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 100 dodge rating.

12.name: Curved Hooks
12.description: Net deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and bleeds that it inflicts last longer.

13.name: Acid Snare
13.description:
Net's base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance on hit from all sources is converted to poison chance for Net.

Net gains the {Poison} tag.

14.name: Bold Throw
14.description: You no longer flip back when using Net.

15.name: Net Trap
15.description:
Net now throws a trap that releases a net at a nearby enemy when it triggers.

You can have a maximum of 6 Net Traps active at once and they last up to 30 seconds.

16.name: Spear Trap
16.description:
Net Traps now also use {Puncture} for you when they are triggered. This will use the melee or bow version of Puncture depending on your equipped weapon.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Puncture's} mana cost.

17.name: Server of Tricks
17.description: You now throw additional Net traps with each throw, but Net costs additional mana.

18.name: Trickster Artist
18.description: When using Net you drop {Caltrops} at your starting location after jumping.

19.name: Zone of Control
19.description: {Caltrops} from all sources deal damage in a larger area.

20.name: Silvered Spikes

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

24.description: Lunge's final hit has a chance to cast {Smite} at up to 3 nearby targets based on distance traveled up to a maximum.

25.description: You are invulnerable while Lunging.

27.description: Killing an enemy with Lunge grants you {Frenzy} for a short duration.

23.description: Sigils last longer.

25.description: Sigils of Hope may now be cast on allies. Any effects from this tree will now be granted to the recipient(s) of the Sigils.

20.description:
The benefits from the {Vampiric Pool} and {Apocalypse} nodes now also trigger when you kill enemies with Profane Veil.

The limit from {Vampiric Pool} remains the same.

30.description: Profane Veil costs less mana.

24.description: You are affected by the beneficial buffs of Dread Shade's aura.

Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

11.description: When {Ice Shield} expires it explodes, freezing nearby enemies.

12.name: Deep Shield
12.description: {Ice Shield} lasts longer, but Ice Barrage has a longer cooldown.

13.name: Frost Armor
13.description: While {Ice Shield} is active, you deal more global cold damage and take less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Looming Frost
14.description:
Each ice shard released by Ice Barrage deals more damage than the previous shard (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This bonus stacks, but is reset on recasting Ice Barrage.

15.name: Sleetfire
15.description:
Ice Barrage has significantly increased fire rate, but you become {Silenced}, losing a large amount of mana and other skills costs more mana. 

You regain the lost mana from this use when Ice Barrage ends.

16.name: Eternal Winter
16.description: Ice Barrage lasts longer.

17.name: Challenge the Elements
17.description: Ice Barrage hits against bosses and rare enemies grant increased fire rate to the remaining hits. This effect stacks up to a cap.

19.name: Brightlance
19.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer seek nearby enemies.

20.name: Aura of Frost
20.description: Ice Barrage creates a {Chilling Aura} around you. The aura repeatedly applies chill to nearby enemies for a duration. This effect can apply multiple stacks of chill to the same enemy.

21.name: Biting Cold
21.description: Ice Barrage deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more critical strike chance.

22.name: Nailed Shot
22.description: Each ice shard cast by Ice Barrage has a chance to pierce all enemies (continue through enemies hit).

23.name: Hypothermia
23.description: Ice Shards that pierce enemies have a chance to inflict them with {Frostbite}.

24.name: Sublimation
24.description:
Ice Barrage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and its ice shards become larger.

Ice Barrage has a slower fire rate, and there is a longer delay between each shard being created and released.

25.name: Wintry Blast
25.description: Ice Barrage now fire 5 ice shards in a cone in front of you, but has a slower fire rate and costs more mana.

26.name: Yrun's Conquest
26.description: Ice Barrage releases ice shards in a wider cone.

27.name: Brittle Fragments
27.description: Ice Shards cast by Ice Barrage shatter and deal cold damage in a cone behind the target. This does not work on piercing projectiles.

28.name: Frozen Ballista
28.description: Ice Barrage deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown, but now only lasts 1 second and fires 3 projectiles.

29.name: Jagged Ice
29.description: Ice Barrage has more critical strike chance against frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Shattered Skin
30.description: Ice Barrage hits deal more damage to frozen targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

31.name: Ice Burst
31.description: Ice Barrage instantly fires 5 ice shards in a cone.

32.name: Arctic Storm
32.description: Ice shards released via {Ice Burst} have a higher chance to freeze enemies, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Arcing Power
2.description: Lightning Blast chains an additional time for each Lightning Blast you have directly cast recently up to a maximum.

3.name: Surging Influence
3.description: Lightning Blast chains have increased range.

4.name: Crackling Speed
4.description: Lightning Blast has increased cast speed.

5.name: Shattershock
5.description: Lightning Blast hits deal more damage to chilled or shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Closed Circuit
6.description: Lightning Blast can now chain to you or your allies, granting increased damage and critical strike chance.

7.name: Blinding Light
7.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to blind enemies.

8.name: Halo Effect
8.description: Lightning Blast has a chance to create a {Spark Nova} around the first enemy hit. Spark Nova deals spell lightning damage to all enemies in a small area.

9.name: Volatile Lightning
9.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to shock enemies.

10.name: Supercharged Floes
10.description:
Lightning Blast now has a chance to freeze and its base lightning damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from this tree is converted to chill chance.\r

11.name: Bitter Burst
11.description: Lightning Blast has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.name: Positive Protection
12.description: Lightning Blast hits grant you ward.

13.name: Insidious Conduction
13.description:
Lightning Blast is now a powerful channelled attack, hitting enemies caught within it but costs mana per second to channel and provides less ward when you hit enemies. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

This is incompatible with the {Focal Blast} node. If you have …

14.name: Effluent Defense
14.description: Casting Lightning Blast grants you ward per mana spent. This only counts the upfront mana cost, not the channelling cost if Lightning Blast is channelled.

15.name: Storm Razor
15.description: Improves Lightning Blast's base critical strike chance, and Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Chain Lightning
16.description: Lightning blast can chain additional times, but costs more mana.

17.name: Focal Blast
17.description:
Lightning Blast now deals damage to all enemies in a line, but no longer chains or forks. Lightning Blast hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time it would have chained (up to your maximum).

This node is incompatible with the {Insidious Conduc…

18.name: Convergence
18.description: Lightning Blast chains now hit the same target after a delay, but no longer chains to additional enemies. Lightning Blast chains half as many times rounded up.

19.name: Divergence
19.description: Lightning Blast hits have added lightning damage, and Lightning Blast chains can fork in addition to chain.

21.name: Lightning Attunement
21.description: When you cast Lightning Blast you have a chance to be granted {Lightning Aegis,} which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

22.name: Overcharge
22.description:
Lightning Blast has a chance to double cast, and Lightning Blast critical strikes deal more damage.

Lightning Blast cannot double cast if it is channelled or cast by another skill.

24.name: Frontloaded
24.description: Lightning Blast deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but this damage bonus is lessened each time Lightning Blast chains.

25.name: Cloud Answer
25.description: Lightning Blast hits have a chance to apply a {Spark Charge}.

26.name: Mortal Capacitor
26.description: {Spark Charges} applied by Lightning Blast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Final Spark
27.description: If Lightning Blast hits an enemy already affected by {Spark Charge} the Spark Charge explodes, dealing lightning damage to all nearby enemies.

28.name: Innate Conduit
28.description: While out of mana, Lightning Blast has no cost, but cannot chain.

30.name: Hypercharge
30.description:
When double casting, Lightning Blast instead has a chance to quadruple cast.

Lightning Blast cannot quadruple cast if it is channelled.

32.name: Countenance of Mana
32.description: Reduces Lightning Blast's channel cost if Lightning Blast cannot chain.

0.name: Ballista
0.description: Summons a ballista that fires fire arrows at nearby enemies.

2.name: Efficient Construction
2.description: Ballista costs significantly less mana, but has a shorter duration.

4.name: Bolt Rain
4.description: Ballista has a chance to shoot extra projectiles.

5.name: Armed Construction
5.description: Ballista now also explodes when it expires or is destroyed. This explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits enemies in a larger area based on your dexterity.

6.name: Light Bolts
6.description: Ballista has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Serrated Edges
7.description: Ballista has a chance to shred enemy armor.

8.name: Twinned Bolts
8.description: Ballista has a chance to fire twice in quick succession.

9.name: Shields Up
9.description: Ballista now has shields in front of it.

10.name: Flaming Shots
10.description: Ballista bolts are lit on fire dealing additional fire damage and have a chance to ignite enemies.

11.name: Rapid Fire
11.description: Ballista has increased attack speed.

12.name: Explosive Delivery
12.description: Ballista's bolts now explode on hit dealing fire damage in an area, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Frigid Barrage
13.description:
The explosion's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage. The explosion also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Ignite chance from inside this skill tree is converted to chill chance.

14.name: Practical Build
14.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a shorter duration.

15.name: Sturdy Foundation
15.description: Ballista has more health and lasts longer.

16.name: Acidulous Mixture
16.description: Ballista has a chance to slow enemies.

17.name: Tainted Ammunition
17.description:
Hitting your Ballista with {Acid Flask} gives it a chance to poison enemies and more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If {Acid Flask} damage is converted to fire, this is instead ignite chance and more fire damage.

18.name: Agile Engineering
18.description: Ballista takes less time to place and has increased attack speed based on your Dexterity.

19.name: Contaminating Shots
19.description: Your ailment modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

20.name: Quickload
20.description: Ballista gains increased attack speed with each hit.

21.name: Siege Commander
21.description: Your Ballistae gain {Frenzy} while you are standing near them.

22.name: Shared Enhancements
22.description: Your damage modifiers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

23.name: Heavy Bolts
23.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Wide Protection
24.description: Ballista shields are wider.

25.name: Elixir of Construction
25.description: Ballista deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if constructed within 4 seconds of using a potion.

26.name: Sharpened Tips
26.description: Improves Ballista's base critical strike chance.

27.name: Perfect Aim
27.description: Your critical strike chance and critical strike multipliers also apply to your Ballista, but at a reduced ratio.

28.name: Bodkin Bolts
28.description: Ballista bolts pierces enemies (continue through targets they hit).

29.name: Harpoon Shot
29.description: Every 5 seconds Ballista shoots a {Harpoon Shot}, that sticks into an enemy and pulls them towards the Ballista.

31.name: Care Package
31.description: Ballista will drop healing potions over its duration.

32.name: Tripwire
32.description: When you construct a second ballista a tripwire is created between it and the existing ballista. Enemies that cross the tripwire cause both ballistae to explode.

2.name: Icy Flow
2.description: Shatter Strike costs less mana and grants you ward when you attack with it and hit at least one enemy.

3.name: Frostbitten
3.description: Shatter Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Frostbite}.

4.name: Razor Ice
4.description: {Frostbite} inflicted by Shatter Strike has additional Cold Penetration.

5.name: Chillflame
5.description: Shatter Strike hits convert all stacks of ignite on enemies into {Frostbite}.

6.name: Absolute Zero
6.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage, but has reduced attack speed.

7.name: Cold Presence
7.description: Shatter Strike hits deal more damage to enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Shiver
8.description: Shatter Strike deals damage in a larger area and penetrates enemy cold resistance.

9.name: Cold Steel
9.description: Shatter Strike’s critical strikes deal more damage per equipped sword.

10.name: Obliteration
10.description: Shatter Strike instantly kills frozen enemies that are below a health threshold.

11.name: Winter's Boon
11.description: Shatter Strike instantly kills frozen enemies that are below a higher health threshold, proportional to how many unique skills you have used since using Shatter Strike (maximum of 4).

12.name: Arctic Blast
12.description: Enemies hit by both of Shatter Strike’s arcs are knocked back.

13.name: Rimestrike
13.description: Shatter Strike chills enemies.

14.name: Frigid Zephyr
14.description: Shatter Strike grants {Haste} for two seconds when instantly killing low health enemies.

15.name: Breadth of Cold
15.description: Shatter Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

16.name: Whiteout
16.description: Shatter Strike recasts after it finishes, but costs more mana and has reduced attack speed. You can use other skills during the recasts.

17.name: Iceblink
17.description: Shatter Strike has increased attack speed, but cannot be used if you have a wand or two-handed weapon equipped.

18.name: Lingering Chill
18.description: You deal increased cold damage and are more likely to freeze enemies if you have used Shatter Strike recently (past 4 seconds).

19.name: Ice Barrier
19.description: You are granted armor for 4 seconds after hitting a frozen enemy.

20.name: Acclimated
20.description: You are granted cold resistance for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy. If the enemy was frozen you gain twice as much resistance.

21.name: Hoarfrost
21.description: You gain ward when you attack with Shatter Strike and hit at least one Frozen enemy.

22.name: Frozen Shrapnel
22.description: Shatter Strike fires {Ice Spikes} from the edge of its area of effect.

23.name: Frigid Efficacy
23.description: {Ice Spikes} deal more damage and move faster, causing them to travel farther.

24.name: Solidify
24.description: Shatter Strike has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

25.name: Glacial Smash
25.description: Shatter Strikes hits deal more damage against frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Unrelenting Winter
26.description: Shatter Strike leaves a patch of {Frozen Ground} for 5 seconds, which chills all enemies who walk on it.

2.name: Blacksmith's Breadth
2.description: Smelter's Wrath charges up faster to reach its maximum area sooner.

3.name: Soldering Strike
3.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to ignite enemies for each second channelled.

4.name: Stinging Steel
4.description: Smelter's Wrath has additional critical strike chance for each second channelled.

5.name: Vulcanic Mastery
5.description: Smelter's Wrath is guaranteed to critically strike when fully charged.

6.name: Backdraft
6.description: When Smelter's Wrath is released, a duplicate attack is released in the opposite direction.

7.name: Heavy Strike
7.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled.

8.name: Bolster
8.description: While charging Smelter's Wrath you have more armor and endurance threshold (multiplicative with other modifiers)

9.name: Whetstone
9.description: Smelter's Wrath deals more melee damage and fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). These bonuses are increased by charging for longer.

10.name: Tempered Blows
10.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage (multiplciative with other modifiers) for each second channelled, but Smelter's Wrath charges more slowly.

11.name: Tempering Blows
11.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to ignited enemies per stack of ignite, up to a maximum of 150%.  This effect is multiplicative with other modifiers.

12.name: Furnace
12.description: Smelter's Wrath spews {Furnace} while charging, a fire spell that deals damage over time in a cone to enemies.

13.name: Bellows
13.description: {Furnace} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Forged By Fire
14.description: {Furnace} has a chance to ignite enemies each second.

15.name: Quench
15.description: {Furnace} has a chance to slow enemies each second.

16.name: Liquefy
16.description: {Furnace} has a chance to reduce enemy armor each second.

17.name: Ferrous Smash
17.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have an increased chance to stun enemies per second channelled.

18.name: Rebuff
18.description: Smelter's Wrath hits knock back enemies a set distance based on how long you have channelled.

19.name: Axe Volley
19.description: When releasing a fully charged Smelter's Wrath you also release five throwing axes in a cone in front of you, a throwing attack dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

20.name: Bury The Hatchet
20.description: {Axe Volley} hits deal more hit damage per point of Dexterity.

21.name: Brightsmith
21.description: Smelter's Wrath converts your increased attack speed to increased critical strike chance.

22.name: Valiance
22.description: Smelter's Wrath hits deal more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Final Strike
23.description: Smelter's Wrath hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). This kill threshold is doubled at maximum charge.

24.name: Forge Scale
24.description: Smelter's Wrath hits have a chance to shred enemies' armor for each second channelled.

25.name: Detonation
25.description: Smelter's Wrath now releases in a nova around you instead of a cone, but costs additional mana.

26.name: Crucible
26.description:
When fully charged, Smelter's Wrath leaves behind a {Burning Patch} for 6 seconds which ignites all enemies who stand in it each second.

Smelter's Wrath costs additional mana.

28.name: Sulphurous Sublimation
28.description: Increased Area for Area Skills stats no longer increases Smelter's Wrath's charge speed and instead grants its more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Flow
2.description: Gain a stack of {Flow} whenever you use a unique skill. Using a fourth unique skill consumes all stacks causing the skill to deal greatly increased damage. Stacks fall off after 4 seconds of not using a new unique skill.

3.name: Draining Arrows
3.description: You have increased bow attack speed and when you use a bow attack and hit at least one enemy you regain health.

4.name: Spell Breaker
4.description: You have a increased mana regen and your melee hits have a chance to inflict {Frailty}.

6.name: Swift Assassin
6.description: Your melee, throwing, and bow attacks have increased attack speed and deal additional physical damage.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: You take less damage while moving (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased dodge rating.

8.name: Agility
8.description: You have a chance to gain {Haste} for one second on hit and deal increased damage based on your increased movement speed.

9.name: Dodge and Parry
9.description: You have additional dodge rating and a chance to receieve a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

10.name: Twin Blade
10.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword or dagger in your off hand. You take more damage while dual wielding (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Lethal Cadence
12.description: Every third melee, throwing, or bow attack deals increased damage.

13.name: Poison Tipped
13.description: You have a chance to poison on hit while you have a dagger or bow equipped.

14.name: Sapping Strikes
14.description: When you use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain health and mana.

15.name: Critical Precision
15.description: You have increased critical strike chance per sword, bow, or dagger you have equipped.

16.name: Disembowel
16.description: Every third non-channelling melee, throwing, or bow attack also inflicts bleed.

17.name: Coated Blades
17.description: When you use a melee or bow attack that costs mana it consumes additional mana to deal more damage (multiplicative)

18.name: Thiefguard
18.description: You have additional health and whenever you receive a glancing blow you recover health.

21.name: Focus Fire
21.description: You have additional Dexterity and when you hit a boss or rare enemy you reduce its dodge rating for 8 seconds.

22.name: Concentration
22.description: By default you have {Concentration}, which increases your damage. If you are hit by an enemy within 4m you lose concentration for 4 seconds. Subsequent hits do not reset the cooldown.

23.name: Missile Mastery
23.description: You have increased bow and throwing attack damage and you have a chance to shred armour on hit.

24.name: Elemental Arrows
24.description: If you have a bow equipped you gain 1 {Elemental Arrow} per second while moving, up to a maximum of 3. Using a bow attack expends an Elemental Arrow to deal additional bow fire damage and bow lightning damage.

25.name: Wound Maker
25.description: You have a chance to inflict Critical Vulnerability on hit.

26.name: Prolonged Demise
26.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers). While wielding a bow you deal increased damage over time.

27.name: Storm Fletcher
27.description: If you have a bow equipped you deal increased elemental damage and gain {Elemental Arrows} more frequently.

29.name: Siege Quiver
29.description: You can hold additional {Elemental Arrows} and you have additional elemental resistance for each arrow you are currently holding.

30.name: Heightened Senses
30.description: You have a chance to avoid critical strikes and your critical strikes with bow attacks deal more damage.

32.name: Elemental Barrage
32.description: You can consume [1] additional {Elemental Arrow} with each bow attack. If you consume 3 arrows with a single attack it has 200% additional shock and ignite chance

33.name: Arrow Storm
33.description: When you use a bow attack you gain {Arrow Storm} which increases your bow attack speed for 3 seconds. You can only gain Arrow Storm once every 10 seconds.

35.name: Fire and Steel
35.description: Non-elemental bow attacks cannot consume {Elemental Arrows}, but instead generate an Elemental Arrow on use. Consuming an Elemental Arrow also increases the elemental damage of the attack that consumes them.

36.name: Covering Fire
36.description: When you proc {Arrowstorm} you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.

38.name: Poison Tipped Arrows
38.description: You have additional poison penetration and bow attacks have additional chance to poison on hit.

39.name: Sharpshooter
39.description: Chance to gain a stack of Sharpshooter when you hit an enemy based on your how far you are from that enemy, up to a maximum at 10m. Each stack of Sharpshooter increases bow damage and lasts 8 seconds.

40.name: Ethereal Arrows
40.description: You have increased mana and mana regen and your bow attacks deal increased damage equal to a portion of their mana cost.

41.name: Barrage of Pain
41.description: Adds {Barrage of Pain} to your Marksman Passive, Bow Mastery. You gain a stack and refresh all existing stacks of Bow Mastery by using a bow attack and hitting at least one enemy.

42.name: Rain of Arrows
42.description: Adds a chance to cause a {Rain of Arrows} to descend upon your target when you proc {Arrow Storm}. Rain of Arrows is a physical bow attack that hits all enemies in an area around the target.

43.name: Mana Warp
43.description: When you use a skill that costs zero mana and hit an enemy you regain mana, but bow attacks cost more mana.

44.name: Death from Afar
44.description: Each stack of Sharpshooter also increases stun chance and adds a chance to shred armour on hit

46.name: Perfect Aim
46.description: Each stack of Bow Mastery with {Barrage of Pain} also grants additional critical strike multiplier and health gained on crit.

50.name: Cloak of Shadows
50.description: You have additional dexterity and you have a chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

52.name: Once
52.description: You deal additional physical damage with melee and throwing attacks, and if you have been hit recently have additional dodge rating.

53.name: Skiasynthesis
53.description: When you create a shadow you regain health and skills used by shadows deal increased damage.

54.name: Rhythm
54.description: Generating a stack of {Flow} increases your melee and throwing attack speed for a short duration. This buff can stack.

55.name: Scarlet Stream
55.description: You deal increased physical damage and have a chance to inflict bleed on hit with melee and throwing attacks.

56.name: Shroud of Dusk
56.description: You have additional health and you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} when hit. Each stack of Dusk Shroud adds 50 dodge rating and 5% chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

57.name: Pulse
57.description: {Flow} is consumed when you use a 5th unique skill rather than a 4th, but the skill that consumes flow has much higher critical strike chance and bleed chance.

58.name: Veil of Night
58.description: You have increased melee attack speed. When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. Each stack of Dusk Shroud adds 50 dodge rating and 5% chance to receive a {Glancing Blow} when hit.

59.name: Tempo
59.description: Skills that generate or consume {Flow} deal increased melee damage and have additional melee critical strike multiplier.

60.name: Crimson Shroud
60.description: When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to gain a stack of {Crimson Shroud} for 4 seconds. Crimson Shroud grants chance to bleed on hit and less damage over time taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).

61.name: Apostacy
61.description: Your dodge chance is added as twice as much chance to receive a glancing blow, but you cannot dodge.

63.name: Blood Dance
63.description: You leech a portion of melee damage as health and your health leech is applied faster.

65.name: Weapons of Choice
65.description: You gain a bonus while dual wielding depending on your weapon combination.

66.name: Argent Veil
66.description:
When you drop below 70% health you gain stacks of {Silver Shroud}. Silver Shroud is a buff that gives you 100% chance to dodge the next hit. Dodging a hit with Silver Shroud consumes all stacks, granting you 100 ward per stack.

This node's effect has a 15 second cooldown, but…

67.name: Perfection
67.description: When you use a melee attack and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of Perfection. When you receive a hit you lose all stacks. Each stack of perfection increases your damage.

68.name: Critical Eye
68.description: You have increased critical strike chance and you have a chance to inflict {Critical Vulnerability} on hit.

69.name: Cloaked Reaper
69.description: When you kill an enemy or hit a rare or boss enemy, you regain health for each stack of any Shroud on you.

72.name: Hooked Blades
72.description: Your hits have a chance to shred armour and armour shred you apply is more effective.

73.name: All In
73.description: You have a higher critical strike multiplier, but you deal less damage with non-critical hits and damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

74.name: Shadow Master
74.description: You can have an additional shadow. Skills used by shadows deal increased damage.

78.name: Raptor's Wings
78.description:
You have a chance to gain haste for 2 seconds when you or your {Falcon} hits an enemy.

Additionally, you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you have haste.

80.name: Crimson Skies
80.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Crimson Shroud} when your {Falcon} or {Ballistas} hit an enemy.

82.name: Outlander's Tenacity
82.description: You have additional dodge rating and you gain a portion of your maximum health as endurance threshold if you have not been hit recently.

85.name: Ranger's Mark
85.description: You deal increased damage while wielding a bow and your bow hits have a chance to grant your {Falcon} additional melee damage for 4 seconds. This has no stack limit.

89.name: Sharpest Point
89.description: You deal increased damage and have an additional chance to bleed while wielding a spear.

91.name: Blast Radius
91.description: Your area skills and your minions' area skills deal damage in a larger area.

93.name: Coordinated Fade
93.description: When you use a certain ability on your bar, you gain 3 stacks of Silver Shroud. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

95.name: Deflect and Weave
95.description: You have additional block and a chance to receive a glancing blow. Additionally, you\r regain health whenever you block or recieve a glancing blow.

97.name: Intuitive Connection
97.description:
{Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} are now instant cast.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} and {Dive Bomb} have a longer cooldown.

98.name: Final Souvenir
98.description:
You have additional dodge rating and you now have a chance to drop {Caltrops} around you when you dodge and there is an enemy within 4 meters of you.

This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

102.name: Stymphalian Feathers
102.description: You have additional armor per point of Dexterity.

103.name: Expediency
103.description: Haste on you has increased effect and you gain haste for a short duration whenever you use a potion.

105.name: Tailwind
105.description:
You take less damage while moving. Additionally, you have increased movement speed and dodge rating.

These effects are doubled if your {Falcon} has hit an enemy recently.

106.name: Finesse Them
106.description:
You regain health when you or your minions crits an enemy.

You have additional critical strike avoidance.

2.name: Primal Serpent
2.description: When Serpent Strike kills an enemy or hits a rare or boss enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Primal Serpent}.

3.name: Culling Point
3.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to instantly kill enemies that are below a threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

4.name: Coldfang
4.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

5.name: Serpent Venom
5.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to inflict {Serpent Venom}, an ailment that deals poison damage over time and prevents enemies from landing critical strikes. It lasts 3 seconds and cannot stack.

6.name: Spirit Viper
6.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your Vitality, and if you have 50 Vitality you regain mana when you inflict an enemy with Serpent Venom or refresh its duration.

7.name: Poison Tipped
7.description: Serpent Strike hits have a higher chance to poison on hit and they deal more melee damage per stack of poison on the target, up to a limit.

8.name: Venemous Union
8.description:
When you lunge forwards with Serpent Strike, if you have a {Primal Scorpion} it casts its companion ability, {Venom Nova}, twice, once centred on itself, and once centred on you.

This effect has a 12 second cooldown, but ignores Venom Nova's regular cooldown and does not put …

9.name: Cobra Lunge
9.description: When you attempt to use Serpent Strike against a target that is slightly out of range you will lunge forwards before attacking.

10.name: Constrictor
10.description: You gain a stack of {Constrictor} every 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 4. When you use Serpent Strike all stacks are consumed causing the attack to deal more damage per stack (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Mussurana
11.description: Each stack of {Constrictor} also grants Serpent Strike additional poison chance and increased poison duration when consumed

12.name: Sapping Coils
12.description: You regain mana when you consume a stack of {Constrictor}.

13.name: Slither
13.description: You have more dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Serpent Strike in the last 4 seconds.

14.name: Gouging Spear
14.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

15.name: Hydra Strikes
15.description: Serpent Strike has increased attack speed.

16.name: Corrosive Venom
16.description: Serpent Strike hits have a chance to shred enemy armor and posion resistance.

17.name: Devour Prey
17.description: You regain health when Serpent Strikes kills or critically strikes an enemy.

18.name: Eye of the Viper
18.description: Serpent Strike's critical strikes deal more damage.

20.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
20.description:
Serpent Strike now has a chance to freeze and its base physical damage is converted to cold damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite chance.

21.name: Vicious Strikes
21.description: {Primal Serpents} have increased melee attack speed and are granted health when they hit enemies with a melee attack.

22.name: Iron Scales
22.description: {Primal Serpents} have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional armour

23.name: Emerald Fangs
23.description: {Primal Serpents}'s hits have an additional chance to poison enemies and inflict {frailty}.

24.name: Guardian Spear
24.description: Instead of summoning a new serpent when the {Primal Serpent} node's effect triggers, you heal your current serpent to full health and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 10 seconds. This damage buff can stack.

26.name: Biting Winds
26.description: Frosbite inflicted by Serpent Strike lasts longer and has additional cold penetration

27.name: Shroud of Winter
27.description: When you use Serpent Strike you gain additional dodge rating based on your uncapped cold resistance for four seconds. This buff can stack an unlimited number of times.

28.name: Swirling Carnage
28.description: Each active stack of {Maelstrom} grants Serpent Strike additional Chance to Bleed on Hit and more damage damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Steel Eater
29.description: Armour Shred inflicted by Serpent Strike has an increased effect based on your Dexterity.

30.name: Shattered Immunity
30.description: Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to high health enemies based on the number of poison and frostbite stacks on them.

31.name: Fast Acting Toxins
31.description:
Serpent Venom deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your melee critical strike chance.

If your melee crit chance is above 50% then Serpent Venom deals its damage twice as quickly. This does not increase the total damage it deals over its full durati…

32.name: Dread Fang
32.description: Ailments applied by Serpent Strike and {Primal Serpents} have additional poison penetration.

2.name: Blazing Flux
2.description: Flame Rush costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown. These effects are doubled if you have enough uncapped fire resistance.

3.name: Manafused Current
3.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 40 current mana.

4.name: Glyph of Intention
4.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Glyph of Dominion} at the target location instead of channeling and Flame Rush ends when reaching the Glyph.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Glyph of Dominion's} mana cost.

5.name: Magma Starter
5.description:
Flame Rush now casts {Volcanic Orb} that is attached to you and only detonates when you end Flame Rush, alongside any other active {Volcanic Orbs}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volcanic Orb's} mana cost.

6.name: Runic Eclipse
6.description:
You take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) during Flame Rush.

This effect is doubled against damage over time effects.

7.name: Celestial Guidance
7.description: All buff effects from the Flame Rush tree persist afterwards for a portion of the time equal to the duration you spent in Flame Rush.

8.name: Lunar Protection
8.description: You gain ward per second during Flame Rush and you gain a burst of ward when Flame Rush ends.

9.name: Energy Equivalence
9.description:
{Flame Rush's} base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

{Fire Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Lightning Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and eff…

10.name: Beta Decay
10.description:
Flame Rush now also casts a {Static Orb} in the opposite direction.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of {Static Orb's} mana cost.

11.name: Snowballing
11.description:
{Flame Rush's} base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

{Lightning Resistance Shred} chance from all sources is converted to {Cold Resistance Shred} for Flame Rush and eff…

13.name: Branding Cold
13.description: Flame Rush now inflicts {Brand of Subjugation} to enemies you pass through. The Brand does not stack but deals a large amount of cold damage over time and it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per your chance to chill.

14.name: Fiery Overload
14.description: You are granted the {Frenzy} buff for a short duration when you end Flame Rush.

15.name: Epilogue
15.description:
You cast {Runic Invocation} when you exit Flame Rush, if you have it on your action bar.

This effect consumes mana equal to a percentage of {Runic Invocation's} mana cost.

16.name: Guidance of Flames
16.description: Casting {Fireball} and then using Flame Rush in the same direction within 2 seconds causes that Flame Rush to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area and grants you mana on cast.

17.name: Breath of Fire
17.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with {Fireball} during Flame Rush it causes a {Runic Burst} around the target.

18.name: Smolder and Burn
18.description: Flame Rush now applies {Fire Resistance Shred} on enemies it passes through.

19.name: Fire Eater
19.description:
Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy you gain ward and consume all your ignite stacks on that enemy. 

Consuming your ignite stacks this way grants you ward per your ignite stack on them, but they don't deal their remaining damage.

20.name: Mark of the Forbidden Flame
20.description: Whenever you pass through an ignited enemy with Flame Rush, instead of gaining ward per stack of ignite on the enemy and consuming your ignite stacks without dealing damage, you lose 12 ward per stack of ignite and the ignite stacks instantly deal their remaining damage on the…

21.name: Solar Rush
21.description: You travel faster and further with Flame Rush.

22.name: Blazeborn
22.description: Flame Rush deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

23.name: Gas Powered
23.description: Whenever you pass through a {Frost Wall} during Flame Rush it causes the explosion to deal damage in a much larger area and its chance to critically hit is doubled.

24.name: Ember Wake
24.description: Every 0.4 seconds during Flame Rush you create a {Rune Ember}, up to a maximum. Every 0.25 seconds while not in Flame Rush you fire a {Rune Ember} at a nearby enemy if you have any.

25.name: Flaring Coals
25.description: {Rune Embers} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Living Embers
26.description: Casting Flame Rush creates additional {Rune Embers}.

27.name: Keen Ignition
27.description: {Rune Embers} now pierce enemies.

28.name: Signet of Ash
28.description: You now have a chance to create a {Rune Ember} on kill during Flame Rush and you create {Rune Embers} faster during Flame Rush.

2.name: Dancing Flames
2.description: Flame Reave has increased attack speed and costs less mana, but travels more slowly, reducing its range.

3.name: Rhythm of Fire
3.description: Using Flame Reave grants 4 stacks of {Rhymth of Fire}. If you already have 12 stacks, Flame Reave instead consumes all the stacks to gain greatly increased width, range, and damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Versatility
4.description:
Directly using Surge, Fireball, Mana Strike, or Firebrand also grants stacks of {Rhythm of Fire}.

These skills cannot consume stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} and you cannot exceed the number of stacks required for Flame Reave to consume stacks, which is 12 by default.

5.name: Engulfing Flames
5.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}.

Flame Reave deals more fire damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Frenzied Flame
6.description:
Flame Reave hits have a chance to grant you {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

In addition to Frenzy's base effect it now grants Flame Reave additional melee fire damage.

7.name: Naurcrist
7.description: Flame Reave hits deal additional melee fire damage per equipped sword.

8.name: Rolling Thunder
8.description:
Half of Flame Reave's base damage is converted to lightning, meaning that this half of the damage scales with increases to lightning damage but not with increases to fire damage.

Fire damage bonuses from this tree now also apply to Lightning.

Ignite chance from this tree now…

9.name: Heat Wave
9.description: Flame Reave deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

10.name: Scorched Earth
10.description: Enemies killed by Flame Reave have a chance to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

11.name: Volatile Strike
11.description: Explosions from the {Scorched Earth} node are larger and deal more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Arcane Severance
12.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it deals added melee damage based on your added spell damage.

13.name: Ember Infusion
13.description: Flame Reave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs additional mana.

14.name: Catalyst of Ash
14.description:
When you hit an enemy with Flame Reave you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards the enemy hit.

Fireballs cast this way cannot have extra projectiles.

16.name: Firewalker
16.description: You gain {Haste} when you use Flame Reave, but Flame Reave has a cooldown. Does not increase the duration of the cooldown if Flame Reave already has one.

17.name: Kindling
17.description: Flame Reave has a shorter cooldown.

18.name: Flame Caller
18.description: Flame Reave returns to you. Flame Reave's damage continues to decrease while returning, to a minimum of 20% of the initial damage.

19.name: Infernal Calling
19.description: Flame Reave pulls enemies with it while it returns to you, but now has a cooldown. Does not increase the duration of the cooldown if Flame Reave already has one.

20.name: Precise Destruction
20.description: Improves Flame Reave's base critical strike chance, but deals damage in a narrower area.

21.name: Infernal Alchemy
21.description: When you attack with Flame Reave and critically strike at least one enemy you gain ward.

22.name: Slash and Burn
22.description: Flame Reave hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

23.name: Scorching Tide
23.description: Flame Reave hits deal more melee damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Chaos Flare
24.description: Flame Reave melee hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

25.name: Rolling Flames
25.description: Flame Reave travels faster, increasing its range.

26.name: Ashen Waste
26.description: Flame Reave's critical strikes deal more damage.

27.name: Unbound Flames
27.description: Flame Reave deals damage in a larger area.

28.name: Worldfire
28.description: Flame Reave hits enemies in an expanding circle centered on you, but has less range and costs significantly more mana.

29.name: Lingering Embers
29.description:
You have a chance to cast {Fire Aura} when you use Flame Reave.

Flame Reave has additional chance to Ignite on hit per active Fire Aura.

30.name: Accelerando
30.description:
Flame Reave requires fewer stacks of {Rhythm of Fire} to consume all stacks. This does not affect the bonuses from consuming stacks.

Additionally when Flame Reave consumes {Rhythm of Fire} stacks it gains additional critical strike chance.

2.name: Rot Weaver
2.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently.

3.name: Icarian Poison
3.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but poison is applied to your self more and more frequently as time goes on.

4.name: Unending Sickness
4.description: Poison and other ailments inflicted by Aura of Decay last longer. This does not include ailments that slow.

5.name: Mana Blight
5.description: Aura of Decay applies Poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but drains mana each second.

6.name: Poisoned Soul
6.description: Aura of Decay applies poison and other ailments to enemies more frequently, but also applies poison to yourself more frequently.

7.name: Seeping Wounds
7.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

8.name: Decrepify
8.description:
Aura of Decay inflicts Armor Shred instead of Poison to you and enemies. 

Armor Shred inflicted by Aura of Decay has 100% increased effectiveness.

9.name: Corrosive Aura
9.description: Enemies affected by Aura of Decay have reduced armor.

10.name: Undertow
10.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to slow nearby enemies every second.

11.name: Putrid Bombs
11.description: While Aura of Decay is active, you leave behind a {Putrid Bomb} every 2 seconds. Putrid Bombs explode after a 2 second delay and Poison all enemies they hit.

12.name: Chill to the Bone
12.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to Chill nearby enemies every second.

13.name: Absence of Life
13.description: Allies within range are healed by Aura of Decay each second. Aura of Decay heals more health the less health you currently have.

14.name: Plague Bearers
14.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to poison on hit, but are poisoned every second.

15.name: Infectious Bones
15.description: Minions within Aura of Decay’s area of effect deal more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Loathing
16.description: While Aura of Decay is active, enemies have a chance to be {Marked for Death} when they hit you.\r

17.name: Feast of Souls
17.description: While Aura of Decay is active, you have a chance to cast {Soul Feast} when you are hit.

18.name: Growing Hunger
18.description: Your chance to cast {Soul Feast} when hit increases each time you fail to cast Soul Feast.

19.name: Poison Skin
19.description: Enemies are inflicted with multiple stacks of Poison when they hit you, but you also gain poison stacks when hit.

20.name: Inoculation
20.description: You take less poison damage while Aura of Decay is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Vulnerability
21.description: Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less Poison Resistance.

22.name: Fume Weaver
22.description: You and Enemies within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have less poison resistance for each point of intelligence you have.

23.name: Poison Bolt
23.description: Aura of Decay fires a {Poison Bolt} that inflicts two stacks of poison on hit at the nearest enemy every 3 seconds.

24.name: Poison Barrage
24.description: Aura of Decay fires {Poison Bolts} more frequently.

25.name: Corruption
25.description: Enemies that die within Aura of Decay’s area of effect have a chance to emit a {Poison Nova}, which poisons all enemies it hits. This effect has a 5 second cooldown by default.

26.name: Death Bloom
26.description: {Poison Nova} has a shorter cooldown.

27.name: Bubonic Aura
27.description: Aura of Decay has a chance to inflict nearby enemies with {Plague} each second.

28.name: Plague Rat
28.description: Aura of Decay affects a larger area.

29.name: Aura of Terror
29.description: Nearby enemies have a chance to be feared when you activate Aura of Decay.

30.name: Respite
30.description: You have additional posion resistance while in Aura of Decay and you have increased health regeneration if you have deactivated Aura of Decay recently (past 4 seconds).

31.name: Incipient Decay
31.description: When you activate Aura of Decay, you create a {Poison Nova} around yourself that poisons all enemies it hits. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

1.name: Reinforcement
1.description: You summon additional shields.

2.name: Healing Shields
2.description: Every 6 seconds each Shield heals nearby allies.

3.name: Phalanx
3.description: When Shields heal allies, they also increase their armor for 4 seconds. This effect does not stack.

4.name: Sturdy Shields
4.description: When Shields heal allies, they also grant them a non stacking increased block effectiveness buff for 4 seconds.

5.name: On the Path
5.description: While using {Warpath}, your Shields spin faster and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Aegis of Life
6.description: Shields have increased healing effectiveness.

7.name: Tempered Steel
7.description: Ring of Shields costs less mana, but Shields have reduced health.

8.name: Martyr Shields
8.description: You are healed any time one of your Shields dies.

9.name: Collateral Damage
9.description: Shields shatter into {Shrapnel} when they die, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies.

10.name: Heavy Shrapnel
10.description: {Shrapnel} created by your dying Shields has a signficantly increased chance to stun enemies.

11.name: Defensive Shields
11.description: You have additional chance to block and a higher block effectiveness if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

12.name: Iron Form
12.description: You are invulnerable for 1 second after casting Ring of Shields, but you cannot move or use abilities.

13.name: Rush Wall
13.description: While using {Shield Rush}, your Shields form a wall in front of you, increasing the area you hit.

14.name: Heavy Burden
14.description: Shields have a chance to slow enemies that hit them.

15.name: Pulsing Shields
15.description: Shields push enemies away from you every 4 seconds.

16.name: Banding
16.description: Shields have increased health and additional physical resistance.

17.name: Enduring Defense
17.description: Ring of Shields lasts longer.

18.name: Coating
18.description: Consuming a potion also heals your Shields.

19.name: Shield Spike
19.description: Shields reflect a percentage of damage taken to attackers.

20.name: Molten Shields
20.description:
Shields take less fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and have a chance to ignite enemies that hit them. 

If you have the {Collateral Damage} node the base physical damage of the {Shrapnel} it creates is converted to fire damage.

21.name: Immolation
21.description: Shields now deal fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

22.name: Fire Spin
22.description: Shields deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and shields rotate faster.

23.name: Touched by Fire
23.description: You deal additional fire damage with spells and attacks if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

24.name: Bastion
24.description: Shields rotate around you at a greater distance.

26.name: Amass
26.description: Ring of Shields summons additional Shields, but costs more mana.

27.name: Displacement
27.description: Ring of Shields is cast at your target location instead, but Shields no longer follow you. Shields have more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and last much longer.

28.name: Wreathed in Flame
28.description: You deal increased melee fire damage if you have cast Ring of Shields recently (last 4 seconds).

2.name: Champion
2.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

3.name: Bound Weapon
3.description: When Rive kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy, you have a chance to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

4.name: Laceration
4.description:
Rive's third strike {lacerates} enemies on it.

Lacerated enemies take melee damage over time for 3 seconds, with base damage equal to 100% of your added melee damage. Laceration does not stack.

5.name: Temporal Warrior
5.description: Rive deals more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and your chance to {Echo} with Rive is doubled.

6.name: Weapon Specialist
6.description:
Rive deals additional melee physical damage per point of Dexterity if you are using a Sword.

Rive deals additional melee void damage per point of Vitality if you are using an Axe.

Rive deals additional melee fire damage per point of Attunement if you are using a Mace.

7.name: Azure Crescendo
7.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restores mana if it hits at least one target.

8.name: Ripples of Oblivion
8.description: Rive deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect is tripled for {Echoes}.

9.name: Sever
9.description: Rive's first strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

10.name: Twisting Fangs
10.description: Rive's second strike has a chance to ignite enemies.

11.name: Flame Drinker's Blade
11.description: Rive's third strike consumes all stacks of ignite you applied to enemies it hits, granting you a buff that grants physical penetration per stack consumed. You can have multiple instances of this buff at once.

12.name: Assassin's Sustenance
12.description: When you trigger {Flame Drinker's Blade's} effect you also gain an additional buff that causes you to leech a percentage of the damage you deal as health. Unlike the buff from Flame Drinker's Blade, this buff cannot stack.

13.name: Savagery
13.description: Rive hits deal more damage to ignited targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Scrap Metal
14.description: Whenever you would summon a {Forged Weapon} from any source, you instead gain a stack of Scrap Metal. Each stack grants more armour and more damage with Rive (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Flurry
15.description: Rive's first and second strike have increased attack speed.

16.name: Concentration
16.description: Improves Rive's base critical strike chance. This bonus is doubled for Rive's third strike.

17.name: Adrenaline
17.description: Rive's first strike grants you increased critical strike chance on hit for 4 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.

18.name: Focused Strike
18.description: Rive's third strike always crits, but strikes one and two can no longer critically strike.

19.name: Rending
19.description: Rive's first and second strike have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

20.name: Indomitable
20.description: If you are at high health and have positive mana, Rive's first strike releases a wave of energy that passes through enemies.

21.name: Cadence
21.description: Changes Rive's sequence of strikes to {1, 2, 1, 2, 3.}

22.name: Triple Threat
22.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and hits in a larger area, and has increased chance to stun enemies.

23.name: Double Slash
23.description: Rive skips its third strike.

24.name: Foe Cleaver
24.description: If you are using a two handed weapon, stats on that weapon that directly add damage, increase damage or add a chance to apply an ailment on hit, have double effect for Rive.

26.name: Iron Reach
26.description: Rive's second strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

27.name: Challenge
27.description: If you have positive mana, Rive's second strike pulls enemies, but costs more mana.

28.name: Outburst
28.description: Rive's third strike deals damage in a larger area.

29.name: Reclamation
29.description: Rive's third strike leeches damage dealt as health.

30.name: Brutality
30.description: Rive's third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

31.name: Massacre
31.description: Rive's third strike has a chance to detonate enemies it kills, dealing fire damage to nearby enemies.

32.name: Coup de Grace
32.description: Rive's third strike instantly kills enemies below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

3.name: Mania of Mortality
3.description: Whenever a nearby enemy, ally, or minion dies, you have a 10% chance to gain ward.

5.name: Ethereal Revenant
5.description: When damage leaves you below half health, you summon a {Revenant,} a melee minion with decaying health whose damage scales with your intelligence . This effect has a 15 second cooldown.

6.name: Blood Pact
6.description: You deal increased damage, but you lose a percent of your maximum health each second if you have killed an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

8.name: Putrid Demise
8.description: You have additional poison resistance, and whenever you kill an enemy you have a chance to inflict poison on the enemies around them.

10.name: Elixir of Hunger
10.description: You have additional health, and when you use a potion you and your minions are imbued with {Hunger,} granting 10% increased attack and cast speed and 10 health gained on hit.

13.name: Life Drinker
13.description: Whenever you use a potion you also consume a random minion, killing it to restore health. The health gained in this manner is equal to a percentage of the minion's current health.

15.name: Reclamation of Souls
15.description: You have increased ward retention, and are granted ward whenever one of your minions die.

17.name: Wisp Weaver
17.description: Whenever you use a minion skill, you have a chance to gain ward equal to the mana spent.

18.name: Soul Drinker
18.description: You are granted a percentage of excess healing from {Life Drinker} as ward, up to a maximum.

19.name: Mark of Punishment
19.description:
Whenever one of your minions die, it has a chance to mark the nearest enemy for death for 5 seconds.

{Mark for Death} is a curse that lasts for 8 seconds and reduces all resistances by 25%. It cannot stack.

20.name: Dark Retribution
20.description:
Whenever one of your minions dies, you have a chance to summon a {Skeleton Vanguard} from its corpse, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 active skeleton vanguards.
This node also grants additional melee physical damage to Skeleton Van…

22.name: Hollow Lich
22.description: All sources of health leech are converted to increased damage at 10 times their value.

24.name: Cling To Life
24.description: Grants you Vitality and grants your minions all resistances.

29.name: Dance with Death
29.description: You deal increased damage. This bonus is tripled when you are below 35% health.

31.name: Harvested Legions
31.description:
Whenever you kill an enemy you have a chance to summon a {Skeleton Vanguard} from its corpse, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 active skeleton vanguards.
This node also grants increased health to Skeleton Vanguards summoned from any…

33.name: Soul Barrier
33.description: When you drop below half health, you are granted ward. This effect has a 12 second cooldown.

35.name: Reaper
35.description: Your spells and melee attacks instantly kill enemies that they leave below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

36.name: Life Barrier
36.description: {Soul Barrier} grants additional ward equal to your vitality.

43.name: Volatile Blood
43.description: Effects that drain a percentage of your health per second drain reduced health, and when you are stunned you have a chance to release a {Wave of Blood,} dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

44.name: Symbol of Decay
44.description: You deal increased damage over time if you are equipped with a one handed weapon and do not have a shield equipped.

45.name: Elixir of Death
45.description: When you use a potion you take less physical and necrotic damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers), but a percent of your current health is drained each second.

47.name: Wands of the Fallen
47.description: You deal increased spell damage if you are equipped with a one handed weapon and do not have a shield equipped.

52.name: Chaos Flames
52.description:
You deal increased fire damage and have a chance to ignite on hit with fire skills, and you deal increased necrotic damage and have a chance to inflict damned on hit with necrotic skills.

These effects also apply to your minions.

55.name: Dark Rituals
55.description: Your minions have increased attack and cast speed. This bonus also applies to you if you have used a minion skill in the last 10 seconds.

56.name: Crimson Gluttony
56.description: You and your minions have increased health regeneration, and effects that drain a percentage of your health drain less health.

64.name: Empty The Graves
64.description: You have increased health regeneration and additional armor for each minion you control.

69.name: Contagion Engine
69.description: You deal increased damage over time if you have killed an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

74.name: Effigies
74.description:
When you take a hit while at low health you have a chance to consume one of your minions, stealing its current health to heal yourself.

Your minions deal increased fire and bow damage.

75.name: Aegisfall
75.description: Your minions have a chance to shred armour on hit

76.name: Moonlight Pyre
76.description: Your minions deal additional fire and necrotic damage with spells and attacks.

77.name: Veins of Malice
77.description: Whenever you cast a spell, you sacrifice 5% of your current health to grant your minions {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a duration. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

80.name: Soul Aegis
80.description: Your minions have additional armor per character level.

82.name: Eye of Damnation
82.description: You and your minions deal increased necrotic damage and you have a chance to apply Damned on hit.

83.name: Dominion of Rot
83.description: You deal increased poison damage and your minions have a chance to poison on hit.

84.name: Veins of Power
84.description: You and your minions deal increased physical damage and have increased bleed duration

89.name: Ward of Malevolence
89.description:
You gain additional ward decay threshold and you gain ward on kill. 

You also gain ward per 2 points of Intelligence while channeling a skill.

92.name: Doom Herald
92.description: You take less damage while channeling and deal more damage to damned enemies while channeling (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

93.name: Spirit Leech
93.description: A portion of the damage you do is returned to you as health over 3 seconds.

94.name: Rancid Concoction
94.description: You gain ward and mana when you use a potion.

100.name: Encroaching Darkness
100.description: When you directly cast a {Curse} skill you also afflict a number of enemies around the target location with {Anguish}.

102.name: Chaotic Strikes
102.description:
Your hits have a chance to deal double damage.

Additionally your hits have a chance to deal double damage per {Curse} on the target.

104.name: Grasping Damnation
104.description: The Chains from the {Chains of Ruin} node last longer. Additionally damned that you inflict last longer.

106.name: Fleeting Crone
106.description:
You have a chance to gain {Haste} for 2 seconds when you kill a {Cursed} enemy or hit a {Cursed} boss or rare enemy.

Additionally {Haste} on you has increased effect.

110.name: Grimhilde's Domain
110.description:
{Witchfire} that you inflict deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per global chance to ignite with fire skills and per global chance to inflict damned with necrotic skills.

Additionally while you have {Ignite} or {Damned Overload} your hits spread {Witchfir…

111.name: Aspect of Death
111.description: You have increased health and you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of each negative ailment on you up to a maximum of 90.

1.name: Biting Limit
1.description: Frost Wall has a chance to inflict a stack of Frostbite to enemies inside the wall every 0.25 seconds.

2.name: Lightning Rod
2.description:
One of Frost Wall's {Pillars} now casts {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies when you first pass through the wall.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

3.name: Charged Pylons
3.description:
Frost Wall's outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} at nearby enemies every other second.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Lightning Blast's} mana cost.

4.name: Amplified Currents
4.description: After Frost Wall has existed for a short duration, its outer {Pillars} cast {Lightning Blast} more often, up to a maximum, every time an enemy passes through the wall.

5.name: Aspirant's Arrival
5.description:
After you pass through your Frost Wall your next direct {Runic Invocation} or {Glyph of Dominion} cast within 5 seconds is empowered. 

An empowered spell cast this way, costs less mana (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it also deals more damage (multiplicative with ot…

6.name: Purifying Gate
6.description: Frost Wall now cleanses negative ailments on you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

7.name: Arch of Rimefrost
7.description: Frost Wall deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

8.name: Crystals of Protection
8.description:
Frost Wall now grants you and your allies ward and mana when they first pass through the wall.

These effects are doubled if the wall is placed at least 2 meters away from you.

9.name: Boosted Kickoff
9.description:
Frost Wall now grants the {Haste} and {Frenzy} buffs for a short duration, up to a maximum, when you and your allies when they first pass through the wall.

The maximum duration is equal to Frost Wall's age plus 1 second.

10.name: Runic Conclusion
10.description: Frost Wall now creates three {Runic Detonations} shortly after you pass through it, dealing spell cold damage to nearby enemies.

11.name: Shattered to Pieces
11.description: The {Runic Detonations} from {Runic Conclusion} intensify, destroying the wall in the process and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

12.name: Glyph of Direfrost
12.description: The {Runic Detonations} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area if you are facing away from the wall when the detonations occur.

13.name: Prepared Wards
13.description:
You now cast Flame Ward on you or your allies (excluding their minions) that pass through your Frost Wall, if it has existed for at least 0.2 seconds.

Frost Wall now has a cooldown, which it shares with Flame Ward. Using one will put the other on cooldown.

14.name: Heaping Cold
14.description: If you haven't cast Frost Wall in the past 15 seconds, it has no mana cost and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Marching Winter
15.description: Frost Wall is larger and lasts longer.

16.name: Chilled Touch
16.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to chilled enemies while you have an active Frost Wall.

17.name: The Dark Cold
17.description:
Frost Wall deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the wall has existed.

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

18.name: Howling Rift
18.description: When you cast Frost Wall while having an existing wall active with more than half its duration remaining, the existing wall is moved to the new target location instead of being replaced and you gain mana equal to half the Frost Wall’s mana cost.

19.name: Frigid Domination
19.description: Frost Wall deals additional spell damage equal to a portion of your freeze rate multiplier.

20.name: Frozen Throne
20.description:
Frost Wall's initial freeze has increased duration, and the wall deals more damage over time to frozen enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This does not affect ailments or subskills.

21.name: Protection of the Apostate
