21.description: You are granted ward whenever enemies pass through the wall for the first time.

22.name: Shelter of the Chef
22.description: Whenever an enemy passes through the wall for the first time, and after it has existed for 0.2 seconds, you gain ward equal to a small portion of the enemy's maximum health, up to a maximum amount of ward per enemy.

23.name: Pyroglass
23.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Ignite}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is converted to…

24.name: Brand the Invaders
24.description:
Frost Wall now inflicts Brand of Trespass to enemies inside the wall. This Brand does not stack, but deals a large amount of fire damage over time.

Brand of Trespass deals more damage equal to your ignite chance.

25.name: Flames Unchained
25.description:
Whenever an enemy passes through your Frost Wall, you have a chance to cast {Fireball} towards them.

This effect consumes mana equal to {Fireball's} mana cost.

26.name: Crackling Barrier
26.description:
{Frost Wall's} base cold damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

For Frost Wall, chill chance from all sources is converted to {Slow}, and Frostbite chance from all sources is conv…

27.name: Wall of Glyptic Art
27.description:
Frost Wall now casts {Runebolt} in the original target direction the Wall was cast. The element of the bolts match the element of the Wall, regardless of {Runebolt's} tree.

This effect consumes 2 mana per projectile and does not cast if you are at negative mana.

28.name: Arcane Mosaic
28.description: Frost Wall casts {Runebolt} more often.

2.name: Iridescent Plumage
2.description: Your Raptor has additional elemental resistance and have additional dodge chance.

3.name: Screech
3.description: Your Raptor gains the ability to {Screech} at enemies, shredding their physical resistance. Screech has a 10 second cooldown.

4.name: Earsplitting Roar
4.description: {Screech} has increased cooldown recovery speed and causes enemies it hits to {Bleed}.

7.name: Brilliant Display
7.description: Your Raptor automatically reduces the cooldown of your other companions' activatable abilities by 3 seconds. This effect has an 8 second cooldown.

8.name: Razor Wings
8.description: Your Raptor deals additional melee physical damage.

9.name: Thrill of the Hunt
9.description: When your Raptor kills an enemy, it gains {Haste} for 4 seconds.

10.name: Adaptation
10.description: If your Raptor has 10 kills in this zone it evolves, gaining 15% more size and damage while you remain in the zone (damage multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Taste for Flesh
11.description: Your Raptor gains more damage for 10 seconds when it kills an enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect can stack.

12.name: Scent of Blood
12.description: Your Raptor deals more damage to bleeding targets (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: In for the Kill
13.description: Your Raptor gains more melee damage for each nearby bleeding enemy (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Ravage
14.description: Raptor deals more critical strike damage and has a higher chance to critically strike against bleeding targets (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Tear Flesh
15.description: Your Raptor's melee attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

16.name: Sharp Claws
16.description: Your Raptor deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Acidic Bile
17.description: Your Raptor gains the ability to cast {Poison Spit,} blinding the enemy and applying stacks of poison. 8 second cooldown.

18.name: Infected Wounds
18.description: Whenever your Raptor hits a bleeding enemy with a melee attack, its next melee attack has additional slow chance based on the number of bleed stacks on that enemy.

19.name: Dripping Blood
19.description: When you Raptor hits an enemy, bleeds on that enemy have a 25% chance to double in speed.

20.name: Cornered
20.description: Your Raptor deals more damage for each percent of its missing health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Broken Tooth
21.description: Your Raptor has increased melee attack speed, but has a 10% chance to lose 10% of its current health on melee attack.

22.name: Vicious Rampage
22.description: Your Raptor gains increased effect from {Rampage.}

23.name: Predator
23.description: Your Raptor has increased chance to critically strike.

24.name: Vexation
24.description: {Rampage} lasts longer.

25.name: Eager
25.description: {Rampage} costs less mana.

26.name: Challenger
26.description: Your Raptor uses {Rampage} if it encounters a rare or boss minion, if it is able to.

27.name: Primal Rage
27.description: {Rampage} fears enemies when it is activated.

28.name: Menacing Aura
28.description: While your Raptor is {Rampaging,} enemies within 5 meters of it have a chance to be slowed each second.

1.name: Dawnfall
1.description: You have a chance to gain {Dusk Shroud} when you use Umbral Blades and hit at least one enemy.

2.name: Sword Thrower
2.description: You now throw just one large Umbral Blade with each throw that deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased radius.

3.name: Cacophony of Steel
3.description:
Blades in the ground now create a {Bladestorm} that hovers and spins in midair at the target location for 4 seconds, hitting nearby enemies 3 times per second.

You can have up to 3 active Bladestorms, but each enemy can only take damage from one at a time.

4.name: Steel Torrent
4.description: {Bladestorms} last longer and deal damage in a larger area.

5.name: Loathing
5.description: {Bladestorms} slowly seek out enemies.

6.name: Lethal Darkness
6.description: Umbral Blades hits inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} on hit, while using a dagger.

7.name: Edge of Obscurity
7.description:
Umbral Blades deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Dusk Shroud} on you. 

This effect is doubled while inside the area of {Smoke Bomb}.

8.name: Umbral Remnant
8.description: Whenever one of your {Shadows} expire they now also leave behind an Umbral Blade.

10.name: Soul Thief
10.description: Umbral Blades has increased attack speed and you gain ward on hit with recalled blades.

11.name: Stabbing Blast
11.description: Recalling the blades now sends each blade toward a different nearby enemy instead of to you, but recalled blades no longer pierce.

12.name: Shredding Daggers
12.description: Recalled blades now have a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies it hits).

13.name: Nightmare Dash
13.description:
You can now only recall blades by using {Shift}, rather than the combo itself.

You regain mana for each blade recalled.

14.name: Backstab
14.description: Recalled blades deal more damage, but blades thrown out deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Slice the Legs
15.description: Recalled blade hits have a chance to slow enemies and a chance to cause them to bleed.

16.name: Bloody Trail
16.description: Recalled blade hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target and per bleed on the target, up to a maximum.

17.name: Cut and Leave
17.description:
Umbral Blades hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

When your blades are recalled you have a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second.

18.name: Emerald Cutlass
18.description:
Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Umbral Blades and effects related to bleed now depend on poison instead. 

If you have the {Explosive Blades}, the explosion hit poisons enemies, but deals 80% less damage and it no longer deals any fire damage.

19.name: Kunai Belt
19.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the second throw.

20.name: Hidden Blades
20.description: Every 2 seconds you throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the next throw.

21.name: Jagged Carvings
21.description: Umbral Blades deals additional throwing physical damage.

22.name: Twilight Assault
22.description: You now throw a third time with Umbral Blades with 4 blades before recalling the blades.

23.name: Duskhunter
23.description: You now throw additional blades with Umbral Blades on the third throw.

24.name: Subzero Intrusion
24.description:
Umbral Blades base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies.

Swaps Umbral Blades' {Physical} tag for a {Cold} tag.

25.name: Coldsnap Strike
25.description: Umbral Blades hits have additional freeze rate and have a chance to chill enemies.

26.name: Precision Cuts
26.description: Umbral Blades now stop if they reach the target location, and you have increased attack speed with Umbral Blades.

27.name: Explosive Blades
27.description: Blades in the ground now arm after 0.5 seconds, but can no longer be recalled and Umbral Blades has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers). If enemies walk over them the blades will cause a {Shard Explosion}, a subskill dealing physical and fire damage in an a…

28.name: Burst of Agony
28.description: The {Shard Explosion} deals damage in a larger area and deals more damage per second the blade has remained on the ground (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

1.name: Marking Strikes
1.description: Your Falcon's other hits now have a chance to inflict {Falconer's Mark}.

2.name: Falconer's Mark
2.description: Whenever the Falcon hits an enemy with {Falcon Strikes} it {Marks} them. Your next hit against a {Marked} target deals more damage and consumes the {Mark}.

4.name: Avian Arsenal
4.description:
When you consume a {Falconer's Mark} your Falcon gains additional melee damage equal to a portion of your added melee damage, throwing damage, bow damage, or spell damage depending on the type of ability used to consume the mark.

This effect lasts 10 seconds and it can stack …

5.name: Toxic Airdrop
5.description:
Your Falcon now throws {Acid Flasks} for you. {Acid Flasks} thrown by the Falcon scale with your stats and your {Acid Flask} tree, but can apply {Falcon's Mark} from {Marking Strikes}.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Acid Flask's} mana cost and has a 6 s…

6.name: Flask Satchel
6.description: Your Falcon has additional {Acid Flask} charges.

7.name: Parrotkin
7.description: When you directly use {Acid Flask} your Falcon has a chance to gain additional {Acid Flask} charges.

8.name: Falconer's Journey
8.description: Your Falcon deals more global damage per character level and per point of Dexterity (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Is it a bird?
9.description:
Your Falcon deals more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

This effect is tripled for {Falcon Strikes}.

10.name: Watchful Eye
10.description: Your Falcon now more heavily prioritizes enemies close to you during combat.

11.name: Sidekick
11.description: Your Falcon now heavily prioritizes enemies close to the target location of your most recent melee, throwing or bow attack.

12.name: Agile Prey
12.description:
Your Falcon deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is tripled against moving targets.

13.name: Dark Plumage
13.description: When your Falcon hits an enemy it has a chance to drop a {Black Arrow} at its location.

14.name: Rending Talons
14.description: A portion of your your chance to bleed, poison, shred armor, shred resistances, and slow on hit now also apply to your Falcon's hits.

15.name: Feather Knives
15.description:
Your Falcon now uses {Feather Knives} at nearby enemies. This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

Your Falcon also throws a single Feather Knife whenever you consume {Falconer's Mark}.

16.name: Sky Chaser
16.description: A portion of your global throwing attack speed now applies to the Falcon's {Feather Knives} ability as increased cooldown recovery speed.

17.name: Trained to Hunt
17.description: A portion of the highest of your global increased melee damage, increased throwing damage, and increased bow damage now apply to all your Falcon's damage.

18.name: Go For the Eyes!
18.description: A portion of the highest of your global melee crit chance, throwing crit chance, and bow crit chance now apply to your Falcon.

19.name: Exposed Weakness
19.description:
When you use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and critically strike at least one enemy, your Falcon gains a portion of your global melee, throwing, or bow critical strike multiplier respectively for 10 seconds.

This effect can occur at most twice every two second.

20.name: Side by Side
20.description: When you directly use a melee, throwing, or bow attack and hit at least one enemy, you reduce a portion of {Falconer Strike's} remaining cooldown.

21.name: Falcon Screech
21.description: After the first hit of {Falcon Strike} your Falcon lets out a {Screech} which slows and applies {Frailty} to enemies around it.

22.name: Frightful Feathers
22.description:
Your Falcon's {Screech} now also fears enemies it hits.

Additionally, your Falcon moves to you when a hit leaves you at low health, and this effect will interrupt any skill it is currently using.

This effect can occur at most every 10 seconds.

23.name: Avian Stamina
23.description: {Falcon Strikes} hits addtional times and your {Falcon} has increased melee attack speed.

24.name: Bird of Prey
24.description:
{Falcon Strikes} instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.name: Razor Wings
25.description: {Falcon Strikes} now cause your Falcon to swoop down in a line in front of you attacking all enemies in that line rather than hitting enemies individually.

26.name: Wingspan
26.description:
A portion of your global increased area for area skills now applies to the width of {Falcon Strikes}.

Additionally, {Falcon Strikes} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have directly used an area skill in the past 8 seconds.

27.name: The Blood Dance
27.description:
If {Falcon Strikes} kills an enemy it will hit an additional time.

Additionally, when {Falcon Strikes} hits a boss or rare enemy it has a chance to hit an additional time.

28.name: Hunter's Spoils
28.description: When your Falcon kills an enemy or hits a boss or rare enemy it restores health and mana to you based on your total attributes.

29.name: Wake of Wings
29.description:
When you consume {Falconer's Mark} you gain the {Falcon's Wake} buff for a short duration. 

This buff grants you increased movement speed, attack and cast speed.

30.name: Falcon's Gale
30.description: Consuming a {Falconer's Mark} instantly recovers {Falcon Strike's} cooldown, but it now also costs additional mana.

2.name: Infusion
2.description:
Flame Ward grants increased fire damage while active

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this damage increase is also converted.

3.name: Retribution
3.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Telepyrosis
4.description: Flame Ward's retaliation is centered on the enemy that hits you, but it hits in a smaller area.

5.name: Blast Field
5.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits in a larger area.

6.name: Frost Ward
6.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, granting it a freeze rate, and converts any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to cold and grants it a Freeze Rate.

7.name: Frostguard
7.description: Flame Ward grants armor while active.

8.name: Glacial Reinforcement
8.description: Flame Ward grants additional block chance, block effectiveness, and ward on block while active.

9.name: Rimeskin
9.description: Flame Ward's retaliation hits have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

10.name: Lightning Ward
10.description:
Flame Ward is converted to Lightning, unless it has been converted to cold. This converts the base damage of the retaliation, and any fire damage modifiers from nodes on this tree.

This also globally converts {Fire Aura} to lightning, unless it has been converted to cold.

11.name: Dilation
11.description: Flame Ward costs less mana. Flame Ward and Fire Aura last longer.

12.name: Fire Aura
12.description: While active, Flame Ward grants you {Fire Aura}, a spell that deals fire damage over time to surrounding enemies.

13.name: Eye of Flame
13.description: {Fire Aura} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This also effects Fire Aura from sources other than Flame Ward.

14.name: Energize
14.description: Flame Ward grants ward over time while active.

15.name: Recollection
15.description: Flame Ward grants increased ward retention while active.

16.name: Through Flames
16.description:
Flame Ward grants additional fire damage to attacks and spells while active.

If Flame Ward is converted to cold or lightning, then this added damage is also converted.

17.name: Stalwart Defense
17.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward.

18.name: Barrier
18.description: You take less damage from hits while Flame Ward is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Prismatic Buffer
19.description: Flame Ward reduces elemental damage taken while active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Selfless Sorcery
20.description:
Flame Ward can be cast on allies.

This has no effect if you have taken the {Mental Aegis} node.

21.name: Shrewd Shielding
21.description: Flame Ward costs less mana.

22.name: Mental Aegis
22.description: Mana now absorbs damage while Flame Ward is active. Each point of mana shields 5 health.

23.name: Warmth
23.description: Flame Ward grants increased mana regeneration while active.

25.name: Concentrated Shielding
25.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward, but has a shorter duration.

27.name: Fortification
27.description: Flame Ward grants significantly more ward, but no longer retaliates.

28.name: Desperate Defense
28.description: Flame Ward grants additional ward equal to a percentage of your missing health.

29.name: Fuel The Flames
29.description: Flame Ward grants more ward, but has a longer cooldown.

30.name: Dual Aegis
30.description: Flame Ward can store an additional charge, allowing you to use it twice before it goes on cooldown.

31.name: Astonish
31.description: Flame Ward is cast when you are stunned, if it is off cooldown and you have positive mana.

33.name: Flame Runner
33.description: You have {Haste} while Flame Ward is active.

34.name: Warden Pulse
34.description: Enemies around you are knocked back when you use Flame Ward

2.name: Lasting Storm
2.description: Tornado lasts longer.

3.name: Strength of Air
3.description: Tornado has increased pull strength.

4.name: Hurricane
4.description: When you use Tornado, you have a chance to create an additional Tornado, but Tornadoes have reduced pull strength.

5.name: Charged Storm
5.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} at a nearby enemy every 2 seconds.

6.name: Frequent Lightning
6.description: Tornado casts {Storm Bolt} more frequently.

7.name: Debris
7.description: Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

8.name: Fire Tornado
8.description:
Tornados' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Tornado deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Druidic Control
9.description: Tornado is now stationary, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Eye of the Storm
10.description: Tornado deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and attach to you wherever you move, but you can no longer cast additional Tornadoes at once.

11.name: Overcast Skies
11.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from further away.

12.name: Churning Orbs
12.description: Tornado now create a {Storm Orb} every second, but Tornado has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Trail of Storms
13.description: Tornadoes cast {Storm Orbs} more frequently.

14.name: Igniting Swirl
14.description: Tornado ignites nearby enemies every 2 seconds.

15.name: Inferno
15.description: Tornado ignites nearby enemies more frequently.

16.name: Stormbringer
16.description: Tornado has an increased cast speed.

17.name: Aspect of the Storm
17.description: Casting Tornado grants {Aspect of the Storm} for 2 seconds, which grants 10% increased movespeed.

8.description: Void Cleave deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in an increased area.

10.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.

11.description: Void Cleave hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} and Void Cleave has increased critical strike chance.

12.name: Champion of the Void
12.description: Void Cleave critical strikes deal more damage and you gain mana with Void Cleave critical strikes.

13.name: Obliterator
13.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next {Erasing Strike} is always a critical strike.

14.name: Crushing Echo
14.description:
Void Cleave deals additional melee void damage. 

This effect is tripled for echoed Void Cleaves.

15.name: Abolisher
15.description: Void Cleave deals significantly more melee void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on low health.

16.name: Ruining Sweep
16.description: Void Cleave hits slow enemies, have increased stun chance and increased stun duration.

17.description: Void Cleave has a shorter cooldown.

18.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy void resistance.

19.description:
You cast {Abyssal Echoes} after using Void Cleave.

20.description: Void Cleave hits inflict enemies with {Time Rot}.

21.name: Ravager
21.description: When you use Void Cleave you gain {Ravaging Aura} for a short duration scaling with the amount of enemies hit up to 10.

22.description: {Ravaging Aura} deals additional spell void damage and has an increased area of effect.

23.description: {Ravaging Aura} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

24.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack inflicts enemies with {Time Rot}.

25.name: Entropic Blows
25.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Time Rot} on the target.

26.description: Void Cleave hits shred enemy armor and {Armor Shred} applied by Void Cleave has increased effect and duration.

27.description: If Void Cleave hits at least one enemy your next throwing attack deals additional void damage.

28.name: Nether Charge
28.description: You can store an additional charge of Void Cleave, but Void Cleave costs more mana.

29.description: Void Cleave deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

30.name: Blazing Steel
30.description: Your increases to physical damage also apply to fire damage for Void Cleave.

32.description: You can travel much further with Void Cleave (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it has a longer cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

2.description:
Smite causes a {Fissure} underneath the target, dealing fire damage to enemies who stand on it.

{Fissure} costs 10 mana, last 3 seconds and has a 0.5 second cooldown.

3.description: {Fissure} deals damage in a larger area.

4.description: {Fissure} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.description: {Fissures} last longer, but Smite costs more mana.

7.description: You appear at Smite's targeted location, dealing physical damage to surrounding enemies. Smite costs more mana, has a cooldown, and counts as a {Traversal} skill.

8.description: Smite hits knock enemies back.

9.name: Holy Wave
9.description: Smite heals in a larger area.

10.description: You deal additional melee fire damage if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

11.description: You have increased attack and cast speed if you have hit an enemy with Smite recently (last 4 seconds).

12.name: Panacea
12.description: Being healed by Smite has a chance to cleanse all negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, from you and allies.

13.name: Desperate Measures
13.description: When you are out of mana Smite is free, but cannot heal, cleanse, or create {Fissures}.

14.name: Soothing Balm
14.description: Being healed by Smite grants you or your allies increased health and mana regeneration for 4 seconds (does not stack).

15.name: Pillars of Light
15.description: When you directly cast smite, you have a chance to double cast. The additional cast does not incur a mana cost and cannot teleport you if you have the Descend node.

16.name: Holy Fire
16.description: Smite hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

17.description: Smite hits deal more damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Smite hits have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames}

19.description: Enemies killed by Smite have a chance to explode, dealing fire damage to nearby enemies.

24.description: {Lightning Bolts} created by Smite hit additional enemies.

26.description: Smite critical strikes deal more damage.

27.name: Grace
27.description: Smite heals allies for more health.

28.description: The {Sacrifice} node costs less health.

30.description: Smite deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Smite consumes a percent of your current health on cast.

31.name: Piety
31.description: Smite has a chance to {Electrify} on hit.

4.description: All physical damage dealt to your Sabertooth is converted to cold damage. Consequently it is reduced by cold resistance, but not by physical resistance.

12.description: Your Sabertooth has increased attack speed.

13.description: Your Sabertooth has increased melee attack speed and has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but your Sabertooth takes more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.description: Your Sabertooth gains the ability to cast {Frost Nova,} a cold spell that hits all nearby enemies and has a freeze rate of 30. Frost Nova has a 10 second cooldown.

19.description:
Your sabertooth retaliates with {Ice Vortex} when it takes 70 or more damage.

23.description: When your sabertooth leaps it uses {Flurry Swipes} when it lands.

24.description: Your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} inflict Bleed on hit and if you or your Sabertoth are below half health it always crits.

25.description: When your sabertooth leaps you gain {Haste} for a duration

26.description: Your Sabertooth deals more damage (mutliplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Chill} on the target.

11.description: While spinning, you leave behind a burning trail that ignites enemies each second. If ignite has been converted to {Time Rot} with {Apoclypse Whirl} this trail inflicts Time Rot instead.

12.description: Warpath deals damage in a larger area.

16.description: While spinning, you have additional spell damage.

17.description: While spinning, you and your allies are healed each second within Warpath's area of effect. The amount of health gained is increased by healing effectiveness.

18.description:

This consumes Smite's mana cost.

19.description: Warpath hits deal more melee fire damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and ignite it inflicts has additional Fire Penetration

20.description: For each second you continuously spin, Warpath deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but costs more mana per second.

22.description: Warpath deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.description: While spinning, you have additional melee leech while wielding an axe, additional base crit chance while wielding a sword, additional physical penetration while wielding a mace and additional fire penetration while wielding a sceptre.

27.description: Warpath costs significantly less mana per second, but you have reduced elemental resistance while spinning.

28.description: Warpath hits shred enemy armor.

Soul Feast consumes poison stacks you applied on the target, granting you more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) and additional poison resistance per stack.

This buff lasts 6 seconds and can stack an unlimited number of times.

Poison stacks applied by minions or ot…

11.description: {Soul Fragments} grant additional ward based on your intelligence.

12.description:
Soul Feast's base necrotic damage is converted to physical damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

13.description:
Soul Feast has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

Physical ailments inflicted by Soul Feast deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your missing health.

14.description: Soul Feast has a chance to cast {Blood Tether} on enemies it hits.

15.description: When you kill an enemy with Soul Feast it has a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} around the target.

17.description: When you kill a damned enemy with Soul Feast, you have a chance to grant your minions {Frenzy} for 3 seconds.

18.description: If the number of cursed enemies within 15 meters is at or below a threshold shortly after you cast Soul Feast, then a number of enemies within that range are {Marked for Death} to reach that threshold of cursed enemies.

21.description: {Soul Fragments} from rare or boss enemies also grant you mana. Modifiers to the amount of ward granted by Soul Fragments also apply to the amount of mana gained from this node.

When you hit a poisoned enemy with Soul Feast it spreads all stacks of your stacks of poison from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

23.description: Soul Feast costs less mana and has a chance based on your current mana to draw back {Greater Soul Fragments}, which grant more ward (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.description: When Soul Feast hits an enemy {Cursed} with {Spirit Plague}, {Decrepify}, {Marked for Death}, or {Penance} it spreads those {Cursed} from that enemy to a number of other enemies within 5 metres.

25.description: {Soul Fragments} return to you faster and Soul Feast has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 4 seconds.

26.description: Soul Feast can hit more targets.

27.description: Soul Feast inflicts {Withering} on hit, an ailment which increases the curse damage taken.

28.description:
Poison Chance from all sources is converted to armor shred for Soul Feast and armor shred applied by Soul Feast has increased effect.

6.description: Puncture deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged.

12.description: {Bleeding Fury} can have more maximum stacks.

19.description: When used with a melee weapon Puncture has increased range.
