29.name: Low Blow
29.description: {Unseen Strike} slows enemies it hits.

30.name: Consumed by Shadow
30.description:
{Unseen Strike} instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

32.name: Braskula's Hesitation
32.description: You deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) with your next damaging non-channelled skill after Shifting, but travel a shorter distance with Shift.

2.name: Resolute Stance
2.description: Focus grants increased health regeneration while channeled.

3.name: Desperate Meditation
3.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled proportional to the percentage of mana you are missing when you start channeling.

4.name: Null Profusion
4.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

5.name: Null Infusion
5.description: Casting Focus while at negative mana instantly grants mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

6.name: Calm Mind
6.description: The mana gained from the Null Profusion and Null Infusion nodes is also gained as ward, but Focus has a longer cooldown.

7.name: Mana Flooded
7.description: Focus grants increased mana regeneration while channeled.

8.name: Shocking Aura
8.description: Focus grants a chance to shock nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from shocked enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Nerve Center
9.description: Shocks, chills and ignites inflicted by Focus have a longer duration.

10.name: Burning Aura
10.description: Focus grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Iron Stance
11.description: Focus heightens your armour while channelling (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you additional armour based on your intelligence.

12.name: Chilling Aura
12.description: Focus grants a chance to chill nearby enemies each second while channeled and causes you to take less damage from chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Prismatic Stance
13.description: Focus grants less elemental damage taken while channeled (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Inner Growth
14.description: Focus heals the target each second while channeled.

15.name: Mind's Eye
15.description: Focus has increased healing effectiveness per point of intelligence.

16.name: Overcharge
16.description: Focus can increase your current mana to a percentage above your maximum mana. The excess decays at a rate of 10 mana per second after you stop channeling.

17.name: Prism Barrier
17.description: Focus grants additional resistance while channeled.

18.name: Friendly Focus
18.description: Focus can be cast on allies.

19.name: Everward
19.description: Focus grants additional ward retention while channeled.

20.name: Energy Battery
20.description: When you finish channeling, you unleash a wave of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of the mana you gained while channeling.

21.name: Energy Infusion
21.description: You gain Haste for 1 second per 20 mana you gained while channeling once you finish channeling. Maximum of 10 seconds.

22.name: Mind's Shield
22.description: You gain ward equal to a percentage of the mana you gained once you finish channeling.

23.name: Energy Overflow
23.description: You unleash waves of lightning with base damage equal to a percentage of your maximum mana to nearby enemies each second while channeling.

24.name: Rapid Overflow
24.description: {Energy Overflow} is cast more frequently.

25.name: Unstable Energy
25.description: The waves of lightning released by the Energy Overflow and Energy Battery nodes deal more damage while you are at full mana (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Mind Shell
26.description: Focus grants additional ward per second while channeled.

27.name: Revelation
27.description: The burst of ward and mana after channelling for exactly one second grants additional ward and mana.

28.name: Unbound Thought
28.description:
Focus no longer has a cooldown, but the burst no longer grants mana.

This node has no effect if you have either the {Null Profusion} node or the {Conveyance} node.

30.name: Conveyance
30.description:
You teleport to the target location when you start channelling Focus, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Focus now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

1.name: Stalwart
1.description: You have a higher chance to block hits and take less damage from hits that you block.

2.name: Armour Clad
2.description: Adds armour and reduces the damage you take from nearby enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers)

3.name: Aegis of Renewal
3.description: You have a 25% chance to gain health whenever you block.

5.name: Overwhelm
5.description: Adds physical damage to your melee attacks and increases their chance to stun.

6.name: Gladiator
6.description: You can dual wield melee weapons by equipping a sword in your off hand. You take more damage while dual wielding (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Axe Thrower
7.description: Whenever you hit an enemy you have a chance to throw an {Axe} at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage to all enemies in its path. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.

10.name: Devouring Blade
10.description: You deal increased damage if you have killed an enemy recently (last 4 seconds).

12.name: World Eater
12.description: You leech a portion of your melee and void damage as health.

14.name: Patient Doom
14.description:
Every 3 seconds, your next melee attack deals increased damage.

Excludes movement abilities.

16.name: Dark Maw
16.description: Whenever you kill an enemy, you have a chance to absorb 5% of its health.

17.name: Renouncement
17.description: You have additional Vitality and Smite now gains spell void damage per point of Vitality, but no longer gains increased damage per point of Attunement.

18.name: Finality
18.description:
Your melee hits deal increased void damage and instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used.

19.name: Future Strike
19.description: Whenever you hit an enemy you have a chance to inflict a {Future Strike,} an ailment that lasts 2 seconds then deals 60 void damage all at once at the end of its duration. Future Strike counts as damage over time, not as a hit.

20.name: Undending Hunger
20.description: {Dark Maw} absorbs more health when it triggers.

24.name: Void Aegis
24.description: You have a chance to be granted {Void Aegis} whenever you are hit, granting you 10% reduced damage taken. Void Aegis breaks after you take 100 damage, releasing a void rift dealing damage to nearby enemies.

25.name: Essence of the End
25.description:
You have a chance to gain a {Void Essence} on kill.

Void Essences last 7 seconds and grant 15% increased void damage, 15% increased melee damage, and 10% reduced duration of stuns on you.

You can have a maximum of 3 Void Essences at once.

27.name: Steel Aegis
27.description: You have a higher chance to block hits and take less damage from hits that you block.

28.name: Battle Hardened
28.description: If you have been hit recently you have higher physical resistance and increased armour.

29.name: Rallying Block
29.description: You have additional armor for each hit you have blocked recently (last 4 seconds).

35.name: Shield Crafter
35.description: You have a chance to cast {Ring of Shields} when you block a hit and your minions have increased health and armour.

36.name: Crushing Blows
36.description: You have increased mana regen and your melee and throwing attacks deal increased damage based on their mana cost.

37.name: Smelter's Might
37.description: You and your minions have a chance to inflict bleeding and ignite on hit. This bonus is doubled for you if you are using a two handed melee weapon.

38.name: Infinite Bulwark
38.description: You have increased armor and chance to find potions if you have used a potion recently (last 4 seconds).

39.name: Hammer and Anvil
39.description: Normally you are in {Anvil Stance}, where you take less damage, but deal less damage. If you use a throwing attack you enter {Hammer Stance} for 4 seconds. In Hammer Stance you deal more damage, but take more damage.

40.name: Echoing Strikes
40.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

41.name: Flawless Defender
41.description: While you are using a shield you have additional block chance and armour.

42.name: Iron Reflexes
42.description: You have additional dexterity and your dodge rating is converted to armour. This conversion occurs after modifiers such as increased dodge rating and increased armour are applied.

47.name: Walls of Solarum
47.description: While you are using a shield you have additional elemental resistance and deal increased fire damage over time.

48.name: Osprixbane
48.description: You take less fire damage on block (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you deal increased damage if you have blocked recently (past 4 seconds)

50.name: Counter Attack
50.description: When you are hit you have a chance to counter attack enemies with {Retribution,} a melee physical attack that deals damage to nearby enemies. This effect has a 0.2 second cooldown.

52.name: Shield Breaker
52.description: Your throwing attacks cost more mana, but shred physical and fire resistance.

53.name: Fresh from the Forge
53.description:
Every 3 seconds, your next melee attack deals additional physical and fire damage.

Every 3 seconds, your next throwing attack deals additional physical and fire damage.

Excludes movement abilities.

54.name: Void Well
54.description:
While you have 3 or more {Void Essences,} if you drop below 0 mana, you consume 1 void essence to set your mana to 30% of your maximum mana pool.

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

55.name: Banish
55.description: {Retribution} deals increased damage and has additional chance to critically strike.

56.name: Void Corruption
56.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage for each passive point you have invested in the Void Knight tree.

57.name: Rot Ripples
57.description: {Time Rot} you inflict lasts longer and whenever you kill an enemy afflicted with Time Rot, nearby enemies have a chance to be inflicted with Time Rot.

58.name: Temporal Corruption
58.description:
Your spells and attacks deal additional void damage and Smite's base damage is converted to void.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to slow chance for Smite, and effects from Smite's tree that depend on ignite depend on slow instead.

Smite can no longer provide hea…

59.name: Null Velocity
59.description:
Whenever you use an ability that reduces your mana below 0, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

60.name: Rot Grip
60.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot.}

63.name: Woe
63.description: You deal increased melee damage, and you have increased armor and void damage if you have killed an enemy with a melee attack recently (last 4 seconds).

64.name: Void Flux
64.description:
Whenever damage reduces your health below 20%, you send all nearby enemies forward in time for 4 seconds.

This effect has a 30 second cooldown.

Bosses are only sent forward by a millisecond and do not visually disappear.

67.name: Liquid Iron
67.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have additional physical resistance. These bonuses are doubled if you have used a potion recently.

68.name: Molded by the Forge
68.description: Your melee attacks gain a bonus depending on the type of weapon you are wielding.

72.name: Honour
72.description: You are less likely to be stunned, you have a higher chance to block hits and you take less damage from hits that you block.

73.name: Rahyeh's Strength
73.description: You have additional strength, and you deal increased fire damage if you have hit an enemy with a melee attack recently (last 4 seconds).

74.name: Divine Bolt
74.description: Whenever you hit an enemy with a melee attack you have a 20% chance to cast {Divine Bolt,} a blast of holy energy that deals fire damage to a random nearby enemy.

75.name: Prayer
75.description: You have increased damage and healing effectiveness if you have healed yourself or an ally recently (last 4 seconds).

76.name: Holy Symbol
76.description:
When you block you cast {Holy Symbol,} healing yourself.

This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

78.name: Holy Nova
78.description: {Holy Symbol} also heals allies in an area around you.

79.name: Time Legion
79.description:
You have increased melee attack speed and your melee attacks have a chance to inflict enemies with {Time Rot.}

Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a higher chance to be echoed 1 second later.

80.name: Shared Divinity
80.description: {Divine Bolt} fires extra projectiles, but has a reduced chance to cast on hit.

81.name: Penance
81.description: Your melee and throwing attacks have a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but you have a chance to bleed when an enemy hits you with a melee attack.

82.name: Piety
82.description: {Divine Bolt} can also target nearby allies, healing them for the amount of base fire damage it would deal.

84.name: Phoenix Strike
84.description: Your melee attacks have a chance to ignite on hit

86.name: Holy Precision
86.description: You have an increased chance to critically strike with spells and throwing attacks. You also have additional critical strike multiplier with lightning skills.

87.name: Redemption
87.description: Bleed you inflict penetrates physical resistance, and you have a chance to be granted increased damage if you have received a stack of bleeding from {Penance} recently (last 4 seconds).

88.name: Righteous Firebrand
88.description: You deal additional fire damage with melee attacks if you have cast a spell recently (last 4 seconds).

89.name: Shield Wall
89.description: You have a higher chance to block and you regain heath on block, but you cannot dodge.

91.name: Prayer Aegis
91.description: You have additional health and endurance threshold and gain haste for 2 second on heal while you are below your endurance threshold. This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

92.name: Sword of Rahyeh
92.description: Your melee attacks have an additional chance to ignite enemies if you have directly casted a spell recently (last 4 seconds).

94.name: Blinding Light
94.description: Your hits have a chance to blind enemies and you have higher endurance.

95.name: Divine Intervention
95.description: While you have 3 or more {Divine Essences,} if you would die, you have a 10% chance to instead consume all Divine Essences and be returned to life at full health.

96.name: Divine Essence
96.description:
You have a chance to be granted a {Divine Essence} when you heal yourself or an ally.

Divine Essences last 10 seconds and grant 10% increased armor and healing effectiveness. They also reduce the duration of stuns on you by 10%.

You can have a maximum of 3 Divine Essences at…

97.name: Alignment
97.description: Every 3 seconds, the next spell you cast has increased healing effectiveness.

100.name: Folded Steel
100.description:
Your manifest armour and {Forged Weapons} deal additional physical damage with their melee attacks.

You can also control an additional {Forged Weapon}.

102.name: Avatar of Regret
102.description: Your melee attacks, throwing attacks, and void spells have a much higher chance to echo, but you have reduced melee attack speed and throwing attack speed and your skills cost more mana.

106.name: Time and Faith
106.description: You regain health and mana when you directly use Rive, Vengeance, Smite, or Multistrike.

107.name: Mail Crusher
107.description: You deal increased damage while you have a mace or sceptre equipped.

108.name: Blademaster
108.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while you have a sword or axe equipped.

110.name: Siege Captain
110.description: While you have a shield equipped your blocks are more effective and you deal additional physical damage with throwing attacks.

111.name: Champion of the Forge
111.description: You deal increased melee damage if you're using a two handed weapon.

112.name: Avatar of War
112.description: You deal increased melee damage for each hit you have taken in the past 10 seconds.

114.name: Heavenfire
114.description: You have additional spell damage while you have a shield equipped.

2.name: Fragile Crust
2.description:
Chthonic Fissure costs less mana and it refunds some of its mana cost if there is a cursed player, rare enemy or boss within 20 meters when you cast it.

This effect also works if you are Cursed.

3.name: Fell Fire
3.description: {Tormenting} an ignited enemy spreads all of your ignite stacks from it to a number of other enemies around it.

4.name: Stygian Current
4.description: The Fissure releases {Spirits} more frequently.

5.name: Of Gloom and Flames
5.description: Chthonic Fissure now creates a secondary Fissure in the opposite direction that casts its own {Spirits}. Enemies can take damage from both Fissures if they stand on both, but Chthonic Fissure costs significantly more mana.

6.name: Chaotic Rupture
6.description:
{Spirits} now have a chance to be replaced by a cast of {Chaos Bolts} that consumes a portion of its mana cost and scales with your {Chaos Bolts} tree.

{Chaos Bolts} cast this way have a chance to have no additional projectiles.

7.name: Spirit Gale
7.description: When {Tormented} enemies die they have a chance to release the {Spirit} to inflict and {Torment} another enemy within 8 meters.

8.name: Severed Wards
8.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy necrotic resistance.

9.name: Singed by Terror
9.description: The {Spirits'} hits shred enemy fire resistance.

10.name: Return Below
10.description: When {Spirits} {Torment} an enemy afflicted by an {Infernal Shade} they consume the Shade, causing it to instantly deal its remaining damage and increases all existing Chthonic Fissures' frequency of releasing {Spirits} up to a maximum.

11.name: Damned Waters
11.description: The {Spirits'} hits inflict enemies with {Damned}.

12.name: Grim Tide
12.description: Chthonic Fissure and ailments it inflicts deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% Added Critical Strike Multiplier.

13.name: Twisted Waves
13.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 2% uncapped necrotic resistance.

14.name: Eradication
14.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to rare enemies and bosses.

This effect is doubled if the enemy or you are cursed.

15.name: Beacon of Torment
15.description:
{Spirits} now target you instead of enemies, and whenever you are {Tormented} or {Torment's} duration on you is refreshed, you gain additional spell damage and Endurance Threshold.

This buff can stack and has the same duration as {Torment}, but persists if {Torment} is cleansed.

16.name: Grasp of the Undying
16.description: The Fissure deals more direct damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it does.

17.name: The Sunderer's Domain
17.description:
You can now have additional Fissures active at a time, but {Spirits} are released less frequently.

If a Fissure is placed over an existing one, the new Fissure closes after 1 second.

18.name: Deepest Ravine
18.description: Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but it no longer releases {Spirits}.

19.name: Rekindled Graves
19.description:
Fissures now cast {Volatile Zombies} every 2 seconds, but consumes mana equal to a portion of {Volatile Zombies} mana cost.

{Volatile Zombie} cast this way has a chance to not create multiple {Zombies} if it would otherwise.

20.name: Death from Below
20.description:
Chthonic Fissure deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

This effect is doubled if you are cursed.

21.name: Pyrochasm
21.description: The Fissure's initial impact now hits enemies dealing spell fire damage, with added damage applying at 300% effectiveness for this hit.

22.name: Fissure of Wrath
22.description:
The Fissure's initial hit now deals additional spell damage with a higher chance to stun per 2% ignite chance.

This effects scales with bleed or poison if the Fissure is converted to physical or poison respectively.

23.name: Forbidden Chasm
23.description: The Fissure's initial hit now Curse enemies with {Acid Skin}, which causes them to take poison damage over time and a chance to be critically struck by any hit.

24.name: Acidbane
24.description:
Your hits against enemies cursed by {Acid Skin} have additional base critical strike chance per 10% of your global increased poison damage.

This bonus critical strike chance is not affected by other critical strike chance modifiers.

25.name: Ash Cloud
25.description: The Fissure's initial impact now spreads all of your ignite stacks from the target to nearby enemies up to a maximum.

26.name: Chthonic Passage
26.description:
When directly casting Chthonic Fissure you now travel along the Fissure as it opens, but this adds a cooldown to Chthonic Fissure.

Chthonic Fissure gains the {Traversal} tag.

27.name: Mantle of Flames
27.description:
The Fissure gains a percentage of your global chance to ignite on hit as ignite chance per second. 

Additionally, the Fissure has a base chance to ignite enemies each second.

28.name: Blood Gulch
28.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources are converted to bleed chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fissures…

29.name: Chronicles of Ruin
29.description: {Torment} lasts longer and any ignite, poison and bleed inflicted by Chthonic Fissure also last longer.

30.name: Tombgorger
30.description: {Torment} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to ignited, poisoned or bleeding enemies.

31.name: Valley of Defilement
31.description:
Chthonic Fissure's base fire damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Ignite chance from all sources is converted to poison chance per second for the Fissure.

Swaps Chthonic Fi…

0.name: Firebrand
0.description: A melee attack which grants you a stack of firebrand buff if it hits an enemy. Firebrand buff increases the size of subsequent firebrand attacks and adds melee fire damage.

1.name: Searing Brand
1.description: Firebrand deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)

2.name: Charring
2.description: Firebrand deals more melee damage per stack of Firebrand (multiplicative with other modifiers), but costs more mana.

3.name: Triple Strike
3.description: Firebrand now shoots three lines instead of one in a cone in front of you, but costs more mana.

4.name: Hypothermia
4.description: Using {Shatter Strike} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Frostbite} Chance per stack consumed.

5.name: Kindling
5.description: Firebrand has increased melee critical strike chance per stack of Firebrand.

6.name: Inflame
6.description: Firebrand has additional melee critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

7.name: Incineration
7.description: Your next melee attack, that is not Firebrand, consumes all stacks of Firebrand and deals more damage per stack consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Illuminating Fire
8.description: Consuming stacks of Firebrand with {Incineration} grants bonus critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier per stack.

9.name: Wildfire
9.description: Firebrand can have more maximum stacks.

10.name: Insulation
10.description: Firebrand grants additional armor and fire resistance per stack of Firebrand.

11.name: Galvanize
11.description:
Firebrands's base fire damage and added melee fire damage from stacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to shock chance and effects rel…

12.name: Mana Shell
12.description: Gain ward per stack of Firebrand when you hit at least 1 enemy with {Mana Strike}.

13.name: Electrostatic
13.description: Gain stacks of {Static} if Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

14.name: Pyroshielding
14.description: You gain ward when Firebrand hits at least one enemy.

15.name: Warding Flames
15.description: You gain ward per second per stack of Firebrand.

16.name: Undying Fire
16.description: Stacks of Firebrand last longer.

17.name: Everflames
17.description: You refresh the duration of all stacks of Firebrand when gaining a new stack.

18.name: Ardent Branding
18.description:
Firebrand can have more maximum stacks, but no longer scales with attack speed. 

Firebrand can still gain attack speed from the {Fulmination} node.

19.name: Fulmination
19.description: Firebrand attacks faster per stack of Firebrand, up to a maximum.

20.name: Brand of Arcanus
20.description: Stacks of Firebrand add spell damage rather than melee fire damage.

21.name: Arcane Sharpshooter
21.description: Firebrand grants global spell critical strike multiplier per stack of Firebrand.

22.name: Pyre
22.description: If Firebrand hits at least one enemy, it consumes 10 mana to cast {Flame Wave}, a spell that deals fire damage in a line.

23.name: Flare
23.description: Firebrand has a chance to ignite enemies.

24.name: Inferno
24.description:
Firebrand has a chance to inflict {Spreading Flames} when hitting an ignited enemy.

Stacks of Firebrand also grant more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against enemies afflicted by Spreading Flames.

25.name: Crossfire
25.description: Each stack of Firebrand grants you global Ignite Chance.

26.name: Exothermic
26.description: Using {Flame Reave} consumes stacks of Firebrand to gain {Ignite} Chance per stack consumed.

27.name: Conflagrate
27.description: You gain an additional stack of Firebrand when attacking, but Firebrand costs more mana.

28.name: Fading Flame
28.description: You gain ward when a stack of Firebrand expires or is consumed.

0.name: Volatile Zombie
0.description: Summons a Volatile Zombie which shambles towards an enemy and explodes.

1.name: Leap Attack
1.description: Zombies now leap towards their targets, up to a maximum distance.

2.name: Fervor
2.description: Zombies deal more damage and have more movement speed (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Grave Attunement
3.description: Zombies deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the Zombies' health decays slower, but they also move slower.

4.name: Giant Zombie
4.description: You now summon a single large zombie with more health, that deals more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

6.name: Corrosive Guts
6.description: {Vomit} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

7.name: Bone Pact
7.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Marrow Shards} from the Zombie towards a nearby enemy.

Marrow Shards does not cost health when cast this way.

8.name: Repulsive Vomit
8.description: Zombies will now {Vomit} on enemies before exploding, dealing physical and poison damage over time. Zombies lose 33% of their maximum health per second while vomiting.

9.name: Corpse Bane
9.description: The explosion applies {Mark for Death} to enemies hit, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

10.name: Dreadful Horde
10.description: You summon additional Zombies per cast, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana and has additional cooldown duration.

11.name: Wretched Innards
11.description: {Vomit} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Army of Rot
12.description: The explosion has a chance to poison enemies.

14.name: Path of Destruction
14.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

15.name: Shepherd of Thralls
15.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area and when a Zombie dies it creates a {Skeleton Vanguard}, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

16.name: Putridity
16.description: {Vomit} has a chance to poison enemies each second.

17.name: Vile Force
17.description: When a Zombie dies it creates {Corpse Parasites} for 4 seconds, but Volatile Zombie costs more mana.

18.name: Rite of the Grave
18.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area, but Zombies no longer move.

19.name: Grand Sacrifice
19.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Sacrifice} on another nearby minion.

Sacrifice cast this way costs less mana.

20.name: Forceful Commander
20.description: You summon Zombies faster and Volatile Zombie costs less mana.

21.name: Necromantic Fervor
21.description:
You are healed for a portion of the Zombies' maximum health when they explode. 

The amount healed is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

22.name: Flammable Vitae
22.description:
The explosion's base physical damage and {Vomit}'s base physical and poison damage are converted to fire. Consequently their damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical or poison damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to ignite chan…

23.name: Horrific Vessels
23.description: The explosion's base physical and fire damage and {Vomit}'s base physical damage are converted to necrotic. Consequently their damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical or fire damage.

24.name: Pull of the Grave
24.description:
Zombies instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

25.name: Army of Nightmares
25.description: The explosion now fears enemies for a short duration.

26.name: Effigy of Combustion
26.description:
When a Zombie dies you have a chance to cast {Infernal Shade} on an enemy near the zombie.

Infernal Shade cast this way costs less mana.

27.name: Ferocious Horde
27.description: Zombies have increased movement speed per point of missing health, but their health decays faster.

28.name: Ravenous
28.description: The explosion's hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bosses and rare enemies.

29.name: Daunting Blast
29.description: The explosion has an increased chance to stun enemies.

31.name: Awakening Presence
31.description: When a minion dies you have a chance to cast Volatile Zombie at its location, expending its mana cost.

32.name: Vital Ward
32.description: {Necromantic Fervor} now grants ward rather than health. The amount of ward gained is not affected by increased healing effectiveness.

0.name: Lethal Mirage
0.description: A circular attack that's also used by your shadow clones. Requires dual wielding.

2.name: Maj'elkan Blade
2.description: Lethal Mirage deals additional melee physical damage per equipped sword or dagger.

3.name: Wounding Ambush
3.description: Lethal Mirage penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.name: Shocking Grasp
4.description:
Lethal Mirage deals additional melee lightning damage and its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Physical penetration from this tree is converted to lightnin…

6.name: Illusory Edge
6.description: Lethal Mirage has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and bleed inflicted by Lethal Mirage has additional Physical Penetration.

7.name: Sundering Blows
7.description: Lethal Mirage hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

8.name: Rive
8.description: Lethal Mirage has more critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of stack of bleed on the target.

9.name: Rending Darkness
9.description: Lethal Mirage can now also hit allies granting them the {Mirage Form} buff for 4 seconds, granting bleed chance and additional dodge rating.

10.name: Gloomy Friendship
10.description: Lethal Mirage now targets allies rather than enemies.

11.name: Phantasmal Presence
11.description: When Lethal Mirage ends you gain {Mirage Form} for 1 second per critical strike landed. This can stack up to 6 seconds.

12.name: Consuming Darkness
12.description: You gain health and mana per kill with Lethal Mirage.

14.name: Unending Mirage
14.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

15.name: Gloom and Doom
15.description: Mirages have a chance to leave behind a {Shadow}.

17.name: Blur
17.description: Mirages are created faster, causing Lethal Mirage to have a shorter duration.

18.name: Synchronize
18.description: Reduce Lethal Mirage's cooldown per enemy killed by Lethal Mirage up to a maximum.

19.name: Ravaging Mirage
19.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and leeches a portion of the melee damage dealt as health.

20.name: Shadow Eater
20.description: Lethal Mirage consumes all active {Shadows} gaining additional Mirages per {Shadow} consumed, resulting in more hits.

21.name: Umbral Feast
21.description: Lethal Mirage deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

22.name: Umbral Burst
22.description: When you reappear Lethal Mirage releases a burst of smoke blinding enemies and inflicts them with {Frailty}.

23.name: Smoke Cloud
23.description: The smoke from {Umbral Burst} persists as a cloud blinding enemies and inflicting {Frailty} each second.

24.name: Feebling Shadows
24.description: Allies within the smoke cloud avoid critical strikes.

25.name: Umbral Toxins
25.description: The smoke cloud is converted to a poison cloud causing enemies to be poisoned each second, but no longer inflicts {Frailty}.

26.name: Lingering Sickness
26.description: Poisons caused by Lethal Mirage last longer.

27.name: Umbral Traversal
27.description: You gain {Haste} when you reappear.

28.name: Umbral Expanse
28.description: Lethal Mirage gains an additional Mirage, resulting in more hits.

29.name: A Gloomy End
29.description: Mirages have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} in addition to their normal attack.

30.name: Pact of the Desert
30.description:
Lethal Mirage creates a {Shadow} at the location you disappear from.

This {Shadow} is not consumed by the {Shadow Eater} node.

31.name: Without a Trace
31.description:
Lethal Mirage instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health), but can no longer inflict bleed.

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

32.name: Backstab
32.description: Improves Lethal Mirage's base critical strike chance, but it has fewer Mirages, resulting in fewer hits.

2.name: Flame Burst
2.description:
Your melee hits apply 10 stacks of {Fiery Inquisition} and the melee hits of other allies affected by the aura apply 1 stack. If an enemy reaches 60 stacks, the stacks are consumed to release a {Flame Burst}, dealing fire damage to surrounding enemies.

While Holy Aura is acti…

3.name: Improved Flame Burst
3.description: If you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Fanaticism
4.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed.

5.name: True Strike
5.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance.

6.name: Extreme Zeal
6.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies' critical strikes to deal more damage.

7.name: Burning Blows
7.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased fire damage.

8.name: Rahyeh's Devotion
8.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a chance to ignite enemies.

9.name: Rahyeh's Fury
9.description: Holy Aura causes you and your allies to penetrate enemy fire resistance.

10.name: Call To Arms
10.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased physical damage.

11.name: Strength From Afar
11.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased throwing attack damage and increased stun chance with throwing attacks.

12.name: Shelter from the Storm
12.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional elemental resistance and endurance threshold.

13.name: Swiftness
13.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional dodge chance.

14.name: Redemption
14.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased healing effectiveness.

15.name: Concentration
15.description: Holy Aura's active duration lasts longer, but Holy Aura's cooldown lasts longer and its passive is disabled during its cooldown.

16.name: Purification
16.description:
Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional poison resistance.
Activating Holy Aura cleanses ailments for you and your allies.

17.name: Demoralizing Aura
17.description: Activating Holy Aura grants you a chance to slow surrounding enemies each second.

18.name: Expedite
18.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increasing throwing attack speed and a chance to gain {Haste} for 1 second on hit.

19.name: Vital Boon
19.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased health regeneration.

20.name: Faith
20.description: Holy Aura regenerates ward for you and nearby allies.

21.name: Shielded By Faith
21.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies increased ward retention.

22.name: Faith's Reward
22.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies a burst of ward when activated, but Holy Aura has a longer cooldown.

23.name: Mighty Shield
23.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies additional block effectiveness and health when blocking attacks.

24.name: Against The Odds
24.description: Holy Aura grants you and your allies ward when blocking attacks.

26.name: Hope
26.description: When an enemy dies in Holy Aura's area of effect, there is a chance it spawns a {Health Globe}, healing for 70 health.

28.name: Inner Flame
28.description: Your melee hits apply an additional stack of {Fiery Inquisition} and if you are the one to get the final hit to unleash {Flame Burst} on an enemy, it deals damage in an increased area.

0.name: Infernal Shade
0.description: Target enemy and all nearby enemies take fire damage per second . Each enemy can only have one Infernal Shade attached at a time. Expires after 5 seconds. Max 4 active shades.

1.name: Ignition
1.description: Infernal Shade costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

2.name: Blaze Shade
2.description: You have a chance to create a {Blaze Shade} which deals more damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Fleeting Shade
3.description: {Blaze Shade} deals more damage, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Fanning the Flames
4.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

5.name: Lingering Flames
5.description: If no target is within range of your target location the shade will wait up to 10 seconds for a target to come within range and then attach to it.

6.name: Purgatory
6.description: Infernal Shade gains 15% fire penetration each second that it is unattached to a target.

7.name: Legion
7.description:
When directly casting Infernal Shade you will create extra shades if there are nearby enemies.

Infernal Shade costs more mana to cast.

Has no effect if you have taken the Hellfire node.

8.name: Wildfires
8.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced duration.

9.name: Combustion
9.description: When Infernal Shade expires there is a large explosion which deals fire damage to nearby enemies.

10.name: Fiery Conclusion
10.description: The explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and affects a larger area.

11.name: Flame Burst
11.description: Infernal Shade has reduce duration and the explosion which occurs when the Infernal Shade expires has added critical strike chance.

12.name: Heart of Fire
12.description: Infernal Shade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area.

13.name: Cackling Flames
13.description: Infernal Shade has increased duration.

14.name: Brimstone
14.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to slow nearby enemies each second.

15.name: Hellfire
15.description:
Infernal Shade is now ground targeted and cannot attach to any targets.

Infernal Shade applies a stack of Fire Resistance Shred each second but now has a cooldown.

Prevents additional Shades from the Legion node being created.

16.name: Fiend Hunter
16.description: Infernal Shade has a shorter cooldown.

17.name: Flight of Fire
17.description: You can cast an additional Infernal Shade or Dread Shade.

18.name: Shifting Doom
18.description: When Infernal Shade's target dies it has a chance to move to a new target.

19.name: Influence
19.description: Infernal Shade deals damage in a larger area.

20.name: Devour in Flames
20.description: Infernal Shade can now only attach to your minions, but your minions are also damaged by Infernal Shade.

21.name: Burn Trail
21.description: Your minions gain {Haste} while they have an Infernal Shade attached to them.

22.name: Subjugation
22.description: Infernal Shade deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second it has been active, up to a maximum.

23.name: Soulfire
23.description: Infernal Shades which attach to minions have unlimited increased duration.

24.name: Manic Pyre
24.description: Minions which have an Infernal Shade attached to them gain increased movement, attack and cast speed each second up to a maximum.

25.name: Torment Beacon
25.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second.

26.name: Baneful
26.description: Ignited inflicted by Infernal Shade has additional Fire Penetration

27.name: Blood Shade
27.description:
Infernal Shade's base fire damage is converted to physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to fire damage.

All ignite chance from this tree is converted to bleed chance and effects related to ignite now depend on bleed ins…

28.name: Corrosion
28.description: Infernal Shade has a chance to shred the armor of nearby enemies each second.

0.name: Assemble Abomination
0.description: Hold ability key to channel to increase the area. When you release, combine all of your minions in the area into a single hulking abomination with states based on which minions are consumed.

2.name: Hulking Mass
2.description: Your abomination has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Unholy Command
3.description:
Your abomination grants additional armor to nearby minions for each minion it consumed.

When your abomination dies this effect is also granted to your minions by its corpse.

4.name: Devour
4.description:
You no longer channel to summon your abomination. Instead it consumes your nearest 5 minions to be summoned.

Assemble Abomination costs more mana.

5.name: Shattered Limbs
5.description: Your abomination has increased critical strike chance, but can no longer regenerate health or consume Bone Golems.

6.name: Spoils of War
6.description: If a Skeleton Warrior, Rogue or Vanguard is consumed, your abomination is granted the ability to {Double Strike,} and the first attack causes enemies to bleed.

7.name: Flesh and Blood
7.description: Your abomination's melee hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but can no longer consume Skeletal Mages.

9.name: Age of Undeath
9.description: You can now only consume minions from the {Summon Skeletons} and {Summon Skeletal Mages} skills to create the Abomination. However the Abomination does not start to decay until you control 6 or more such minions at the same time.

11.name: Fractured End
11.description: When your abomination dies, it disassembles into a number of Skeleton Vanguards.

12.name: Repugnant Presence
12.description: Your abomination reflects a percentage of damage to attackers and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

13.name: Domination
13.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: The Quick and the Dead
14.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but decays faster.

15.name: Imprisoned Horror
15.description: You abomination is impaled by bone spikes, granting it significantly increased damage, but is rendered immobile and drains health faster.

16.name: Consume
16.description: Your abomination's hits leech a portion of the damage they deal as health.

17.name: Unholy Reach
17.description: Your abomination's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area.

18.name: Reap The Damned
18.description: If a {Wraith} is consumed, its melee attack is replaced with {Soul Reave}, which deals melee necrotic damage.

19.name: Shattered Similacrum
19.description: If a {Golem} is consumed, your abomination uses {Stomp,} a melee attack that deals physical damage and has a high chance to stun enemies in a large area.

20.name: Meat Grinder
20.description:
Your abomination gains 10% increased damage when it kills an enemy. This effect stacks up to 10 times.

The abomination gains 2 stacks instead if the target is undead.

21.name: Stitched Flesh
21.description: Your abomination's health decays slower.

22.name: Cadaverous Carapace
22.description: Your abomination's health decays at half the rate, but your abomination deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Dead Eye
23.description: If a {Skeletal Archer} is absorbed, your abomination casts {Arrow Nova} every 4 seconds, a ranged ability that deals physical damage to enemies.

24.name: Horrific Volley
24.description: Your abomination's {Arrow Nova} fires more frequently and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Engorgement
26.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each minion consumed to create it (up to a maximum).

27.name: Epicurean
27.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each type of minion consumed to create it.

28.name: Death in the Family
28.description: If you absorb at least five different types of minion, Assemble Abomination has increased attack and cast speed.

29.name: Corrupt Palate
29.description: If a Skeletal Mage is consumed, your abomination can cast {Devouring Souls}.

30.name: Frightful Feast
30.description: Your abomination's {Devouring Souls} releases an additional soul for each Skeletal Mage that was consumed to summon your abomination.

31.name: A Violent End
31.description: Your abomination deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for 8 seconds after it has been summoned.

32.name: Bloated Corpse
32.description: If a {Volatile Zombie} is consumed, your Abomination gains an explosive {Tail Slam} ability.

33.name: Rapacious Protection
33.description: Your abomination also gains the combined health of all consumed Bone Golems as armor, and will focus on protecting you from nearby enemies.

2.name: Necrotic Conviction
2.description: Skeleton Warriors have more maximum health, while Skeleton Rogues and Archers deal more damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Aegis of Death
3.description: When one of your Skeletons dies, another Skeleton is healed to full health.

4.name: Unbound Necromancy
4.description: Summon Skeletons costs less mana, and your Skeletons have improved base critical strike chance.

5.name: Soul Catcher
5.description: You gain ward whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

6.name: Mind Catcher
6.description: You gain mana whenever one of your Skeletons dies.

7.name: Memory Catcher
7.description: You have increased spell damage if one of your Skeletons has died recently (past 4 seconds).

8.name: Unholy Rage
8.description: Skeletons have increased attack speed, cast speed, and movement speed.

9.name: Lone Guardian
9.description: Your Skeletons have increased critical strike chance, but you can only have one Skeleton Warrior summoned at once.

10.name: Mightier than the Sword
10.description: Skeleton Warriors are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

11.name: Marrow Walkers
11.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

12.name: Hollow Walkers
12.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

13.name: Grave Walkers
13.description: You can summon more Skeletons.

14.name: Shambling Steel
14.description: Skeleton Archers are removed from the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned.

15.name: Fire Arrow
15.description: Skeleton Archers use {Fire Arrow}, which is a bow attack that deals physical and fire damage and ignites on hit. Fire Arrow has a 6 second cooldown by default.

16.name: Multishot
16.description: {Fire Arrow} shoots more arrows that deal more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has a longer cooldown.

17.name: Ice Arrow
17.description: Converts {Fire Arrow} into {Ice Arrow}, converting its base fire damage to cold damage. Ice Arrow cannot ignite, but has a chance to freeze.

18.name: Dread Phalanx
18.description: Skeletons deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger, but you can only summon half as many as you could before (rounded up).

19.name: Bone Armor
19.description: Skeleton Warriors can now cast {Bone Armor}, which reduces damage taken by 40% for 4 seconds and has a 10 second cooldown.

20.name: Impatience
20.description: Skeletons are able to use their abilities more frequently, and {Bone Armor} cast by Skeletons lasts longer.

21.name: Bone Share
21.description: Skeleton Warriors can target allies with {Bone Armor}.  Bone Armor has 75% reduced effect on non-minions.

22.name: Marrow Tap
22.description: Skeletons leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and they have additional physical resistance.

23.name: Empty the Graves
23.description: You summon multiple Skeletons in a single cast, but Summon Skeleton costs more mana. This does not affect your maximum number of Skeletons.

24.name: Sweeping Strikes
24.description: Skeletons have an increased area of effect with melee attacks, and your Skeletons deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Skeleton Rogue
25.description: Adds Skeleton Rogues to the pool of Skeletons that can be summoned. Rogues teleport to distant enemies, throw shurikens, and use melee attacks.

26.name: Immortal
26.description: When a Skeleton dies, there is a chance to summon a random new one at the same location after 3 seconds.

27.name: Acid Flask
27.description: Skeleton Rogues throw {Acid Flasks}, which inflict poison and armor shred on hit. Acid Flask has a 5 second cooldown.

28.name: Individual Operator
28.description: Skeleton Rogues gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased cooldown recovery speed, but the amount is divided by your maximum number of summonable Skeleton Rogues.

2.name: Shocking Conduit
2.description: Static Orb hits has a chance to shock enemies.

3.name: Manacharged
3.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 20 maximum mana, but Static Orb costs more mana equal to a portion of your maximum mana.

4.name: Static Ground
4.description: The explosion now leaves behind {Charged Ground} dealing lightning damage over time in an area. Creating another Charged Ground halves the remaining duration of all existing ones.

5.name: Electrocuting Cascade
5.description: {Charged Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per additonal critical strike multiplier.

6.name: Charged Allies
6.description: You and allies have additonal shock chance and increased shock effectiveness while inside {Charged Ground's} area.

7.name: Insidious Focus
7.description: Static Orb costs less mana, but it no longer pulls enemies.

8.name: Ball Lightning
8.description:
Static Orb costs significantly less mana, but it now has a chance to not explode.

If you {Scatter Blast} then you only have a chance to create small orbs, and if you have {Orbital Fulmination} all static orbs orbit you for a reduced duration.

9.name: Recurring Orb
9.description:
If Static Orb does not explode it returns to you and deals damage on the way back, but it costs more mana.

This node has no effect if you have {Orbital Fulmination}.

10.name: Biting Force
10.description:
Static Orb's base lightning damage is converted to cold and it gains a base freeze rate, but it no longer pulls enemies. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to {Frostb…

11.name: Wintry Power
11.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

12.name: Glacial Orb
12.description: The orb and the explosion have a higher chance to freeze enemies, but the explosion no longer creates Tendrils.

13.name: Orbital Fulmination
13.description:
The orb now orbits you for up to 3 seconds before exploding, but you are limited to a few orbs and casting more will detonate older ones.

Static Orb gains damage and explosion area with time rather than travel distance, but scales up to the same maximum as before.

14.name: Storm Conductor
14.description: Static Orb deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to shocked enemies.

15.name: Arcane Current
15.description: Static Orb generates {Static Charges} on hit.

16.name: Overwhelming Barrage
16.description: The explosion has a higher chance to stun, increased stun duration and you gain ward on stun with the explosion.

17.name: Critical Trajectory
17.description: Static Orb's critical strikes deal more damage.

18.name: Forking Surge
18.description: The explosion creates additional {Tendrils} to hit enemies outside the explosion area.

19.name: Static Armor
19.description: Static Orb grants you {Lightning Aegis} for a short duration on cast, which grants 50% increased lightning damage and 25% less damage taken. Lightning Aegis causes an explosion of lightning damage when you lose 25% of your health or after 10 seconds.

20.name: Storm Burst
20.description: Static Orb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, but automatically explodes after 4 meters.

21.name: Volatile Outburst
21.description: The explosion's damage ramps up more with distance, but it travels slower.

22.name: Storm Artillery
22.description: Static Orb deals more damage and now travel faster and in an arcing trajectory rather than a straight line, but it no longer pulls or hits enemies until it explodes.

23.name: Fusionblast
23.description: After using Static Orb the next {Lightning Blasts} cast from any source chain 2 additonal times.

24.name: Atomic Manipulation
24.description:
For 4 seconds after using Static Orb directly casting {Lightning Blast} and hitting at least one enemy will return 25% of Static Orb's mana cost. 

This effect can only occur a limited number of times.

25.name: Open Circuit
25.description: Static Orb travels faster and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Overcharged Detonation
26.description: Static Orb explodes on hit rather than piercing enemies. The orb deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1 mana cost.

27.name: Auxiliary Capacity
27.description: You have a chance to cast an additional Static Orb towards the target when it hits a rare enemy or boss. This effect has a short cooldown.

28.name: Scatter Blast
28.description: Casting Static Orb sends out smaller orbs in a cone in front of you. These small orbs can hit the same target as the large orb, but cannot explode and do not pull.

2.name: Amalgam of Rogues
2.description: Your Golem moves and attacks faster.

3.name: Twinned Golems
3.description: You summon an additional Golem, but each Golem has reduced maximum health, is smaller, and deals less damage (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Ivory Twin
4.description: Your Golems deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). If Bone Golems have been replaced by another type of Golem, you now have an equal chance to summon a Bone Golem.

5.name: Burning Bones
5.description: Your Golem has a chance to ignite enemies, it also has additional fire resistance and deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Charred Bones
6.description: Your Golem deals additional fire damage with spells and melee attacks.

7.name: Pyre Golem
7.description:
You now summon a {Pyre Golem} instead of a Bone Golem.

The base physical damage of Pyre Golems' melee attacks is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion fire damage, but not increases to minion physical damage.

Pyre Golems also cast {Infer…

8.name: World Pyre
8.description: Your Golem deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers), and {Pyre Golems}’ {Infernal Aura} deals damage in a larger area.

9.name: Unnatural Speed
9.description: Your Golem causes all nearby minions to move faster, including themselves. This bonus is doubled for the Golems themselves.

10.name: Infected Remains
10.description: Your Golem has a chance to grant you a stack of {Putrid Coating} when it is hit. Each stack lasts for 8 seconds and grants you a chance to poison enemies.

11.name: Cold Vengeance
11.description: Your Golem deals additional melee cold damage and it has a chance to chill attackers when hit.

12.name: Deathchill Golem
12.description:
You now summon a {Deathchill Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

The base physical damage of Deathchill Golems' melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not increases to minion physical damage. Death Chill Gole…

13.name: Amalgam of Sentinels
13.description: Your Golem has additional health and armor, as well as more health and armor (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Bladed Fists
14.description: Your Golem deals more damage with melee attacks (multiplicative with other modifers), and has an increased chance to stun with melee attacks.

15.name: Tower of Bones
15.description: Your Golem is larger (multiplicative with other modifiers) and generates more threat, which increases the likelihood of enemies targeting it.

16.name: Fragments of the Fallen
16.description:
Your Golems have increased size and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have no other living golems when you summon them.

Your Golems have significantly higher armor for the first 15 seconds of their life when summoned near the corpse of another Golem.

17.name: Amalgam of Primalists
17.description: Your Golem grants additional armor to nearby minions, including itself.

18.name: Hunger
18.description: Your Golem's hits restore health to you and itself. This effect restores additional health per 2 Vitality.

19.name: Blood Golem
19.description:
You now summon a {Blood Golem} instead of a Bone Golem. 

Blood Golems can also cast {Sanguine Orb}, a spell that deals physical damage to nearby enemies over 2 seconds.

20.name: Amalgam of Mages
20.description: Your Golem deals more spell damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and has an increased chance to stun.

21.name: Bone Hail
21.description: Your Golem has a higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when hit and its Bone Shatter deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.name: Flight of the Femurs
22.description: Your Golem's {Bone Shatter} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit) and travel faster, causing them to also travel further.

23.description: Your Golem has additional health regeneration based on your total amount of health regeneration.

24.name: Marrow Eater
24.description: Your Golem gains significantly more armor for 8 seconds whenever a skeleton minion dies nearby.

25.name: Betrayal
25.description: If you only control one Golem, it has a much higher chance to retaliate with {Bone Shatter} when damaged by hits from allies.

26.name: Breath of Formosus
26.description: Your Golem's {Freezing Grasp} spell now has additional spell damage and base freeze rate per point of Vitality.

28.name: Bone Kindling
28.description: {Pyre Golems}’ {Infernal Aura} consumes {Skeletons} and {Skeletal Mages} that it hits to deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per minion it consumed.

2.name: Venomous Maw
2.description: Your scorpion's attacks grant health on hit, and have a higher chance to poison on hit.

3.name: Envenomed Prey
3.description: Your Scorpion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Poison on the target (up to 30).

4.description: Your Scorpion's melee attacks deal damage in a larger area, and your Scorpion is larger.

5.description: Your Scorpion's has a chance to cause enemies to bleed, and it deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers)

6.description: Your Scorpion deals additional melee damage, and its Poison Chance from all sources is converted to Armour Shred Chance.

7.name: Maternal Instinct
7.description: Your Scorpion spawns a number of {Baby Scorpions} every 10 seconds. Baby Scorpions have an unlimited duration but can be killed.

8.description: {Baby Scorpions} deal more damage (damage is multiplicative with other modifiers) and their attacks have a chance to poison enemies.

9.name: Sweet Release
9.description: Activating your Scorpion's ability summons additional {Baby Scorpions.}

10.name: Fertility Rites
10.description: {Baby Scorpions} are summoned more frequently.

11.name: Scurry
11.description: {Baby Scorpions} have increased attack and movement speed.

12.name: Chromatic Carapace
12.description: Your Scorpion has additional elemental resistance.

13.name: Cold-Blooded
13.description:
Your scorpion takes less cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

The base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to minion cold damage, but not with increases to minion physical damage. …

14.name: Ice Sting
14.description: Your Scorpion deals more cold damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a higher chance to freeze enemies.

15.name: Get Over Here
15.description: Your Scorpion now has the ability to pull an enemy that is out of range into melee range every 8 seconds.

16.name: Thunder Stinger
16.description:
Your Scorpion's activated ability is now {Shock Nova}, a spell that deals lightning damage and applies 3 stacks of {Shock} on hit.

If you do not have the {Cold-Blooded} node the base physical damage of your scorpion's melee attacks is converted to lightning. Consequently this…

17.name: Shock and Claw
17.description: Your Scorpion has a chance to {Shock} on hit and deals more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of shock on the target.

18.name: Rest for the Wicked
18.description: Whenever your Scorpion kills an enemy, it heals for a percentage of its maximum health.

19.name: Frost Thorns
19.description: Your Scorpion can cast {Frost Thorns}, a cold spell with seeking projectiles.

20.name: Noxious Carapace
20.description: Your Scorpion deals more poison damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Acid Lob
21.description: Your Scorpion casts {Acid Lob,} a ranged spell that explodes on impact, poisoning enemies and reducing their armor. Acid Lob has a 6 second cooldown.

22.name: Miasma
22.description: Your scorpion's {Venom Nova} deals damage in a larger area, and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Deeper Puddle
23.description: {Venom Nova} leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for a duration, which applies a stack of poison each second to enemies standing in the pool.

24.name: Pus Sacks
24.description: Your Scorpion has a chance when it is hit to create a {Poison Pool.} This effect has a 10 second cooldown.

25.name: Brood Invigoration
25.description: {Poison Pools} grant you and your minions increased attack speed and cast speed and a chance to poison enemies.

26.name: Winternid Jaws
26.description: Your scorpion has a chance to inflict {Frostbite} on hit and its Bleed Chance from all sources is converted to Frostbite Chance.

1.name: Emission
1.description: Anomaly hits enemies in a larger area.

2.name: Red Shift
2.description: Anomaly lasts longer.

3.name: Borrowed Time
3.description: Anomaly is cast instantly, but Anomaly has a longer cooldown.

4.name: Time Wave
4.description: When enemies return to the present a {Time Wave} is released, a spell dealing void damage to nearby enemies.

5.name: Temporal Expanse
5.description: {Time Wave} deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area, and increases to Anomaly's area also affect Time Wave.

6.name: Tides of Time
6.description: An additional {Time Wave} is released when you cast Anomaly.

7.name: Anticipation
7.description: Anomaly has a shorter cooldown.

8.name: Reflection
8.description: {Future Strike} is applied to all enemies hit by Anomaly.

9.name: Resonate
9.description: {Future Strikes} applied by Anomaly have additional Void Penetration

10.name: Quicksand
10.description: When enemies return to the present, all damaging ailments currently applied to them apply faster.

11.name: Cycle of Decay
11.description: When enemies return to the present, the duration of damaging ailments applied to them is reset.

12.name: Void Touched
12.description: Enemies hit by Anomaly are afflicted with {Time Rot} when they return.

13.name: Exacerbate
13.description: {Time Rot} inflicted by Anomaly lasts longer and has additional Void Penetration

14.name: Mark of Rot
14.description: When enemies return to the present, they take increased void damage for a duration.

15.name: Voidfire
15.description: Anomaly now applies Ignite instead of Time Rot. Modifiers to Time Rot apply to Ignite instead.

16.name: Hour of Flame
16.description: Anomaly applies additional stacks of ignite.

17.name: Time Bubble
17.description: Anomaly leaves behind a {Time Bubble} for 5 seconds, which slows enemies and shreds their void resistance.

18.name: Decimation
18.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased critical strike chance while in its area.

19.name: Temporal Mastery
19.description: {Time Bubble} lasts longer.

20.name: Time Lord
20.description: {Time Bubble} is now cast on yourself and moves with you, but Anomaly costs more mana.

22.name: Manipulation
22.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased attack and cast speed while in its area.

23.name: Swiftrest
23.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased cooldown recovery speed while in its area.

24.name: Time Eater
24.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies global health leech. This is doubled for void damage.

25.name: Void Maw
25.description: {Time Bubble} grants you and your allies increased health leech while in its area.

26.name: Immediacy
26.description: Anomaly no longer sends enemies foward in time. Effects that would be triggered when enemies return to the present are instead triggered immediately.

27.name: Time Lock
27.description:
When enemies return to the present they are afflicted by {Time Lock,} rendering them unable to move, attack, or cast spells for 2 seconds.

Anomaly costs more mana.

28.name: Temporal Prison
28.description: {Time Lock} lasts longer.

29.name: Stasis
29.description: When enemies return to the present, enemies within the area of Anomaly's original cast are also time locked for 2 seconds.

30.name: Lingering Memory
30.description: When allies or enemies exit {Time Bubble's} area of effect, effects caused or granted by Time Bubble persist for 2 seconds.

1.name: Sanctified Serenity
1.description: {Consecrated Ground} has increased healing effectiveness.

2.name: Lingering Force
2.description: {Consecrated Ground} lasts longer.

3.name: Anointed
3.description: {Consecrated Ground} becomes a {Consecrating Aura} which surrounds you, but Judgement costs more mana and has a longer cooldown.

4.description: {Consecrated Ground} heals allies and deals damage in a larger area.

5.description: When {Consecrated Ground} finishes, it casts {Holy Eruption}, dealing fire damage to all nearby enemies and heals you and all your nearby allies for 80 health.

6.description: {Holy Eruption} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and restore more health.

7.description: {Holy Eruption} cleanses negative ailments, such as ignite and chill, on you and allies.

8.name: Expedite
8.description: {Consecrated Ground} restores more health, but has a shorter duration.

9.description: Judgement now pulls in enemies and slows them, but its initial hit no longer deals damage.

10.name: Flaming Soul
10.description: {Consecrated Ground} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Ashes To Dust
11.description: {Consecrated Ground} has a chance to shred enemy armor each second.

12.name: Divine Destruction
12.description: Judgement hits and {Conscrated Ground} deal more damage against enemies at high health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Scourgebane
13.description: Judgement hits deal more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Sigil of Sacrifice
14.description: Judgement consumes all of your {Sigils of Hope} to deal additional fire damage for each Sigil consumed.

15.name: Pious Offering
15.description: Judgement now also consumes a percentage of your current mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per mana consumed.

16.name: Ascendant Liturgy
16.description: Judgement gains significant physical and fire penetration, but no longer leaves behind {Consecrated Ground}.

17.name: Proclamation
17.description: Judgement deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

18.name: Righteous Decree
18.description: Judgement also casts {Smite} at nearby enemies. Smite consumes mana equal to its mana cost for each cast.

19.name: Sacred Sword
19.description: Judgement hits have a chance to ignite enemies and ignites applied by Judgement have additional Fire Penetration.

20.name: Warrior's Tithe
20.description: Judgement's melee attack heals you and nearby allied players for each enemy it hits. This healing is affected by your increased healing effectiveness.

21.name: Purifying Flame
21.description: Judgement hits and {Consecrated Ground} deal more damage against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

22.name: Fervent Impact
22.description: Judgement hits have more critical strike chance against ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Punish
23.description: Judgement critical strikes deal more damage.

24.name: Swift Verdict
24.description: Judgement has a shorter cooldown and a lower mana cost.

25.name: Prophesied Immolation
25.description: Judgement's melee attack cannot be dodged and deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) based on your increased healing effectiveness.

26.name: Ensuing Fervour
26.description: You gain Frenzy for a duration after using Judgement if it hits at least one enemy.

27.name: Deliverance
27.description: If you hit at least one enemy with Judgement you gain the {Deliverance} buff, which drastically increases mana regen and health regen.

28.name: Holy War
28.description: While you have the {Deliverance} buff whenever you directly use Vengeance, Rive, or Multistrike and hit at least one enemy you regain additional mana.

29.name: Urgent Inquisition
29.description: Judgement no longer has a cooldown, but costs substantially more mana. Its mana cost now counts as mana consumed for the effect of the {Pious Offering} node.

2.name: Dense Thicket
2.description: Ice Thorns travel faster and farther, and you have a chance to release 6 additional thorns when casting Ice Thorns.

3.name: Anemophily
3.description: Ice Thorns travel faster and farther.

4.description: Ice Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (pass through enemies they hits), and Ice Thorns hits deal additional base cold damage.

5.description: Ice Thorns now creates a {Thorn Barrier} for 1 second before releasing granting you armor.

6.description: {Thorn Barrier} lasts longer before releasing.

7.description: {Thorn Barrier} has a chance to recast when it expires.

8.description: You can cast {Thorn Barrier} on allies, and which will provide them armour and cause thorns to burst from them when it expires.

9.description: You have a chance to cast Ice Thorns when hit by enemies.

11.description: Ice Thorns has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

12.description: Kills with Ice Thorns have a chance to cast {Thorn Trail,} a spell which travels along the ground in a line dealing physical damage to enemies it hits, but Ice Thorns deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Ice Thorns hits have a chance to cast {Sundering Thorns}, a spell which travels in a line dealing physical damage to enemies hit.

Sundering Thorns has a 4 second cooldown.

14.name: Earthen Assault
14.description: {Sundering Thorns} has a shorter cooldown.

15.name: Ritual Briar
15.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). This effect is doubled if you have an active totem.

16.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each of your active totems.

17.description: Ice Thorns deals more damage and you have a chance to cast Ice Thorns when hit if you have at least 2 active totems.

18.description: Ice Thorns now casts twice in quick succession, but has a 4 second cooldown.

19.name: Floric Tides
19.description: Ice Thorns has a shorter cooldown, and {Thorn Barrier} grants a chance to avoid critical strikes.

20.name: Emblem of Might
20.description: Ice Thorns costs no mana if you're using a two-handed melee weapon.

21.name: Bark Shield
21.description: {Thorn Barrier} grants additional armor.

22.name: Frostroot Storm
22.description: Ice Thorns releases additional thorns, but costs more mana.

23.name: Thorn Burst
23.description: Ice Thorns releases additional thorns and deals additional spell physical damage, but thorns have a shorter duration and no longer home in on enemies.

24.name: Thaw
24.description: Ice Thorns' base cold damage is converted to physical damage. Ice Thorns has higher cast speed, but can no longer freeze enemies.

25.name: Cold Prison
25.description: Ice Thorns hits deal additional base cold damage and have a higher chance to freeze enemies.

26.name: Nightshade
26.description: Converts bleed chance from all sources to poison chance for Ice Thorns, and poison inflicted by Ice Thorns lasts longer.

27.name: Farwood Heart
27.description: When you use Ice Thorns you gain a stack of {Farwood Heart} for 4 seconds, a buff that grants 25% increased cold damage and +40% freeze rate multiplier.

28.name: Dagger Thorns
28.description: Improves Ice Thorns' base critical strike chance, and Ice Thorns critical strikes deal more damage.

29.name: Totem Weaver
29.description:
You have a chance to summon a {Thorn Totem} when Ice Thorns kills an enemy.

You can only summon a Thorn Totem this way every 3 seconds.

2.name: Rush of the Hunt
2.description: Dive Bomb has a shorter cooldown.

3.name: United Assault
3.description: You reduce a portion of Dive Bomb's remaining cooldown when you use a throwing or bow attack and hit at least one enemy.

4.description:
Before your Falcon dives it now uses {Featherfall} that causes razorsharp feathers to strike a number of enemies in an area around the target location.

{Shadow Falcons} won't use {Featherfall}.

7.description: Dive Bomb's hits apply {Critical Vulnerability} on enemies.

If Dive Bomb hits your {Explosive Traps} they instantly explode dealing more damage in a larger area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

Additionally, when you detonate an {Explosive Trap} this way you gain a stack of {Talon Blades}.

11.description: Dive Bomb's hits shred enemy physical resistance.

12.name: Red Wings
12.description: Dive Bomb's hits grant you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} per enemy hit, up to a maximum.

13.name: Exsanguinating Strike
13.description:
Dive Bomb's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed on the target up to a maximum.

Additionally, it causes all bleed stacks inflicted by you or your Falcon to be consumed to deal their remaining damage instantly.

14.name: Rushing Wings
14.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has a shorter delay before the Falcon dives.

15.name: Devastating Dive
15.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and stuns caused by it last longer, but it has a longer cooldown.

18.name: On Wings of Shadow
18.description:
Dive Bomb now creates a {Shadow Falcon} to strike the location of your own {Shadows} and it will prioritize your {Shadows} nearest the target location, but {Shadow Falcons} deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) than the real Falcon.

The number of {Shadow Falc…

19.description: You gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for each {Shadow Falcon} that hit at least one enemy.
