20.description: A {Shadow Falcon} takes your Falcon's place, that uses Dive Bomb. Your Falcon is able to attack and use other abilities during this.

21.name: Dancing Shadows
21.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} that land inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} take off again after a short delay before diving again at a nearby enemy to deal damage around them.

22.name: Midnight Aviary
22.description: Your {Shadow Falcons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modfiers) per {Umbral Blade} you have on the ground.

23.name: Valkyrie
23.description:
If you are wielding a spear you also leap to the target location when you use Dive Bomb. This deals damage in the area around the target.

Dive Bomb gains the {Traversal} tag.

24.name: Rending Impact
24.description: Dive Bomb's hits cause enemies to bleed.

25.name: Talon Knives
25.description: If you are dual wielding, a portion of the damage specific stats from both of your weapons apply to your Falcon's Dive Bomb.

26.name: Gaping Wounds
26.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10% of your increased stun chance.

27.name: Rapid Pursuit
27.description: If Dive Bomb hits at least one boss or rare enemy you regain mana and recover a portion of your remaining traversal skills' cooldown.

28.name: Incendiary Collision Bird Missile
28.description:
If Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoy}, it detonates it, causing its explosion to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

The effects from the {Rapid Pursuit} node are also gained when Dive Bomb hits one of your {Decoys}.

29.name: Focused Hunter
29.description: Dive Bomb deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

30.name: Cloud Gatherer
30.description: If your Falcon lands inside the area of your {Smoke Bomb} the smoke area lasts longer.

32.name: To Shreds
32.description: {Featherfall's} hits shred enemy armor.

2.description: Aerial Assault deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a shorter cooldown.

3.name: Featherstorm
3.description: After the initial {Wing Burst} your Falcon continues releasing {Featherstorm} at the target location for 5 seconds.

4.name: Domain of the Huntress
4.description:
{Featherstorm} now has a chance to slow enemies inside its area each second. 

Additionally, you and your allies have additional dodge rating while inside the area.

5.name: Shaded Wingspan
5.description: If there is a boss or rare enemy nearby Aerial Assault now also creates a {Shadow Falcon} to use {Featherstorm} against it.

6.name: Storm on the Horizon
6.description: Aerial Assault no longer moves you. Additionally, it deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and it no longer has a minimum range.

7.name: Razorblade Plume
7.description: {Featherstorm} lasts longer and deals more direct damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second it has been active.

8.name: Darkwing Fall
8.description: {Featherstorm} now has a chance each second to drop a {Black Arrow}.

9.name: Pitohui
9.description:
{Featherstorms'} base physical damage over time is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

10.description: A portion of Aerial Assault's cooldown is recovered when your Falcon hits an enemy.

11.name: Treacherous Pursuit
11.description: Using Aerial Assault now also drops {Caltrops} at your location.

12.name: Vengeful Nails
12.description: {Caltrops} from all sources have a chance to slow on hit, and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Spikefield
13.description: You now drop additional {Caltrops} halfway through Aerial Assault's movement if you traveled at least 6 meters.

14.name: Rending Barbs
14.description:
{Caltrops'} hits from all sources has a chance to cause enemies to bleed. 

Additionally, when an enemy walks over your {Caltrops} your Falcon's hits gain additional bleed chance per 4 Dexterity for 4 seconds, and this can stack an unlimited number of times.

15.name: Refreshing Resolve
15.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing mana.

16.name: Coordinated Assault
16.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of the remaining cooldown of {Falconry} and {Dive Bomb} per 10 maximum mana you have.

17.name: Healing Gust
17.description: Directly using Aerial Assault recovers a portion of your missing health.

18.name: Gustborne Guard
18.description: The health gain from the {Healing Gust} node is converted to ward.

19.name: Aerial Prowess
19.description:
For the next 8 seconds after using Aerial Assault, critical strikes dealt by you or your {Falcon} grant you a stack of {Aerial Prowess} up to a maximum.

When you next use Aerial Assault it consumes all stacks to restore health per stack and deal more damage (multiplicative wi…

20.name: Wind Rider
20.description:
You have more global dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers) while traveling.

Additionally, each hit you dodge while traveling grants you a stack of {Aerial Prowess}.

21.name: Torrent of Talons
21.description: Aerial Assault now has a chance to grant you {Aerial Prowess} stacks on non-critical strikes and when you kill an enemy.

22.name: Falcon's Havoc
22.description: Consuming stacks of {Aerial Assault} now grants you {Haste} and Frenzy for a short duration per stack consumed.

23.description: Directly using {Ballista,} {Explosive Trap} or {Dive Bomb} now also consumes your stacks of {Aerial Prowess}, applying the damage bonus to the ability that consumed them.

25.name: Covering Fire
25.description: The {Wing Burst's} hits apply frailty.

26.name: Tactician
26.description: After landing, all your active {Ballistas} prioritize targets around you and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per Intelligence as well as gaining increased attack speed.

27.description: The {Wing Burst} deals damage in a larger area.

28.description: The {Wing Burst} deals more direct damage to enemies on high health.

32.description: The {Wing Burst} now also includes a few {Umbral Blades} that your Falcon throws for you.

5.description: Javelin gains physical and lightning penetration for each second you have been standing still up to a maximum duration.

12.name: Monster Piercer
12.description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to enemies on high health.

13.description: Javelin hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) up to a maximum, for each enemy pierced.

15.description: Javelin hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

16.description: Javelin costs less mana.

17.name: Perfect Setup
17.description: Directly using Javelin causes your next melee attack to costs less mana.

18.description: Directly using Javelin and hitting an enemy causes your next {Judgement} or {Forge Strike} to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Mighty Delivery
19.description: Javelin deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has increased attack speed.

21.name: Seismic Tide
21.description:
Earthquake's initial hit occurs three times. First with 30% reduced radius and damage, then with 5% reduced radius and damage, then with 30% increased radius and damage.

Earthquake now has a cooldown, and each initial hit consumes mana.

22.name: Sunder
22.description: Earthquake's initial hit reduces enemy armor.

23.name: The Harder They Fall
23.description: Earthquake's initial hit deals more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Cataclysm
24.description:
Earthquake's base damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Additionally, armor shred chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance.

25.name: Concussion
25.description: Earthquake's initial hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun enemies.

26.name: Storm Rift
26.description: Earthquake is converted into a spell, and no longer scales with melee damage. Earthquake now deals substantial additional base damage on the initial hit and half of its base damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this converted portion scales with increased lightning d…

27.name: Thunderblight
27.description: Earthquake's initial hit deals additional lightning damage.

28.name: Fury Of The Elements
28.description:
Casting Earthquake expends Storm Stacks over 0.5 seconds.

{Storm Bolts} triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

30.name: Staggering Force
30.description: Earthquake's initial hit deals more damage and has increased stun chance and stun duration, but Earthquake has a 6 second cooldown.

31.name: Shattered Resolve
31.description: Stuns caused by Earthquake and its Aftershocks last longer, but Earthquake has a longer cooldown.

32.name: Deep Impact
32.description: Earthquake's initial hit can't be dodged.

2.name: Corrosive
2.description: Acid Flask deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Elixir of Speed
3.description: Acid Flask has a chance to grant {Haste} on use for a short duration.

4.name: Toxic Salvo
4.description:
You now throw 3 Acid Flasks in a line, but Acid Flask costs more mana.

Enemies can only be hit by one flask per throw.

5.name: Barrage
5.description: You now throw Acid Flasks in a fan in front of you instead of a line. Flasks travel faster.

6.name: Tempered Glass
6.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy armor.

7.name: Poison Pools
7.description:
Acid Flask leaves behind a {Poison Pool} for 4 seconds that poison enemies that stand in it and adds a 2 second cooldown per flask thrown.

You can have a maximum of 4 {Poison Pools} active at once.

8.name: Hydrochloric Acid
8.description: You have a chance to poison enemies while standing in your {Poison Pools}.

9.name: Lingering Toxicity
9.description: {Poison Pools} last longer.

10.name: Explosive Flask
10.description:
Acid Flask's base damage is converted to fire damage and its hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Acid Flask can no longer apply poison o…

11.name: Smoulder
11.description: Converts Armor Shred from all sources that Acid Flask would apply to Fire Resistance Shred.

12.name: Cluster Bomb
12.description: When Acid Flask is thrown directly it causes 3 smaller explosions around the impact location dealing fire damage on hit, but it costs more mana.

13.name: Blinding Mixture
13.description: Acid Flask has a chance to blind enemies hit for 4 seconds.

14.name: Contamination
14.description: Acid Flask has a chance to shred enemy poison resistance on hit.

15.name: Caustic Concoction
15.description: Acid Flask has additional chance to poison enemies on hit.

16.name: Debilitate
16.description: Acid Flask has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

17.name: Lasting Sickness
17.description: Acid Flask has increased poison duration.

18.name: Quick Draw
18.description: Acid Flask has increased throwing speed.

19.name: Castigate
19.description:
You have a chance to drop an Acid Flask at your feet when an enemy hits you. 

This effect has a 5 second cooldown.

20.name: Alchemical Proficiency
20.description: Acid Flask costs less mana.

21.name: Hindering Mixture
21.description: Acid Flask has a chance to slow enemies on hit. Slow caused by Acid Flask lasts longer.

22.name: Firebomb Cocktail
22.description: Acid Flask deals additional throwing fire damage.

23.name: Flammable Concoction
23.description: Acid Flask has a chance to ignite enemies.

24.name: Piercing Debris
24.description: Acid Flask has increased citical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.

25.name: Splash Zone
25.description: Acid Flask deals damage in a larger area.

26.name: Lightweight
26.description: Acid Flask travels faster.

28.name: Knowledge of Immunity
28.description: Acid Flask penetrates poison resistance based on your own uncapped Poison Resistance

29.name: Amatoxic Pools
29.description: {Poison Pools} have a chance to inflict enemies with {Efficacious Toxin} each second, causing them to take increased damage over time.

30.name: Alchemist's Gift
30.description:
Acid Flask is now thrown as a trap that starts arming and explodes when enemies walk over it.

You can have a maximum of 6 Acid Flask Traps active at once.

2.name: Reinforced Totem
2.description: Frenzy Totem has more health (multiplicative with other modifiers) and lasts longer.

3.name: Reach
3.description: Frenzy Totem affects allies or enemies in a larger area.

4.name: Healing Pulse
4.description: While in range of your Frenzy Totem, you have a chance to cast {Eterra's Blessing} on a random ally each second.

5.name: Thorn Idol
5.description: Frenzy Totem stores a portion of the damage it receives, releasing it as damage dealt to enemies after taking a percent of its maximum health in damage.

6.name: Improved Thorn Idol
6.description: Frenzy Totem also stores a percentage of the damage taken by you.

7.name: Lash Out
7.description: Frenzy Totem has a chance to cast {Ice Thorns} when hit by enemies.

8.name: Sloth Totem
8.description:
Frenzy Totem is now {Sloth Totem,} which will now slow and reduce the armor of enemies instead of granting Frenzy.

Increased effect of frenzy is converted to increased effect of armor shred.

9.name: Grounded
9.description:
Frenzy Totem is no longer summoned at your cursor; instead it is always placed 1 meter in the direction you're facing.

Frenzy Totem costs less mana and grants additional melee damage.

10.name: Dig In
10.description: You are tethered to the totem while you remain within 5 meters of it, and while tethered you deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Totemic Reach
11.description: Frenzy Totem's tether has a higher range.

13.name: Dig Deep
13.description: You have additional critical strike multiplier while tethered.

14.name: Revitalizing Totem
14.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted increased health regeneration.

15.name: Symbol of Haste
15.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, you and your companions are granted {Haste} for a duration (doubled for companions).

16.name: Symbol of Selflessness
16.description: Frenzy Totem's buffs are more effective, but Frenzy Totem now affects only companions.

17.name: Warding Totem
17.description: Companions affected by Frenzy Totem have higher physical and elemental resistance.

18.name: Mortuary Totem
18.description: While affected by Frenzy Totem, you revive downed companions faster.

19.name: Invigorated Renewal
19.description: Whenever you revive a downed companion, Frenzy Totem casts {Healing Nova.}

20.name: Venomous Intent
20.description: Allies affected by Frenzy Totem are granted a chance to poison enemies.

22.name: Rabidity
22.description: Frenzy Totem's Frenzy buff is more effective.

23.name: Reckless Frenzy
23.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem you gain a temporary buff that grants you more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed, but also increases the damage you take.

24.name: Bestial Frenzy
24.description: When you summon Frenzy Totem, your companions are granted additional melee physical damage for 4 seconds.

25.name: Furious Cry
25.description: Summoning Frenzy Totem refreshes companion ability cooldowns.

26.name: Maim
26.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Sabertooth's {Flurry Swipes} casts an additional time when used.

28.name: Lead The Pack
28.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Wolves' howls also grant increased critical strike chance to you and your allies.

29.name: Venom Spray
29.description: While Frenzy Totem is active, your Scorpion's {Venom Nova} hits in a larger area.

2.name: Unstable Arrival
2.description: Teleport knocks enemies back from your destination once you arrive.

3.name: Frigid Departure
3.description: You have have a higher chance to freeze enemies if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

4.name: Mana Tunnel
4.description: After casting Teleport your next direct spell cast refunds its mana cost, but Teleport has a longer cooldown.

5.name: Tunnel Finder
5.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown.

6.name: Crystaline Passage
6.description: You have higher cold resistance and armor if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

7.name: Time Dilation
7.description: Stat buffs granted by having cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds) last longer.

8.name: Decoy Position
8.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you depart. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.

9.name: Unexpected Copy
9.description: Teleport creates a {Mirror Image} where you arrive. Mirror Images count as minions and will taunt nearby enemies for 10 seconds, then disappear. Teleport costs more mana.

10.name: Uncontrolled Duplication
10.description: Teleport creates additional {Mirror Images} on arrival. Mirror images have a shorter duration.

11.name: Stable Duplicants
11.description: {Mirror Images} last longer.

12.name: Ether Barrier
12.description: Teleport grants ward on cast.

13.name: Out of Mind
13.description: When you use Teleport, you are granted ward equal to your intelligence stat.

14.name: Stable Bubble
14.description: You have increased ward retention if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

15.name: Resonant Plasma
15.description: You have higher lightning resistance, fire resistance, and stun avoidance if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

16.name: Intense Arrival
16.description: Teleport knocks enemies further back.

17.name: Flicker
17.description: Teleport costs less mana.

18.name: Wormhole
18.description: Your other skills recover more quickly if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

19.name: Elemental Affinity
19.description: You deal increased elemental damage if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

20.name: Elemental Dawn
20.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you arrive.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

21.name: Elemental Dusk
21.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova where you depart.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

22.name: Elemental Midnight
22.description:
Teleport casts Elemental Nova halfway between your arrival and departure points.

This node does not work if Elemental Nova has a cooldown.

23.name: Out of Body
23.description: Casting Teleport converts a percentage of your current health into twice as much ward.

24.name: Rock Phase
24.description: You cannot be stunned if you have cast Teleport recently (past 4 seconds).

26.name: Comet Rush
26.description: Teleport has a shorter cooldown and if you have {Haste} when you cast Teleport its duration is reset.

2.name: Toxic Tips
2.description: Shurikens has a chance to poison enemies.

3.name: Weighted Projectiles
3.description: Shurikens penetrates enemy physical resistance.

4.name: Deep Cuts
4.description: Shurikens has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

6.name: Flip of a Coin
6.description: You have a chance to throw many additional Shurikens with each throw.

7.name: Entry Points
7.description: Shurikens hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed or poison on the target up to a maximum.

8.name: Throwing Star
8.description: Shurikens are now be thrown at enemies all around you rather than in a cone in front of you.

9.name: Scintillant Steel
9.description: Shurikens deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and costs less mana.

10.name: Keen Throw
10.description: {Chakram} hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each projectile you would release with Shurikens.

11.name: Behind the Veil
11.description: Shurikens has a chance to {Blind} enemies.

12.name: Acrobatics
12.description: You backflip away from target direction when you use Shurikens, but it now has a cooldown.

13.name: Exuberance
13.description: Shurikens has a shorter cooldown and you gain {Haste} for a short duration if it hits at least one enemy.

14.name: Stagger
14.description: Shurikens {Immobilizes} enemies on hit, causing them to be unable to move for a short duration.

15.name: Alacrity
15.description: Shurikens has increased attack speed.

16.name: Charged Steel
16.description:
Shurikens deals additional lightning damage and a percentage of its base physical damage is converted to Lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Shurikens gains a {Lightning} tag. If all its base dam…

17.name: Shuriken Storm
17.description: Shurikens shocks enemies on hit.

18.name: Abrasive Arsenal
18.description: Shurikens has a chance to shred enemy physical and poison resistance.

19.name: Ricochet
19.description:
Shurikens ricochets to different targets up to a maximum number of times, but costs more mana.

Pierce chance is converted to additional critical strike multiplier.

20.name: Fan of Blades
20.description: You throw additional Shurikens with each throw.

21.name: Blade Shield
21.description: You now summon your Shurikens in a shield around you for 3 seconds. This effect does not stack.

22.name: Bladed Armor
22.description: You have increased armor per Shuriken spinning around you.

23.name: Floating Blades
23.description: {Blade Shield} lasts longer.

24.name: Aerodynamic
24.description:
Shurikens travel faster and farther.

This does not affect {Chakram.}

25.name: Deadly Aim
25.description:
Shurikens are now thrown in a straight line and they can hit the same target, but you throw half as many (rounded up).

This has no effect if you have the {Blade Shield} node.

27.name: Ethereal Blades
27.description: Shurikens has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit).

28.name: Jagged Edges
28.description: Improves Shurikens' base critical strike chance and Shurikens deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Massacre
29.description: Shurikens' critical strikes deal more damage.

30.name: Chakram
30.description:
You now throw a single returning {Chakram} instead of multiple Shurikens. 

Chakram has significant increased size and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Safeguard
2.description: Eterra's Blessing grants elemental and poison resistance.

3.name: Embolden
3.description: Your next spell after casting Eterra's Blessing deals increased damage.

4.name: Lifestream
4.description: After casting Eterra's Blessing, your spells leech a portion of the damage they deal as health for 4 seconds.

5.name: Natural Affinity
5.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing grants stun immunity for 4 seconds.

6.name: Caustic Renewal
6.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Scorpion} companion, you are both granted a chance to poison enemies with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

7.name: Symbiosis
7.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Sabertooth} or {Raptor} companions, you are both granted a chance to cause enemies to bleed with attacks and spells for 4 seconds.

8.name: Ardent Touch
8.description: When cast on a minion, Eterra's Blessing also grants increased movement, attack, and cast speed for 4 seconds.

9.name: Encourage
9.description: When Eterra's Blessing heals one of your companions it has a chance to refresh its activated ability cooldown, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

10.name: Swift Recovery
10.description: When Eterra's Blessing targets a downed companion, it heals them for a portion of their maximum downed duration.

11.name: Eterra's Furor
11.description: When you directly cast Eterra's Blessing on a companion it taunts nearby enemies for 4 seconds. However Eterra's Blessing now has a long cooldown.

12.name: Binding Heal
12.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on one of your companions, you also heal yourself for a portion of its base heal amount.

13.name: Triage
13.description: Eterra's Blessing automatically targets the lowest health ally in range, but Eterra's Blessing costs more mana.

14.name: Soul Bond
14.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Spriggan} companion, you are both granted increased spell damage for 4 seconds.

15.name: Overgrowth
15.description: Eterra's Blessing has a chance to heal all allies nearby its target for 50 health.

16.name: Conservation
16.description: Eterra's Blessing costs less mana.

18.name: Rebuke
18.description: Eterra's Blessing knocks back enemies a given distance from its target.

20.name: Rosebloom
20.description:
Whenever you directly cast Thorn Shield, you also cast Eterra's Blessing on the same target.

Consumes Eterra's Blessing's mana cost as rage.

21.name: Skyboon
21.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your Storm Crow companions, they are granted {Haste} and Frenzy for 5 seconds.

23.name: Improved Blessing
23.description: Eterra's Blessing has increased healing effectiveness.

24.name: Purge
24.description: Eterra's Blessing cleanses all ailments on its target.

26.name: Efflorescence
26.description: Eterra's Blessing heals half of its value immediately, and half of its value over 4 seconds.

27.name: Regrowth
27.description: When {Efflorescence's} heal over time expires, heal again for half of Eterra's Blessing's value.

28.name: Tranquil Spirit
28.description: When you are out of mana Eterra's Blessing is free, but Eterra's Blessing can no longer provide additional buffs.

29.name: Ancestral Renewal
29.description: When you heal a target that is already at high health, you have a chance to summon a {Healing Totem} at its location which heals nearby allies.

30.name: Boon of the Shifter
30.description: Eterra's Blessing heals for more if you have transformed recently (last 4 seconds).

32.name: Savage Boon
32.description: When Eterra's Blessing is cast on your {Wolf} or {Bear} companions, you are both granted increased physical damage for 4 seconds.

1.name: Ironbound
1.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance, and critical strikes deal more damage.

2.name: Lightforge
2.description: Forge Strike has increased cooldown recovery speed and attack speed. The attack speed bonus also applies to your Forged Weapons.

3.name: Arcane Welding
3.description: You are granted ward when Forge Strike summons a {Forged Weapon}.

4.name: Rewarding Craft
4.description: {Forged Weapons} no longer move or attack, but generate ward when you are near them.

5.name: Singular Craft
5.description: Improves Forge Strike's base critical chance and its hits inflict bleeding on hit, but your maximum number of {Forged Weapons} is halved.

6.name: Put to the Sword
6.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a sword that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has more attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers), cannot crit, and critical strike multiplier from the tree is converted to additional Physical Penetration for Bleed.

Converts to a pol…

7.name: Spear Forge
7.description:
Converts Forge Strike into a spear that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike critical strikes deal significantly more damage, but it hits in a smaller area.

Converts to a polearm if you also have the {Put To The Sword} node.

8.name: Heavy Strike
8.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

9.name: Rending Descent
9.description: Forge Strike hits reduce enemy armor.

10.name: Eagle Strike
10.description: Forge Strike can now be cast at your target instead of in front of you.

11.name: Reinforce Weapon
11.description: You deal additional melee damage if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

12.name: Reinforce Armor
12.description: You have increased armor if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

14.name: Goliath Strike
14.description: Forge Strike hits deal more damage against rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Engines of War
15.description: Forge Strike and {Forged Weapons'} hits deal damage in a larger area

16.name: Anvil Blow
16.description: Converts Forge Strike into an anvil that falls from the sky instead. Forge Strike has an increased chance to stun enemies, stuns it inflicts lasts longer, and it deals additional physical damage.

17.name: Temper
17.description: Forge Strike hits deal additional melee fire damage.

18.name: Detonating Ground
18.description: Forge Strike causes {Detonating Ground}, sending out cracks which erupt after 1.5 seconds, dealing melee fire damage and igniting enemies.

19.name: Lava Burn
19.description: {Detonating Ground} hits deal more damage.

20.name: Ignited Grounds
20.description: {Detonating Ground} has a chance to ignite enemies on hit.

21.name: Forged by Fire
21.description: {Forged Weapons} deal additional melee fire damage.

22.name: Well Forged Weapons
22.description: {Forged Weapons} last longer and you can control more forged weapons at once.

23.name: Forgemaster
23.description: {Forged Weapons} now have a chance to become a {Great Axe} on summon, which deal damage in a larger area.

24.name: Mass Production
24.description: Forge Strike has a higher chance to summon {Forged Weapons}. This added chance is much higher against bosses and rare enemies.

25.name: Shrapnel
25.description: {Forged Weapons} have a much shorter duration, but deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and explode when they expire, dealing fire and physical damage to nearby enemies.

26.name: Serrated Blade
26.description: Bleed inflicted by Forge Strike has additional Physical Penetration and lasts longer.

28.name: Beneath Solarum
28.description: Forge Strike has no cooldown, but costs additional mana.

29.name: Bellows
29.description: Ailments inflicted by Forge Strike deal increased damage over time equal to your increased stun chance.

30.name: Fan The Flames
30.description: You have additional global Fire Penetration if you have used Forge Strike recently (last 4 seconds).

0.name: Dancing Strikes
0.description: A series of fast dash attacks.

2.name: Slicing
2.description: Dancing Strikes penetrates enemy physical resistance.

3.name: Dark Blades
3.description: Dancing Strikes inflicts enemies with {Shadow Dagger}.

4.name: Grievious Wounds
4.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

5.name: Trickling Cuts
5.description: You deal more global damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.

6.name: Contaminate
6.description: All bleed chance is converted to poison chance with Dancing Strikes. Physical penetration from this tree converted to poison penetration.

7.name: Majasa's Dagger
7.description: Dancing Strikes deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per poison stacks on the target up to a maximum.

8.name: Silent Death
8.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to poison enemies, but deals less physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Snake Bites
9.description: Dancing Strikes hits deal more damage to bleeding and poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Eluding Steps
10.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating for a short duration on use.

11.name: Nimble
11.description: Dancing Strikes grants you additional dodge rating per point of Dexterity for a short duration on use.

12.name: Underdog
12.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Graceful Arena
13.description:
Dancing Strikes' third attack creates a {Fighting Arena} for 4 seconds.

Fighting inside the arena you deal increased damage and take less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Lacerating Aura
14.description: You and allies fighting inside the arena have a high chance to cause enemies to bleed.

15.name: Close Combat
15.description: Dancing Strikes deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) but you travel less far between each attack.

16.name: Tenacious Vitae
16.description: You take less damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) for a short duration after using Dancing Strikes.

17.name: Resolute Technique
17.description: {Lethal Mirage} and {Synchronized Strikes} deal increased damage for each time you have used Dancing Strikes recently.

18.name: Invigorating Moves
18.description: Dancing Strikes' third attack heals you if it hits at least one enemy.

19.name: Quick Step
19.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to grant you {Haste} for 2 seconds on use.

20.name: Windmill Ballet
20.description: Dancing Strikes' second and fourth attack have a chance to throw {Shurikens} in target direction.

21.name: Broad Dancing
21.description: Dancing Strikes deals damage in a larger area.

22.name: Cutting Corners
22.description: Dancing Strikes has a chance to shred enemy armor.

23.name: Rhythm
23.description: When you use Dancing Strikes and hit at least one enemy, you gain a stack of {Rhythm} for a short duration and refresh all existing stacks, granting you increased global damage per stack.

24.name: Elegance
24.description: You have increased dodge rating per stack of {Rhythm}.

25.name: Refined Cuts
25.description: You have a global chance to cause enemies to bleed per stack of {Rhythm}.

26.name: Art of Blades
26.description: Your critical strikes deal more damage per stack of {Rhythm}.

27.name: Perfect Choreography
27.description: Each stack of {Rhythm} also grants 5% more global damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Dancing Strikes cost more mana.

28.name: Sophisticated Stabs
28.description: Dancing Strikes' first attack shreds enemy armor.

29.name: Shadow Steps
29.description: Dancing Strikes' second attack creates a {Shadow}, but Dancing Strikes costs more mana.

30.name: Deadly Waltz
30.description: Dancing Strikes shreds enemy physical resistance.

31.name: Rupture
31.description: Your next {Puncture} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) after using Dancing Strikes.

32.name: Hidden Blade
32.description: You have a chance to use {Shadow Cascade} when you use Dancing Strikes.

2.name: Adept
2.description: Snap Freeze has increased cast speed.

3.name: Flash Freeze
3.description: Snap Freeze has a shorter cooldown, but Freeze inflicted by Snap Freeze has reduced duration.

4.name: Gale Force
4.description: Snap Freeze knocks enemies back.

5.name: Lasting Cold
5.description: Snap Freeze has a chance to chill enemies.

6.name: Permafrost
6.description: Chill caused by Snap Freeze has increased duration. If you have taken the {Snap Shock} node, this increases Shock duration instead.

7.name: Shatter
7.description: Snap Freeze hits and deals spell cold damage and can apply on-hit effects, but costs more mana.

8.name: Deathly cold
8.description: Snap Freeze hits deal additional spell cold damage.

9.name: Snap Shock
9.description:
Snap Freeze no longer freezes and its base cold damage is converted to lightning damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Adds 4 lighting damage for each second of freeze duration. \r
\r
All chill chance is …

10.name: Focused Current
10.description: Improves Snap Freeze’s base critical strike chance.

11.name: Electrocute
11.description: Snap Freeze critical strikes deal more damage.

12.name: Spark Surge
12.description: Snap Freeze hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of {Shock} on the target.

13.name: Snow Flurry
13.description: Snap Freeze costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown.

14.name: Frostbite
14.description: Snap Freeze inflicts {Frostbite} on all enemies within its area of effect.

12.description: Frost Claw has a higher chance to freeze based on its critical strike chance.

13.name: Kolheim Ballista
13.description: If you have an active {Ice Barrage} when you hit an enemy with Frost Claw, that Ice Barrage fires faster for the rest of its duration, up to a maximum.

14.name: Power Word: Hail
14.description:
You have a chance to cast {Ice Barrage} in the target direction when you cast Frost Claw.

This consumes mana equal to Ice Barrage's mana cost and cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

16.name: Shiver Shell
16.description:
When you are hit by an enemy you have a chance to retaliate with Frost Claw.

When you cast Frost Claw by any method you gain Ward.

17.name: Reowyn's Veil
17.description: When you cast Frost Claw you gain ward based on its Freeze Rate Multiplier.

18.name: Macuahuitl
18.description: When you use a Melee Attack and hit at least one enemy you have a chance to cast Frost Claw at it, or at another nearby enemy if the hit killed the original target.

20.name: Frozen Sleeper
20.description: Gain a stack of Frozen Sleeper every second up to a maximum. When you cast Frost Claw it consumes all stacks to gain cold penetration per stack and release an {Ice Spiral} for each stack.

21.name: Chaos Whirl
21.description: When you cast {Ice Spirals} there is a chance that the number of projectiles will be doubled and they'll all deal double damage.

22.name: Age of Vengeance
22.description: For each active {Ice Spiral}, Glacier gains increased area and additional cold penetration, and Snap Freeze gains increased area and freeze duration.

24.name: On Through The Snow
24.description:
Directly casting Frost Claw causes it to recast from the target location to a location 4 meters behind it. The second can hit the same enemies as the first cast.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

25.name: Ever Onward
25.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} causes a third cast. The third cast can hit the same enemies as the first and second casts.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

26.name: Frozen Malice
26.description:
The second cast from {On Through The Snow} targets a random enemy that is 3 to 9 meters away from the original target location.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

27.name: A Crack in the Ice
27.description:
When the second cast from {On Through The Snow} is released, Frost Claw is also cast back towards you.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

28.name: Hand of Morditas
28.description:
Frost Claw has 2 additional projectiles allowing it to hit enemies in a wider area on the way to the target.

Frost Claw costs additional mana.

29.name: Volley of Glass
29.description:
Frost Claw no longer creates a burst of damage at the target, but its projectiles are now staggered and they can all hit the same target.

Frost Claw's mana cost is increased.

30.name: Frozen Reign
30.description: Frost Claw has a lower mana cost and it deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to frozen enemies, but its projectiles are slower.

32.name: Spark of Celerity
32.description: Frost Claw's projectiles are faster and it costs less mana.

2.name: Bone Armor
2.description:
When you use Transplant you are granted {Bone Armor} for 4 seconds, which grants armor and less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).\r
\r
This effect has a 10 second cooldown.\r

3.name: Plated Bone
3.description: {Bone Armor} is more effective.

4.name: Fleeting Form
4.description: Transplant as increased cast speed and cooldown recovery speed.

5.name: Apostasy
5.description: {Bone Armor} lasts longer.

6.name: Drink Deep
6.description: Transplant's health cost is regenerated over 4 seconds, but costs significantly more health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.name: Marrow Blades
7.description: Your minions deal additional melee damage for 4 seconds after you cast Transplant.

8.name: Simulacrum
8.description: You leave behind a {Bone Minion}, which is a temporary melee minion, when you use Transplant, but your previous body no longer detonates. Other detonations still behave normally.

9.name: Transfusion
9.description: You may Transplant to minions, which sacrifices the minion. Sacrifice cast this way uses your Sacrifice Tree and deals more damage than usual (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Purgatory
10.description: {Bone Minions} last until killed, but you may have only 1 active at a time.

11.name: Ivory Court
11.description: You can summon more {Bone Minions}.

12.name: Scarlet Rain
12.description: Transplant’s detonations deal damage in a larger area.

13.name: Cursed Exile
13.description: Transplant deals more hit damage to cursed enemies. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Bone Curse restore health. Transplant hits against enemies afflicted with Spirit Plague grant ward.

14.name: Ethereal Body
14.description: Transplant's base physical damage is converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

15.name: Squeamish
15.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on departure.

16.name: Thanatophobia
16.description: Transplant inflicts surrounding enemies with {Fear} on arrival.

17.name: Reign of Blood
17.description: Transplant creates an additional body that detonates on arrival.

18.name: Acolyte's Fervor
18.description: Casting Transplant grants you {Haste} and {Frenzy} for a short duration.

19.name: Doom Bringer
19.description: You cast Bone Curse around the target location after you arrive.

20.name: Hemophilia
20.description: Explosions cause enemies to bleed, but using Transplant also causes you to bleed.

21.name: Sticky Blood
21.description: Transplant detonations leave a {Pool of Blood} for 3 seconds that slows enemies.

22.name: Anemia
22.description: Transplant costs less health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Siphon
23.description: {Pools of Blood} heal you for a percentage of your total health when you walk on them.

24.name: Dance of Blood
24.description: You automatically cast {Rip Blood} at enemies nearby where you depart, but Transplant costs more health (multiplicative with other modifiers). An enemy cannot be hit by multiple instances of Rip Blood created this way.

25.name: Azure Veins
25.description: When you hit an enemy with Transplant you regain mana, but lose a portion of your current health and ward.

26.name: Pale Blood
26.description: Transplant restores mana, but has a longer cooldown.

27.name: Flesh Marquis
27.description: Transplant detonation hits deal more damage, especially to bleeding enemies.

28.name: Forced Fruition
28.description: When you are out of mana, Transplant detonations deal more damage.

30.name: Violent Emergence
30.description:
Transplant explosions instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health). \r
\r
If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node, then the highest threshold is used. \r

2.name: Higher Plane
2.description: Arcane Ascendance grants you increased spell damage while active.

3.name: Arcane Absorption
3.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, each hit you take increases your spell damage and cast speed, but drains your mana.

4.name: Power Overload
4.description: You are granted increased spell damage each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

5.name: Unstable Energy
5.description: You are granted increased cast speed each second while Arcane Ascendance is active.

6.name: Chronoclasm
6.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to slow enemies over 5 meters away and you deal more damage to enemies per stack of slow on them.

7.name: Mana Surge
7.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you are granted mana whenever you kill an enemy that is over 5 meters away.

8.name: Chains of Ice
8.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, whenever you kill a frozen enemy a nearby enemy is frozen for a duration.

9.name: Power Sprint
9.description: You are granted {Haste} for a duration after leaving Arcane Ascendance. The duration is capped at 200% of the time you spent in Arcane Ascendance.

10.name: Arcane Rift
10.description: You regain mana while you enter Arcane Ascendance, but the mana is lost when you exit Arcane Ascendance.

11.name: Cosmic Insight
11.description: Arcane Ascendance has a shorter cooldown.

12.name: Rebuff
12.description: You gain ward when you activate Arcane Ascendance.

14.name: Frozen Monolith
14.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, your spells and attacks that can freeze enemies have a higher chance to do so.

15.name: Force Of Mind
15.description: You knock back all nearby enemies when you enter Arcane Ascendance.

16.name: Superconductor
16.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you automatically cast {Lightning Blast} when you hit an enemy. Lightning Blast uses its skill tree and you lose mana equal to Lightning Blast's cost. This effect has a 2 second cooldown.

17.name: Closed Circuit
17.description: Lightning Blast cast by {Superconductor} triggers more frequently.

18.name: Slow Breathing
18.description: Arcane Ascendance drains less mana per second.

19.name: Tranquility
19.description: All of your spells cost less mana while Arcane Ascendance is active, but you cannot regenerate mana while Arcane Ascendance is active.

21.name: Cold Front
21.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to chill enemies over 5 meters away.

22.name: Shocking Expanse
22.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, spells and attacks have a chance to shock enemies over 5 meters away.

23.name: Mark Of Thunder
23.description: While Arcane Ascendance is active, you {Mark} enemies you hit that are over 5 meters away. When you exit Arcane Ascendance, you consume all marks, dealing lightning damage to affected enemies.

24.name: Acuity
24.description: Arcane Ascendance now has a 2 second cooldown and no longer drains your mana. You can cast 4 spells before Arcane Ascendance ends automatically. Lasts 12 seconds.

25.name: Cunning
25.description: You can cast more spells via {Acuity}, but Arcane Ascendance has a longer cooldown.

26.name: Glyph of Lightning
26.description: {Mark Of Thunder} deals more damage when it is consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

0.name: Dark Quiver
0.description:
Requires a bow.

Summons 7 {Black Arrows} which rain from the sky over 4 seconds, granting bonus damage to your next bow attack when retrieved.

2.name: Scourge Quiver
2.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased damage over time to your next bow attack.

3.name: Crimson Quiver
3.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

4.name: Rending Shots
4.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to shred enemy physical resistance to your next bow attack.

5.name: Mending
5.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores health.

6.name: Nightfall
6.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you a stack of {Dusk Shroud} for 4 seconds, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

7.name: Arrow of the Trickster
7.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} creates a {Shadow} at the arrow's location.

8.name: Quick Draw
8.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants you the Frenzy buff, granting you 20% increased attack and cast speed for a short duration.

9.name: Heavy Arrows
9.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional physical damage to your next bow attack.

10.name: Heartseeker
10.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased critical strike chance to your next bow attack.

11.name: Trueshot
11.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Multishot} to pierce additional enemies (continue through targets they hit).

12.name: Fatal Barrage
12.description: Using a {Black Arrow} improves your next {Flurry's} base critical strike chance.

13.name: Archer's Focus
13.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to your next bow attack, but consume additional mana.

14.name: Fiery Vengeance
14.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} resets the combo of {Cinder Strike}.

15.name: Dragon Slayer
15.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Cinder Strike} to instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

16.name: Resolve
16.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} restores mana.

17.name: Umbral Resolution
17.description:
Using a {Black Arrow} consumes all active {Shadows} to grant your next bow attack more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per {Shadow} consumed.

Consuming at least 3 {Shadows} grants significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Lacerating Arrows
18.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants {Puncture} additional physical penetration and bleed chance.

19.name: Toxic Quiver
19.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants additional poison penetration and poison chance to your next bow attack.

20.name: Large Quiver
20.description: Additional {Black Arrows} are summoned, but the arrows are summoned at the same frequency causing {Dark Quiver} to have a longer duration.

21.name: Nature's Focus
21.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants increased elemental damage to your next bow attack.

22.name: Elemental Adept
22.description: Using a {Black Arrow} grants a chance to freeze, shock or ignite enemies, depending on the element, to your next bow elemental attack.

23.name: Grand Detonation
23.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Detonating Arrow} to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

24.name: Crippling Arrows
24.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} slows nearby enemies for a short duration.

25.name: Fend Off
25.description: Picking up a {Black Arrow} knocks nearby enemies back 4 meters.

26.name: Accessible
26.description: {Black Arrows} are summoned more frequently. This does not cause more arrows to be summoned and also causes {Dark Quiver} to have a shorter duration.

27.name: Quickened Arrows
27.description: You instantly summon a number of {Black Arrows} on use. The rest are spread out over the normal duration.

28.name: Until Dawn
28.description: Using a bow attack grants you a chance to summon a {Black Arrow} at a random nearby location. This effect has a 3 second cooldown.

29.name: Tide of Darkness
29.description: Using a {Black Arrow} causes your next {Hail of Arrows} to deal increased damage over time equal to twice your critical strike chance.

30.name: Perfect Bolts
30.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} additional bow physical damage while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

31.name: Keen Shots
31.description:
Picking up a {Black Arrow} grants active {Ballistae} increased attack speed while they are alive.

This effect stacks up to 4 times.

32.name: Heavy Artillery
32.description: {Ballistae} that have been buffed by at least 4 {Black Arrows} always critically strike.

0.name: Detonating Arrow
0.description:
Requires a bow.

Fires an arrow that attatches itself in a target then explodes after 0.6 seconds. Added bow damage is converted to lightning damage.

2.name: Quick Detonation
2.description: Detonating Arrow has increased critical strike chance and it has reduced arming time.

3.name: Weak Spot
3.description: Detonating Arrow critical strikes deal more damage and it has a chance to apply {Critical Vulnerability} to enemies, making them easier to critically strike.

4.name: Barrage
4.description: Detonating Arrow now explodes on impact in a cone behind the target rather than a circle, but no longer has an arming time.

5.name: Dragon Arrow
5.description:
The explosion base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to shock now depend on ignite instea…

6.name: Outburst
6.description: The explosion deals damage in a larger area.

7.name: Jolting Charge
7.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies, but the explosion hit deals less hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Infused Discharge
8.description: Detonating Arrow consumes a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to the mana consumed.

9.name: Well Crafted
9.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

10.name: Thundersteel Arrow
10.description:
Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has an increased chance to stun, but now has a cooldown. 

The explosion deals damage in a significantly larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Loaded Quiver
11.description: You can store an additional charge of Detonating Arrow.

12.name: Rapid Detonation
12.description: If an enemy has an attached Detonating Arrow and gets hit again, it explodes the first arrow immediately.

13.name: Frostfang Arrow
13.description:
Detonating Arrow's base lightning damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to lightning damage. It also gains a base freeze rate.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to chill chance.

Swaps Detonating…

14.name: Frozen Resonance
14.description: Detonating Arrow has a higher chance based on your uncapped Cold Resistance.

15.name: Arrow of Delay
15.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less movement speed (multiplicative with other modifiers) while they have an arrow attached.

16.name: Delayed Detonation
16.description: Detonating Arrow has a longer arming time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Beastslayer Arrow
17.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a longer arming time. The explosion deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second the arrow spent arming.

18.name: Copper Dust Arrow
18.description: Detonating Arrow causes enemies to have less elemental resistance while they have an arrow attached.

19.name: Lethal Blast
19.description: The explosion hit deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 5% health the enemy is missing.

20.name: Concentration
20.description: The explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Aimed Shot
21.description: Detonating Arrow can now be charged up for up to 2 seconds, causing it to pierce a number of enemies (continue through targets it hits) per 0.5 seconds charged up.

22.name: Pinpoint
22.description: Detonating Arrow deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per second charged up.

23.name: Shock Arrow
23.description: Detonating Arrow has a chance to shock enemies.

24.name: Navigator's Shot
24.description: Detonating Arrow now slightly seeks out targets.

26.name: Suckerpunch Arrow
26.description:
When you hit an enemy with Detonating Arrow that already has an arrow attached to them, the explosion deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers). 

{Suckerpunch Arrow} will not attach an additional Detonating Arrow.

27.name: Fastshot
27.description: Detonating Arrow has increased attack speed and shock applied by this skill last longer.

28.name: Arcing Blast
28.description:
The explosion causes {Lightning Tendrils} to chain out to nearby targets. 

This has no effect if Detonating Arrow's damage is converted.

29.name: Piercing Thunder
29.description: {Lightning Tendrils} penetrate a portion of enemy lightning resistance and have a chance to shock enemies.

30.name: Scorpion Arrow
30.description:
The explosion now poisons enemies on hit, but its hits deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

Detonating Arrow's base damage is convered to Physical. Consequently this damage scales with increases to physical damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Sh…

32.name: Mana Arrow
32.description: Detonating arrow no longer costs mana and instead restores mana when you directly use it and hit at least one enemy. However it now only has a small chance of exploding.

34.name: Deadly Ailments
34.description: Ailments inflicted by Detonating Arrow deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Ash Compartment
2.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and its hits shred enemy fire resistance.

3.name: Hold This
3.description:
Whenever you hit an enemy with any melee attack you attach an Explosive Trap to that enemy.

This effect has a 1.5 second cooldown and attached traps explode after 1 second ignoring arming time or when the enemy it's attached to dies. Enemies cannot have more than 1 trap attac…

4.name: Aspect of the Rabbit
4.description:
Attached traps deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If the enemy that the Explosive Trap is attached to hits you, it now attaches to you instead (but will still only damage enemies). Hitting an enemy then attaches it back to them without changing the delay …

5.name: Arrow Traps
5.description:
When an Explosive Trap detonates, all other Explosive Traps now also detonate in quick succession and fire {Detonating Arrows} at the original target trap's location.

This effect consumes mana equal to a portion of your {Detonating Arrow's} mana cost.

6.name: Blasting Device
6.description: {Detonating Arrows} fired this way deal additional bow damage per 3 Dexterity.

7.name: Static Mines
7.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to lightning. Consequently this damage scales with increases to lightning damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to lightning resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's…

8.name: Lightning Bomb
8.description: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to shock enemies and inflict them with a {Spark Charge}.

9.name: Trapas
9.description:
When directly using Explosive Trap, an unconverted Explosive Trap and a trap corresponding to each conversion node you have taken are thrown at the same time. Traps thrown this way are thrown in a small area.

Additionally, Explosive Trap deals less damage in a smaller area (b…

10.name: Coldsnap Mines
10.description:
Explosive Trap's base fire damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to fire damage.

Fire resistance shred chance from all sources is converted to cold resistance shred.

Swaps Explosive Trap's {Fire} tag for…

11.name: Flash Frozen
11.description:
Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to chill enemies.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has additional freeze rate per Intelligence.

12.name: Freezing Trap
12.description:
When you directly throw Explosive Trap, its hits always freeze enemies, but it now has a cooldown.

Whenever you freeze an enemy with any skill a portion of Explosive Trap's remaining cooldown is recovered.

13.name: Tinkerer's Design
13.description: Explosive Trap is now triggered from farther away and deals damage in a larger area.

14.name: Adaptive Fuse
14.description:
Particularly fast enemies (with a movement speed above 6 meters per second) trigger Explosive Traps instantly, even if they haven't armed.

Additionally, Explosive Trap's hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to moving enemies.

15.name: Prepared Demolition
15.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area for each second it has existed before detonating up to a maximum.

16.name: Gadgeteer
16.description: Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifeirs) if the arming time is not ignored, but it takes longer for it to arm before it can detonate.

17.name: Smoke Traps
17.description: Explosive Trap's hits have a chance to grant you a stack of {Dusk Shroud}. This chance increases for each second it spends arming.

18.name: Umbral Saboteur
18.description: Explosive Trap deals additional throwing damage per stack of {Dusk Shroud} you have.

19.name: Jelkhor's Blueprint
19.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana and it has increased throwing attack speed.

20.name: Sky Signal
20.description:
Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate your {Falcon} gains physical and elemental penetration for a short duration.

This buff can stack an unlimited amount of times.

21.name: Free Lofting Bird
21.description: Whenever one of your Explosive Traps detonate your {Falcon's} skills recover a portion of their remaining cooldowns.

22.name: No Man's Land
22.description:
Whenever you directly throw Explosive Trap you now throw traps, up to your maximum number of traps, in a wide area around the target location.

Explosive Trap deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per maximum traps, but it now has a cooldown and costs more ma…

23.name: Minefield
23.description: You can now have more active Explosive Traps.

24.name: Clustered Explosives
24.description: You now throw additional Explosive Traps per use, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

25.name: Subtle Sabotage
25.description: Explosive Trap costs less mana, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a smaller area.

26.name: Blast Rain
26.description:
You now shoot arrows attached with Explosive Traps up into the air that then drop down around the target location.

Explosive Trap now scales with your bow damage instead of throwing damage and your bow attack speed instead of throwing attack speed.

This requires wielding a bow.

27.name: Impact Trigger
27.description:
Explosive Traps now instantly detonate when the arrows hit the ground via the {Blast Rain} node, ignoring the arming time.

Additionally, Explosive Trap has a higher chance to stun enemies.

28.name: Trap Sprinkler
28.description: Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates it has a chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap at its location, as long as there is an enemy within 6 meters.

29.name: Automated Bombardment
29.description:
Explosive Trap has an additional chance to drop a fresh Explosive Trap via the {Trap Sprinkler} node, but Explosive Trap costs more mana.

Traps dropped this way cannot drop more additional traps.

30.name: Siege Engineering
30.description:
Whenever an Explosive Trap detonates it now has a chance to create a {Ballista} for you.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of {Ballista's} mana cost.

31.name: Trapuchet
31.description:
Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node are now instead flung at a nearby enemy within 12 meters, rather than being dropped.

Explosive Traps dropped by the {Trap Sprinkler} node can now drop Explosive Traps when there's an enemy within 12 meters even if there is …

32.name: Instrument of the Alchemist
32.description:
When an Explosive Trap drops a trap by the {Trap Sprinkler} node it also flings an {Acid Flask} for you towards the target location.

This consumes mana equal to a portion of Acid Flask's mana cost.

2.name: Death by a Thousand Wings
2.description: Your Armblade Slash, Dive and {Locust} hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

3.name: Bloodlust Swarm
3.description:
When you create a {Locust Swarm} with Swarm Strike you consume all stacks of bleed from enemies hit by it, causing the {Swarm} to deal increased damage in a larger area per stack of bleed consumed.

The increased area scales up to a maximum.

4.name: Feverous Stings
4.description: Yours and your {Locusts'} hits have a chance to poison enemies.

5.name: Grand Colony
5.description: You can control additional {Locusts} and your Hives contain additional {Locusts}.

6.name: Hive Mind
6.description: Hives release {Locusts} more frequently and if you have an active {Locust Swarm} it also releases Locusts every second.

7.name: Swarmkeeper's Call
7.description:
After using Summon Hive, Human Form is now replaced with {Cleanse Hives}, which releases all {Locusts} from up to 2 Hives, replaces them with {Healing Totems} and transforms you to {Spriggan Form}.

This requires you to have Spriggan Form unlocked.

8.name: Bountiful Hibernacula
8.description: When a {Hive} releases a {Locust} you regain health and {Rage}.

9.name: Release the Horde
9.description: Your Armblade Slash can now hit your own Hives which causes them to release {Locusts}.

10.name: Frost Bites
10.description: The base damage of Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm}, and Dive is converted to cold, and {Locusts'} base melee damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. These attack all also gain a chance to fr…

11.name: Chitin Sleet Storm
11.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance of freezing enemies per point of Attunement.

12.name: Spiked Vespiary
12.description: Your Hives now cast {Thorns} as if they were {Thorn Totems}, rather than releasing {Locusts}. They can cast thorns a limited number of times equal to the number of Locusts they would have released.

13.name: Locust Agility
13.description: You and your {Locusts} have a higher chance to dodge and additional armor while in Swarmblade Form.

14.name: Water Strider
14.description:
You cast {Maelstrom} a number of times when you Dive. 

This consumes a portion of Maelstrom's mana cost as {Rage}.

15.name: Springer's Fury
15.description: You gain {Rage} when you dodge.

16.name: Ironclad Beetle
16.description: All of your dodge rating is converted to armor while in Swarmblade Form.

17.name: Slashing Spiral
17.description: Your Swarm Strike, {Locust Swarm} and your {Locusts'} melee attacks all deal damage in a larger area.

18.name: Vampiric Mandibles
18.description: Your {Locust Swarm} leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health to you.

20.name: Neverending Drove
20.description: {Locust Swarm} lasts longer and Swarm Strike hits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Swarm's Fury
21.description:
After using Swarm Strike, Human Form is now replaced with {Angered Swarm}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of your {Locust Swarm} and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

22.name: Inspiring Swarm
22.description: A random active companion uses its active ability after you directly use Swarm Strike.

23.name: Plague of Locusts
23.description: Your {Locust Swarm} deals more damage per {Locust} consumed (multiplicative with other modifiers) and while the Locust Swarm is active you have additional chance to poison on hit per {Locust} consumed.

24.name: Earth Stinger
24.description: You and your {Locusts} deal additional melee physical damage while in Swarmblade Form and your {Locust Swarm} deals additional melee physical damage per active {Locust} consumed when you use Swarm Strike.

25.name: Needle-Like Sting
25.description: You and your {Locusts} have improved base critical strike chance while in Swarmblade Form.

26.name: Hornet Nest
26.description: You can only control half as many {Locusts}, but they have significantly more health, deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers) and are larger.

27.name: Grasshopper's Frenzy
27.description: You regain {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} critically hit.

28.name: Viper's Call
28.description:
Your {Serpent Strike} tree now applies to Armblade Slashes, and it does not require a spear.

This effect does not include the base additional poison chance or increased poison duration from Serpent Strike.

29.name: Endless Pressure
29.description: You regain health and {Rage} when you or your {Locusts} kill an enemy or when you hit a rare enemy or boss.

30.name: Windfury Strikes
30.description:
You gain a stack of {Howling Cascade} when you use Armblade Slash and hit at least one enemy. Reaching 6 stacks consumes them to cast {Tornado}.

This consumes Tornado's mana cost.

31.name: Army of the Tempest
31.description: Reduce the maximum stacks of {Howling Cascade} required to cast {Tornado}, and tornadoes cast via Howling Cascade deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

32.name: Locust Master
32.description:
The first part of the Armblade Slashes combo now has a cooldown. While it is on cooldown Slashes are replaced with {Summon Locust}.

Additionally when you use Armblade Slashes and hit at least one enemy, all existing Locusts gain additional melee physical damage. This buff sta…

34.name: Wasp Flight
34.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Swarmblade form.

35.name: Soaring Scourge
35.description: {Locust Swarm} now scales with your minion damage rather than your damage.

36.name: Carnage
36.description: Swarm Strike and Dive deal more damage and you regain {Rage} on hit with both skills.

2.name: Volley
2.description: Hail of Arrows deals damage in a larger area

3.name: Blot Out the Sun
3.description: You have a chance to gain a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while inside the area, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

4.name: Fight in the Shade
4.description: Hail of Arrows now also grants a stack of {Dusk Shroud} to allies each second for 2 seconds while inside the area.

5.name: Skystrike
5.description: Hail of Arrows now also shoots a {Barrage of Arrows} on use dealing bow physical damage, but costs more mana. This does not scale with damage over time.

6.name: Silver Arrows
6.description: Improves {Barrage of Arrows'} base critical strike chance.

7.name: Condemn
7.description: {Barrage of Arrows} immobilizes enemies for a short duration. Rare enemies and bosses are slowed instead.

8.name: Blighted Arrows
8.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies each second.

9.name: Sundering Rain
9.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to shred enemy armour each second.

10.name: Lethality
10.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to inflict enemies with {Crit Vulnerability} each second.

11.name: Arsonist
11.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Scorched Earth
12.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to ignite chance and effects related to bleed now depend on ignite instea…

13.name: Pristine Fletcher
13.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but in a smaller area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

14.name: Soul Stealer Arrows
14.description: Hail of Arrows leeches a portion of the bow damage it deals as health.

16.name: Focus
16.description: Hail of Arrows deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

17.name: Quick Draw
17.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Backup Volley
18.description: You can store additional charges of Hail of Arrows, but it has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Deadly Draw
19.description: Hail of Arrows costs less mana and has a shorter cooldown, but has a longer delay before the arrows fall.

20.name: Tear Flesh
20.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to cause enemies to bleed each second.

21.name: Aim for the Heart
21.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage per stack of bleed on the enemy, up to a maximum. This does not affect ailment damage.

22.name: Arrow Spray
22.description: Hail of Arrows now fall in a forward advancing rectangle area rather than a circle.

23.name: Pin Down
23.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to slow enemies each second.

24.name: Crystal Arrows
24.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. It also has a chance to freeze enemies each second.

All slow chance from this tree is converted to chill chance and …

25.name: Frost Shots
25.description: Hail of Arrows has increased chance to freeze enemies each second and has increased chill duration.

26.name: Steady
26.description: Hail of Arrows lasts longer.

27.name: Nowhere to Hide
27.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) over its duration scaling up to a maximum. This does not affect damaging ailments.

28.name: The Hunt
28.description:
Hail of Arrows lasts significantly longer (multiplicative with other modifiers), but you can only have one Hail of Arrows active at a time. 

Using Hail of Arrows again causes the old instance to stop.

29.name: Endless Barrage
29.description:
Hail of Arrows is now channeled and can be retargeted while you are channelling. It costs less initial mana, but rapidly drains your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling. 

Channelled Hail of Arrows' delay is halved, and increases to its delay are halved.

30.name: Acid Rain
30.description:
Hail of Arrows' base physical damage is converted to poison. Consequently this damage scales with increases to poison damage, but not increases to physical damage.

Swaps Hail of Arrows' {Physical} tag for a {Poison} tag.

Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison c…

31.name: Venom Arrows
31.description: Hail of Arrows has a chance to poison enemies each second.

32.name: Headshot
32.description: Hail of Arrows deals more bow damage to stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers). This does not affect ailment damage.

0.name: Rip Blood
0.description: Rips blood out of a target enemy dealing physical damage to it. A {Blood Orb} is drawn back to you which restores 10 health when it reaches you.

2.name: Splatter
2.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to create a {Blood Splatter} at the target, dealing damage to other enemies around it, but not the original target.

3.name: Eviscerate
3.description:
Rip Blood has a significantly higher chance to make a {Blood Splatter}, but costs more mana\r.

This {Blood Splatter} can not occur if you are out of mana.

4.name: Crimson Flood
4.description: {Blood Splatter} deals damage in a larger area.

5.name: Revile
5.description: {Blood Splatter} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

6.name: Coagulation
6.description: When a blood orb grants excess health above your maximum, you gain a stack of {Coagulated Blood}. Upon reaching 4 stacks, your next Rip Blood will consume all stacks to form a {Coagulated Blood Orb} that seeks out a nearby enemy, dealing spell physical damage in a small area.

8.name: Varicose Veins
8.description: The {Coagulated Blood Orb} deals more damage in a larger area (multiplicative with other modifiers).

12.name: Blood Infusion
12.description: {Blood Splatter} grants your minions {Blood Infusion} when it hits them. The {Blood Infusion} buff grants 15% more damage for 4 seconds (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Necrotic Unity
13.description: Blood Splatter has increased area for each minion you currently control.

14.name: Infused Frenzy
14.description: {Blood Infusion} grants increased attack and cast speed.

15.name: Hemophagy
15.description: {Blood Infusion} causes your minions to leech a portion of the physical damage they deal as health.

16.name: Hemomancer
16.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed.

17.name: Thirst
17.description: Rip Blood costs less mana and has increased cast speed\r.

18.name: Carrion Hunger
18.description: When you are out of mana Rip Blood is free.

19.name: Quenching
19.description: {Blood Orbs} grant additional health and the {Blood Orb} returns faster.

20.name: Hematology
20.description: {Blood Orbs} restore more health based on your Intelligence stat\r.

21.name: Mana Feast
21.description: {Blood Orbs} now also grant you mana when you directly cast Rip Blood.

22.name: Marrow Drinker
22.description: Rip Blood can be cast on your minions, but no longer can be cast on enemies. {Blood Orbs} restore significantly more health.

23.name: Gushing Wound
23.description: Rip Blood hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed\r.

24.name: Septic Wound
24.description: Bleed chance granted by the {Gushing Wounds} node is converted to poison chance.

25.name: Septic Blood
25.description: {Blood Splatter} has a chance to poison enemies.\r

26.name: Arcane Absorption
26.description: When you directly cast Rip Blood and hit at least one enemy you gain additional spell damage for 6 seconds. This effect can stack.

27.name: Run Dry
27.description: Rip Blood deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers)\r.

28.name: Necrotic Inspiration
28.description: Rip Blood deals more damage for each minion you currently control (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Blood Catalyst
29.description:
Rip Blood will automatically cast itself on a nearby enemy if it kills an enemy, but no longer creates {Blood Orbs}.

This effect can repeat and chain to other enemies. This effect cannot trigger if you are out of mana.

30.name: Rip Spirit
30.description: Rip Blood's and {Blood Splatter's} base physical damage is converted to necrotic damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

31.name: Arcane Fortress
31.description:
{Blood Orbs} now grant ward instead of health, equal to half of the health they would have restored.

Being at or close to full health does not affect the amount of the ward the {Blood Orbs} grant.\r

32.name: Stench of Blood
32.description: Rip Blood has increased cast speed leaves a stench on the target enemy that causes your minions to prioritise attacking it.

0.name: Bone Curse
0.description: Apply a curse to enemies in an area that causes spell physical damage when hit.

1.name: Iron Maiden
1.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Brittle Bones
2.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

3.name: Ruptured Corpse
3.description: Enemies afflicted with Bone Curse have a chance to explode on death, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but Bone Curse costs more mana.

4.name: Entreat the Damned
4.description: Killing an enemy with Bone Curse has a chance to summon a Skeleton Vanguard, a minion that deals melee physical damage using a spear. You are limited to 3 Skeleton Vanguards by default.

5.name: Bone Eruption
5.description: Shortly after casting Bone Curse, it causes a {Bone Eruption} beneath the target area, causing enemies to take spell physical damage, but Bone Curse Costs more mana.

6.name: Acute Infliction
6.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but falls off after a few hits.

7.name: Signet of Agony
7.description:
Bone Curse becomes a toggled aura which surrounds you, but it has reduced area and drains your mana over time. You are also inflicted with Bone Curse.
