This is not compatible with the {Oppressive Gaze} and {Illusion of Pain} nodes.

8.name: Illusion of Pain
8.description:
Bone Curse falls off after only 1 hit, but it always crits and deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). Bone Curse now has a cooldown.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.
The duration of {Cursed Limbs} and {Cursed Ground} are …

9.name: Defile Defenses
9.description: Bone Curse has a chance to reduce enemy armor.

10.name: Marrow Thief
10.description: If you kill an enemy affected by Bone Curse you have a chance to gain {Bone Armor} for a short duration, which grants armor and less damage taken (multiplicative with other modifiers).\r

11.name: Bone Feast
11.description:
When {Marrow Thief} triggers you are also healed. 

The healing scales with healing effectiveness.

12.name: Cloven Flesh
12.description: Bone Curse has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

13.name: Crimson Enlightenment
13.description: When Bone Curse times out, you cast {Rip Blood} on that enemy, a spell dealing physical damage.

14.name: Cursed Ground
14.description: When you cast Bone Curse, it now also leaves behind {Cursed Ground} for a short duration. Enemies that walk into the Cursed Ground are afflicted with Bone Curse.

15.name: Conflation
15.description: Bone Curse affects a larger area.

16.name: Bone Prison
16.description:
When you directly cast Bone Curse you summon a {Bone Prison} around the target area, trapping enemies inside. Bone Prison lasts a long time, but can be attacked and destroyed.

Bone Curse has a significantly longer cooldown.

17.name: Shattered Prison
17.description: Bone Curse has a significantly shorter cooldown, but {Bone Prison} now has gaps.

18.name: Ossify
18.description: {Bone Prison} has significantly more health.

19.name: Sigil of Mortality
19.description:
Bone Curse applies {Mark for Death} for 2 seconds, but costs more mana.

This effect overwrites {Mark for Death's} normal duration.

20.name: Reaper's Mark
20.description: {Mark for Death} lasts longer.

21.name: Misery
21.description: Bone Curse's base physical damage is converted to necrotic. Consequently this damage scales with increases to necrotic damage, but not increases to physical damage.

22.name: Oppressive Gaze
22.description:
Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but now only affects a single target. Bone Curse and Mark for Death have unlimited duration.

This is not compatible with the {Signet of Agony} node.

23.name: Crippling Anguish
23.description: Bone Curse slows enemies within its area of effect

24.name: Swift Release
24.description: Bone Curse deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but lingers for a shorter duration on enemies if not reapplied. The duration reduction only applies to Bone Curse applied by the aura.

25.name: Cultist's Fervor
25.description: Bone Curse costs less mana and has increased cast speed.

26.name: Chilblains
26.description: Bone Curse has a chance to apply chill when the enemy is hit.

27.name: Bitter Winter
27.description: Adds a freeze rate to Bone Curse, granting it a chance to freeze enemies.

28.name: Merciless
28.description:
You may cast Bone Curse on your minions, which grants them more physical damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also applies Bone Curse's negative effects. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

29.name: Spiked Bones
29.description:
Casting Bone Curse on minions causes them to reflect a flat amount damage to attackers. 

This effect lasts 4 seconds and does not stack.

30.name: Barbed Construct
30.description: All minion buffs from Bone Curse have 200% increased effect on Bone Golems.

31.name: Cursed Limbs
31.description:
After directly casting Bone Curse, you also cast Bone Curse on hit for the next few seconds, but Bone Curse costs more mana.
This cast on hit effect can't occur more than once per second.

1.name: Herald of Domination
1.description: The {Glyph} explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of slow on the target.

2.name: Astromage
2.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

3.name: Astral Extension
3.description: You can now place down up to two Glyphs of Dominion, but Glyph of Dominion costs more mana. When the first {Glyph} explodes the second one does too. The second explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) the further it is from the first one up to a maximum.

4.name: Careful Drawings
4.description: Glyph of Dominion expands slower and lasts a longer (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This increases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

5.name: Runecarver's Domain
5.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers). This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

6.name: Attuned Shapes
6.description: Glyph of Dominion expands faster and lasts a shorter duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) per amount of missing mana. This decreases the time before it reaches its full size to detonate.

7.name: Doom Scribe
7.description: After Glyph of Dominion its full size it now has a short delay before it detonates.

8.name: Runic Dominance
8.description: Glyph of Dominion now has a cooldown, which is refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}. It also deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per rune from {Runic Invocation}, without consuming them.

9.name: Power Word: Devastation
9.description:
Glyph of Dominion now consumes the {Runes} from {Runic Invocation} on cast to gain additional effects per {Rune} you have. 

{Rah Rune}: Glyph deals more damage in a larger area per {Rune} of this type.\r
{Gon Rune}: Glyph detonates additional times during the delay per {Rune}…

10.name: Perfect Design
10.description: Glyph of Dominion has additional charges and all charges are refreshed whenever you directly cast {Runic Invocation}.

11.name: Evoker of Elements
11.description: You cast {Elemental Nova} in the middle of the {Glyph} if you stand inside it when the delay from {Doom Scribe} starts and you gain stacks of {Fire Aura}.

12.name: Wreak Havoc
12.description: Glyph of Dominion's damage over time part deals more damage for each second it is active (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Atomization
13.description: While standing on your {Glyph} you and your allies deal more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Armor Shred on the enemy, up to a maximum of 14 stacks.

14.name: Vaporizing Realm
14.description: Glyph of Dominion deals more damage over time (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.name: Runes of Disintegration
15.description: {Disintegrate} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and grants you ward per second if you start channelling it while standing on your {Glyph}.

16.name: Amplified Expanse
16.description: Glyph of Dominion deals damage in a larger area.

17.name: Charged Reflections
17.description: Glyph of Dominion is now cast at your current location and it grants you and your allies ward per second per your uncapped resistance while standing on your {Glyph}.

18.name: Arcane Mirror
18.description: You and your allies gain additional resistances while standing on your {Glyph}.

19.name: Static Sparks
19.description: After casting Glyph of Dominion you gain {Static Charges} at an accelerating rate while standing still, until your {Glyph} detonates.

20.name: Sanctuary Threshold
20.description:
Whenever you or your allies enters your Glyph of Dominion it cleanses ailments and grants the {Haste} buff for a short duration.

Leaving and re-entering the same {Glyph} does not cause this effect to trigger again.

21.name: Shocking Grasp
21.description: You and your allies gain additional Shock chance while standing on your {Glyph}.

22.name: Power Word: Stun
22.description: Normal and Magic enemies have a chance to be stunned every half second while on your {Glyph}.

23.name: Tendrils of the Invoker
23.description: Your {Lightning Blast} now chains while you are standing on your {Glyph}, but consumes mana when cast this way while you are at positive mana.

24.name: Mage's Decree
24.description: You and your allies gain increased area to spells and attacks while standing on your {Glyph}.

25.name: Flaming Scroll
25.description:
{Glyph of Dominion's} base lightning damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to lightning damage.

Shock chance from all sources is converted to ignite for Glyph of Dominion and effects related to shock now …

26.name: Burning Symbol
26.description: Glyph of Dominion ignites enemies on the {Glyph} every half second.

27.name: Fan the Inferno
27.description: The ignite frequency from {Burning Symbol} is increased by your chance to ignite.

2.name: Regenerative Shell
2.description: You have increased health regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

3.name: Mystic Aegis
3.description: Rebuke has a shorter cooldown, but costs more mana.

4.name: Brave the Elements
4.description: You take less elemental damage while channelling Rebuke (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.name: Augmented Plating
5.description: You have more armor (multiplicative with other modifiers) while channelling Rebuke.

6.name: Bide
6.description: Rebuke's maximum duration is increased, allowing you to absorb more damage.

7.name: Burst of Speed
7.description: After you finish channelling Rebuke you gain the {Haste} buff, attack speed, and cast speed for a duration equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

8.name: Redemption
8.description: You heal yourself and nearby allies each second while channelling Rebuke.

9.name: Solemn Vow
9.description: Buffs via the {Burst of Speed} and {Protective Legacy} nodes last longer after you finish channelling Rebuke.

10.name: Battle Meditation
10.description: You have increased mana regeneration while channelling Rebuke.

11.name: Retaliation
11.description: Rebuke hits deal more damage, and Rebuke hits in a larger area.

12.name: Wildfire Shell
12.description: While channelling Rebuke, you have a chance to apply {Spreading Flames} to nearby enemies each second.

13.name: Singed Shield
13.description: You have a chance to ignite nearby enemies each second while channelling Rebuke.

14.name: Unforge
14.description: You have a chance to reduce nearby enemy armor each second while channelling Rebuke.

15.name: Lingering Ailments
15.description: Ignite, armor shred, and spreading flames applied to enemies while channelling Rebuke last longer.

16.name: Dark Thoughts
16.description: Rebuke hits deal additional base void damage.

17.name: Voidfused Barrier
17.description:
Rebuke hits have a chance to grant you a {Void Essence}.

Void Essences last 7 seconds and grant 15% increased void damage, 15% increased melee damage, and 10% reduced stun duration.

You can have a maximum of 3 Void Essences at once.

18.name: Infinite Guardian
18.description: Rebuke has an increased maximum duration, allowing you to absorb more damage, but has a longer cooldown.

19.name: Accelerated Healing
19.description: While channeling Rebuke the healing from the {Redemption} node increases each second.

20.name: War Priest
20.description: Healing via the {Redemption} node now also scales with your attunement.

21.name: Protective Legacy
21.description: The buffs you are granted via the {Augmented Plating} and {Brave the Elements} nodes now persist after you finish channelling Rebuke. Their duration is equal to half the duration you channelled Rebuke for.

22.name: Inner Focus
22.description: Regenerate mana when you are hit while channelling Rebuke.

24.name: Reclaimed Refuge
24.description:
You reduce a portion of Rebuke's remaining cooldown when you use a different melee attack and hit at least one enemy.

This effect can only occur a limited number of times per use of Rebuke, and the effect is doubled while wielding a two handed weapon.

25.name: Stoic Challenge
25.description: Rebuke now has an additonal charge.

2.name: Rapid Throw
2.description: Hammer Throw has increased attack speed.

3.name: Weighted Hammers
3.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but hammers travels slower.

4.name: Enra's Technique
4.description:
Hammer Throw can no longer spiral, chain, or orbit.

If your hammers would spiral, they instead deal significantly more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

If your hammers would chain, they instead deal more critical damage for each time they would chain.

If yo…

5.name: Mana Starved Forging
5.description: When you are out of mana Hammer Throw is free.

6.name: Shattering Force
6.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to reduce enemy armor.

7.name: Disintegrating Aura
7.description: Your hammers gain a {Disintegrating Aura}, causing enemies nearby them to take void damage over time, but Hammer Throw costs more mana and has reduced attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Rapid Disintegration
8.description: {Disintegrating Aura} deals more damage, and Hammer Throw costs less mana.

9.name: Force of Impact
9.description: Hammer Throw hits deal more damage, have a higher chance to stun enemies, and stun for a longer duration.

10.name: Collision
10.description: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to stun enemies, and the stuns they inflict last longer, but Hammer Throw hits no longer pierce (travel through enemies hit).

11.name: Ricochet
11.description: Hammers chain to nearby enemies instead of returning to you, but Hammer Throw hits deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have reduced chance to stun enemies.

12.name: Chaining Hammers
12.description: Hammers chain to additional enemies, but Hammer Throw has less attack speed and its hits deal less damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Overwhelm
13.description: Hammer Throw deals more hit damage against stunned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers) and the stuns they inflict last longer

14.name: Battle Rouse
14.description: Hammer Throw has a chance to grant you health on hit.

15.name: Hammer of Want
15.description: Hammer Throw rips a {Dark Orb} from enemies on hit, which travels back to you and grants 6 health and mana. Hammer Throw has a 5 second cooldown.

16.name: Winged Hammers
16.description: Hammers travel faster.

17.name: Steadfast Path
17.description: Hammer Throw hits have a chance to deal double damage, but hammers no longer return to you.

18.name: Catapult
18.description:
Hammer Throw launches additional hammers, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

Hammers from the same throw cannot hit the same enemy, unless they spiral.

19.name: Avatar of the Spire
19.description: Hammers are now thrown in a nova, with double the amount of additional hammers unless your hammers spiral. Hammer Throw hits deal additional throwing physical damage.

20.name: Iron Spiral
20.description: Hammers now travel in a spiral around you, but halves your amount of additional hammers and Hammer Throw costs more mana.

21.name: Hammer Vortex
21.description: Your spiralling hammers now orbit you, but Hammer Throw costs more mana.

22.name: Ballista
22.description: Hammer Throw deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and costs less mana.

23.name: Zealot's Conviction
23.description: Hammer Throw hits have a higher chance to deal double damage.

24.name: Guardian's Zeal
24.description: Using Hammer Throw grants you a stack of {Zeal} for 4 seconds, which increases your damage and critical strike chance by 10% per stack.

25.name: Rahyeh's Legacy
25.description: Each stack of {Zeal} also grants you added global ignite chance.

2.name: Overgrowth
2.description: {Vines} deal more damage and have more health (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

3.name: Creeping Underbrush
3.description: You now have a chance to summon a new Vine next to a nearby enemy when a {Vine} dies. Vines have increased attack and cast speed.

4.name: Blades of the Forest
4.description:
After using Summon Vine, Human Form is now replaced with {Infestation}, which converts your 2 nearest {Vines} into {Hives} and transforms you to {Swarmblade Form}.

This requires you to have Swarmblade Form unlocked.

5.name: Garden of Rage
5.description:
Your {Vines} have a chance to grant you {Rage} on hit. Melee hits have a higher chance to grant Rage than spell hits.

If you have the {Great Vine} node the rage gained is 200% higher.

6.name: Great Vine
6.description:
You can now only summon 1 {Vine} at a time up to a maximum of 6, but they have significantly more health, size, threat generation and their melee attacks deal significantly more damage in a larger area (all multiplicative with other modifiers).

Indirect casts only create a vi…

7.name: Barbed Thicket
7.description: You now have a chance to also cast Thorn Shield on the nearest {Vine} when you cast Thorn Shield. Other allies with Thorn Shield deal global increased physical damage and have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.name: Spikeburst
8.description: {Thorn Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

9.name: Stinging Bramble
9.description: {Thorn Burst} and Spirit Thorn hits have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

10.name: Glacial Grove
10.description: You now also have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} when you directly cast Thorn Shield.

11.name: Ironbark
11.description: You have additional armor and increased armor while in Spriggan Form.

12.name: Deep Roots
12.description: Thorn Shield lasts longer.

13.name: Eterra's Bulwark
13.description: Thorn Shield grants additional armor and increased armor.

14.name: Introspection
14.description: Thorn Shield can now only target you and can no longer attach to other allies.

15.name: Bulb Growth
15.description: Thorn Shield has a chance to recast itself on the same target when it expires.

16.name: Briar Shell
16.description: Thorn Shield reflects additional flat damage to attackers.

17.name: Roar of the Woodland
17.description:
After directly casting Thorn Shield, Human Form is now replaced with {Bark Skin}, which adds 4 seconds to the duration of every Thorn Shield on you and transforms you to {Werebear Form}.

This requires you to have Werebear Form unlocked.

18.name: Leaf Barrier
18.description: You gain ward equal to your armor when you enter Spriggan Form.

19.name: Friend of the Forest
19.description:
You summon an additional {Spriggan} when you enter Spriggan Form which doesn't count towards your Spriggan limit, but does count towards your companion limit.

You will not summon an additional Spriggan if you are already at your maximum companion limit.

20.name: Totem Warden
20.description: Your {Healing Totems} have more health and duration (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and you have increased summoning speed while in Spriggan Form.

21.name: Spiked Totems
21.description: Healing Totems directly cast from this tree now also shoot thorns. {Thorn Totem's} skill tree, mana cost, cooldown and totem limit also apply to Healing Totems.

22.name: Unbound Garden
22.description: You now always summon 3 Healing Totems and you can have additional maximum Healing Totems.

23.name: Guardian of Nature
23.description: Healing Totems have increased healing effectiveness.

24.name: Ire of Trees
24.description: Healing Totems are converted to Fury Totems and now restore {Rage} instead of healing, but can only affect you.

25.name: Wrath of the Glade
25.description: You now have a chance to cast Spirit Thorns from each of your Healing Totems when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

26.name: Rose Meadow
26.description: Spirit Thorns and Thorn Shield deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Ancestral Call
27.description: You gain {Rage} and ward when you directly cast Spirit Thorns and hit at least 1 enemy.

28.name: Branch Storm
28.description: Spirit Thorns has a chance to pierce enemies (continue through targets they hit) and they penetrate enemy physical and cold resistance.

29.name: Spiritwhisperer
29.description: You now summon a {Vale Spirit} every 5 direct casts with Spirit Thorns, up to a maximum.

30.name: Cycle of Life
30.description: Your Healing Totems have a chance to summon a {Vale Spirit} when they die.

31.name: Valetide
31.description: You can have additional maximum {Vale Spirits} and when you directly cast Spirit Thorns, while at maximum Vale Spirits, you consume them to cast {Entangling Roots} at the target area and you regain {Rage}, which deals more damage when cast this way (multiplicative with other m…

32.name: Spirit Vortex
32.description: You have a chance to cast {Maelstrom} on you when you directly cast Spirit Thorns.

33.name: Nightshade
33.description: Your hits have a chance to poison enemies while in Spriggan Form and your Vines have a chance to poison enemies.

34.name: Ice Branch
34.description:
Spirit Thorns, Summon Vines and Thorn Shield's base physical damage is converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to physical damage. They also have a chance to freeze enemies.

Poison chance from all sources, for all th…

35.name: Huntersbane
35.description: Your {Vines} now cast thorns from range, instead of using a melee attack. This is affected by nodes on this tree that affects Spirit Thorns, but they only fire 1 projectile and {Great Vine} fires 3 projectiles.

1.name: Gravetide
1.description: Skeletal Mages deal additional spell damage.

2.name: Macabre Waltz
2.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your melee Wraiths and Blood Spectres, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

3.name: Underlings
3.description: Skeletal Mages can cast {Profane Oblation} on your Skeleton Warriors, Skeleton Rogues, and Skeleton Vanguards, sacrificing them to deal necrotic damage to surrounding enemies.

4.name: Cryomancers
4.description:
Adds {Cryomancers} to the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Cryomancers deal cold damage and cast {Ice Shard}.

All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to chill chance for Cryomancers.

5.name: Frost Lich
5.description: Removes regular Skeletal Mages and Pyromancers from the pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned, and your Skeletal Mages deal increased damage.

6.name: Frozen Tomb
6.description: Skeletal Mages have an increased chance to stun enemies and an increased freeze rate.

7.name: Putrid Essence
7.description: Skeletal Mage hits have a chance to poison enemies.

8.name: Ossein Frenzy
8.description: Skeletal Mages have a chance to gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds when they hit an enemy.

9.name: Pyromancers
9.description:
Adds Pyromancers to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages that can be summoned. Pyromancers deal fire damage and cast {Fireball}.\r
 \r
All poison chance gained from this tree is converted to ignite chance for Pyromancers.\r

10.name: Inferno
10.description: Your Skeletal Mages have increased health, but regular Skeletal Mages are removed from the summon pool of Skeletal Mages.

11.name: Flame Rot
11.description: Ignites and poisons inflicted by Skeletal Mages last longer and have additional Penetration.

12.name: Celer Mortis
12.description: Improves Skeletal Mages' base critical strike chance and they move faster.

13.name: Grey Merchant
13.description: Skeletal Mages' critical strikes deal more damage, and when they critically strike they are healed for a percentage of their maximum health.

14.name: Order of Death
14.description: You can summon more Skeletal Mages.

15.name: Leech Life
15.description: Skeletal Mages leech a portion of the damage they deal as health and have increased maximum health.

16.name: Death Knights
16.description: Adds Death Knights to the summon pool of Skeletal Mages, which uses melee necrotic attacks, and removes all other types of Skeletal Mages from the pool.

17.name: Flaming Attacks
17.description: Death Knight melee hits deal additional fire damage.

18.name: Death Blossom
18.description: Death Knights cast {Hungering Souls} with additional projectiles. Hungering Souls has an 8 second cooldown when cast by Death Knights.

19.name: Undead Mortars
19.description: Skeletal Mages cast {Necrotic Mortar}, a ranged necrotic spell with a large area of effect. Necrotic Mortar has a 6 second cooldown.

20.name: Battle Hardened
20.description: Skeletal Mages are able to use their abilities more frequently.

21.name: Splintered Dominion
21.description:
Skeletal Mages have a chance to fire 2 additional projectiles. \r
\r
Skeletal Mages have an increased area of effect with melee attacks. \r

22.name: Archmage
22.description: You can only summon one Skeletal Mage, an Archmage, that has significantly more maximum health and damage (both multiplicative with other modifiers), fires twice the number of extra projectiles, and is larger.

23.name: Argonautic Speed
23.description: Skeletal Mages attack and cast faster (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Shadow Wardens
24.description: Skeletal Mages' gain ward over time and have a chance to avoid critical strikes.

26.name: Forbidden Arcana
26.description: Skeletal Mages deal more damage based on your maximum mana.

27.name: Grave Passage
27.description: When you directly cast Summon Skeletal Mage you are teleported to the target location. Summon Skeletal Mage now has a cooldown and counts as {Traversal} skill.

28.name: Death's Cavalry
28.description: When you teleport using Summon Skeletal Mage some of your other minions are teleported with you.

2.name: Catalyst
2.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Black Hole pulls enemies a shorter distance towards itself.

3.name: Absolute Zero
3.description: Black Hole has a chance to chill enemies within its area of effect each second.

4.name: Red Giant
4.description:
Back Hole’s base cold damage is converted to fire damage. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to cold damage.

Black Hole lasts much longer, but no longer pulls enemies.

5.name: Scorching
5.description: Black Hole’s damage over time penetrates enemy fire resistance.

6.name: Heat Wave
6.description: Black Hole has a chance to ignite enemies within its area of effect each second based on your uncapped fire resistance.

7.name: Flaming
7.description: Black Hole deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Infusion
8.description: Black Hole grants you ward each second.

9.name: Binary System
9.description:
Black Hole becomes two stars which orbit each other. One deals fire damage and the other deals cold damage. \r
\r
Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers). \r

10.name: Umbral Core
10.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Event Horizon
11.description: Black Hole deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but has reduced cast speed.

12.name: Collapse
12.description: Black Hole creates an explosion when it ends that pushes all enemies back, but has a shorter duration (multiplicative with other modifiers). The explosion makes a wave of energy that deals 15 cold damage and has a freeze rate of 30.

13.name: Pulsar
13.description: Black Hole will {Collapse} each second while it exists.

14.name: Deep Space
14.description: The explosions created by the {Collapse} and {Pulsar} nodes have an increased chance to freeze enemies.

15.name: Time Dilation
15.description: Black Hole has a chance to blind enemies within its area of effect each second.

16.name: Cascade Fracture
16.description: Black Hole has a chance to create another Black Hole once it expires.

17.name: Rifts
17.description: Black Hole has a shorter cooldown and costs less mana, but pulls enemies a lesser distance towards itself and pulls enemies within a lesser area (both multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Intensity
18.description: Black Hole pulls enemies a longer distance towards itself.

19.name: Massive
19.description: Black Hole pulls enemies within a larger area.

20.name: Drifting Singularity
20.description: Black Hole moves toward the nearest enemy that is not within its damaging area.

21.name: Spacial Dilation
21.description: Black Hole moves faster toward the nearest enemy.

22.name: Gravity's Guile
22.description: Black Hole’s center hits enemies, dealing spell physical damage.

23.name: Supermassive
23.description: Black Hole deals more damage to rare enemies and bosses (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it prioritises moving towards rare enemies and bosses.

24.name: Stability
24.description: Black Hole lasts longer.

25.name: Endless Maw
25.description: Black Hole lasts longer, but has a longer cooldown.

26.name: Scattered
26.description: A second Black Hole is created 10 meters away in a random direction from the first Black Hole.

27.name: Weakened Reality
27.description: Black Hole deals more damage to enemies within 1 meter of its center.

28.name: Singularity
28.description: Black Hole deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but only 1 Black Hole can be created at a time.

29.name: Armageddon
29.description: Black Hole casts {Meteor} every second, but consumes Meteor's mana cost every second.

2.name: Chilling Force
2.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to chill enemies.

3.name: Lesser Destruction
3.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Moderate Destruction
4.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.name: Greater Destruction
5.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Lesser Chilling
6.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to chill enemies.

7.name: Moderate Chilling
7.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

8.name: Greater Chilling
8.description: Glacier’s largest explosion deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a chance to chill enemies.

9.name: Lesser Vortex
9.description: Glacier’s smallest explosion has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

10.name: Moderate Vortex
10.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased duration.

11.name: Greater Vortex
11.description: Glacier’s largest explosion has a greater chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, and the {Rime} buff has increased effect.

12.name: Whirlpools
12.description: Each of Glacier’s explosions has a chance to create an {Ice Vortex}, which lasts for 4 seconds and deals spell cold damage over time.

13.name: Rime Caster
13.description: When you cast Glacier you gain the {Rime} buff which increases your damage over time and freeze rate multiplier.

14.name: Lesser Glacier
14.description: Glacier costs less mana, but the largest explosion is disabled.

15.name: Cold Snap
15.description: Glacier’s middle-sized explosion deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Glacier costs more mana.

16.name: Frost Grip
16.description: Glacier has an increased chance to freeze and stun enemies.

17.name: Critical Rejuvenation
17.description: Critical hits with Glacier grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

18.name: Cold Victory
18.description: Glacier kills grant mana equal to a percentage of your maximum mana.

19.name: Fading Echoes
19.description: Glacier’s explosions occur in reverse order.

20.name: Resplendent Frost
20.description: Greatly improves Glacier’s base critical strike chance, but reduces its critical strike multiplier.

21.name: Static Collapse
21.description: All of Glacier’s explosions occur at a target location, but Glacier's critical hits no longer deal extra damage (compared to non-critical hits).

22.name: Perma Frost
22.description: Glacier has a higher chance to freeze enemies, but deals less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

24.name: Breaking Point
24.description: Glacier costs less mana and deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Engulfing Vortex
25.description: {Ice Vortices} created by Glacier have a chance to instead become a {Greater Ice Vortex} that deals significantly more damage and has a larger radius.

26.name: Morditas' Bane
26.description: Glacier deals more hit damage to rare and boss enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

27.name: Endless Frost
27.description: Chill chance granted by this tree is doubled. Glacier hits deal more damage to chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Critical Barrier
28.description: You gain ward on critical strikes with Glacier.

30.name: Snow Blink
30.description:
When you directly cast Glacier you are teleported to the target location, as long as the location is accessible. This does not count as casting the Teleport skill and is not affected by Teleport's skill tree.

Glacier also gains a cooldown and now counts as a {Traversal} skill.

0.name: Synchronized Strike
0.description:
Requires a melee weapon.

Jump forward and strike in an area in front of you while shadows appear and simultaneously strike on either side of you.

1.name: Growing Darkness
1.description: Synchronized Strike deals damage in a larger area.

2.name: Foreshadowing
2.description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike deal increased damage.

3.name: Dark Allies
3.description: Synchronized Strike creates 2 additional {Shadows}, but costs significantly more mana. This can exceed your normal maximum number of {Shadows}.

4.name: Razor Strikes
4.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to cause enemies to bleed and a chance to shred enemy physical resistance.

5.name: Crimson Storm
5.description: Using Synchronized Strike grants you {Crimson Shroud} for a short duration, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken. This stacks up to 3 times for a short duration.

6.name: Shadow Dancing
6.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but {Shadows} from Synchronized Strike expire after attacking. They also do not cause existing {Shadows} to expire and do not trigger {on shadow creation} or {on shadow expiration} effects.

7.name: Shadow Fang
7.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

8.name: Last Call
8.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage to enemies on low health.

9.name: Lust for Carnage
9.description: Synchronized Strike leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

10.name: Escape Artist
10.description: You gain {Haste} for a short duration when you kill an enemy with Synchronized Strike.

11.name: Umbral Execution
11.description:
Synchronized Strike instantly kills enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

If you have a similar effect from an item or passive node then the highest threshold is used.

12.name: Thrill of the Kill
12.description: You are granted increased critical strike chance for 4 seconds on kill with Synchronized Strike. This effect can stack.

13.name: Blade Prowess
13.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per equipped sword and has a chance to poison enemies per equipped dagger.

14.name: Lethality
14.description: Improves Synchronized Strike's base critical strike chance.

15.name: True Strikes
15.description: Synchronized Strike deals more critical strike damage.

16.name: Harmony of Death
16.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to inflict enemies with {Critical Vulnerability}.

17.name: Coordinated Cuts
17.description: Synchronized Strike has a chance to shred enemy armor. Armor shred applied by Synchronized Strike has increased effectiveness.

18.name: Umbral Assassination
18.description: Synchronized Strike inflicts enemies with a {Shadow Dagger}.

19.name: Shadow Infusion
19.description: Synchronized Strike consumes existing {Shadows} to deal damage in a larger area and grant you ward per {Shadow} consumed.

20.name: Wave of Darkness
20.description:
Synchronized Strike causes existing {Shadows} to use {Shadow Cascade} on use, rather than being consumed immediately. 

This effect consumes a portion of mana per active Shadow.

21.name: Dynamics
21.description: Synchronized Strike costs less mana.

22.name: Art of the Blade
22.description: You are granted increased attack speed for 3 seconds if Synchronized Strike hits at least one enemy.

23.name: Perfect Coordination
23.description: The {Shadows} now jump inward towards the target rather than outward, but Synchronized Strike costs more mana.

24.name: Divergence
24.description: Synchronized Strike deals more damage, but the {Shadows} now attack from where you teleport from, rather than where you arrive.

25.name: Shadow Rush
25.description: {Shadows} created within 4 seconds of using Synchronized Strike restore health on creation.

26.name: Retreat Into Shadow
26.description: You now disappear instead of teleporting to the target and a {Shadow} is created in your place, but Synchronized Strike has a longer cooldown.

27.name: Dark Passage
27.description: Synchronized Strike deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but will no longer generate any {Shadows} other than the one created by {Dark Passage}.

28.name: Cutthroat
28.description: Synchronized Strike always critically hits enemies on high health.

2.name: Ice Nova
2.description: Enables {Ice Nova}, which has a freeze rate of 40. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

3.name: Glyphs of Winter
3.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to chill enemies and an increased chance to freeze enemies.

4.name: Freezing Cascade
4.description: Elemental Nova casts {Freezing Cascade} on hit, creating a cascade of freezing novas that chain between enemies.

5.name: Glacial Might
5.description: Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Elemental Nova costs more mana.

6.name: Protective Strikes
6.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to grant ward.

7.name: Magical Barrier
7.description: The {Protective Strikes} and {Survival of the Victor} nodes on this tree grant more ward.

8.name: Lightning Nova
8.description: Enables {Lightning Nova}, which has 20% more critical strike chance than other Elemental Nova types. Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

9.name: Charged Destruction
9.description: Elemental Nova hits have an increased critical strike chance.

10.name: Survival of the Victor
10.description: Elemental Nova kills have a chance to grant ward.

11.name: Arcane Protection
11.description: You have more ward retention for 4 seconds after killing an enemy with Elemental Nova. You may have only one instance of this buff at once.

12.name: Fire Nova
12.description: Enables {Fire Nova}, which deals 11% more hit damage than other Elemental Nova types. All Elemental Nova hits deal more (multiplicative with other modifiers) damage.

13.name: Infernal Prism
13.description: Elemental Nova hits penetrate enemy elemental resistances.

14.name: Ash Frenzy
14.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against enemies that are at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers). Elemental Nova has increased cast speed.

15.name: Arcane Projection
15.description: Elemental Nova is now cast at a target location instead of around you.

16.name: Infernal Nova
16.description: Elemental Nova has a significantly larger area of effect and ignites caused by Elemental Nova have increased duration, but Elemental Nova has a 4 second cooldown. The area of effect increase is smaller if Elemental Nova is channeled.

17.name: Conflagrating Speed
17.description: Elemental Nova has a shorter cooldown.

18.name: Spark Charges
18.description:
Elemental Nova hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}, which deals lightning damage to nearby enemies after 1 second or when the enemy dies.

Additionally, Elemental Nova deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Immolation
19.description: Elemental Nova hits have a chance to Ignite enemies.

20.name: Flame Battery
20.description: You can store an additional charge of Elemental Nova.

21.name: Elemental Expanse
21.description: Elemental Nova has a larger area of effect.

22.name: Overcharge
22.description: Elemental Novas have a chance to be {Overcharged}. Overcharged Novas shock enemies and have a larger area of effect.

23.name: Overload
23.description: {Overcharged} Elemental Novas deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased stun chance.

24.name: Elemental Tranquillity
24.description:
{Ice Nova} has a higher chance to Freeze enemies.\r

{Lightning Nova} has a chance to Shock enemies.\r

{Fire Nova} has a chance to Ignite enemies.\r

25.name: Cryomantic Fragility
25.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana, but you take increased cold damage if you have cast Elemental Nova recently (past 4 seconds).

26.name: Arcana Elementorum
26.description: Elemental Nova deals more elemental damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and has a slightly larger area of effect.

27.name: Melting Nova
27.description: Elemental Nova has a chance to shred armour on hit and has increased critical strike chance.

28.name: Luminaire
28.description: Elemental Nova becomes a channeled ability, unleashing 5 novas per second, and rapidly draining your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling. Elemental Nova has a smaller area of effect (multiplicative with other area modifiers).

29.name: Star Prism
29.description: Elemental Nova costs less mana per second to channel

30.name: Silenced Spark
30.description:
You have additional lightning resistance while channeling, but Lightning Nova is disabled.

If you have not taken the {Fire Nova} or {Ice Nova} nodes, then this node re-enables basic Elemental Nova.

32.name: Shatter Nova
32.description: Elemental Nova hits deal more damage against chilled enemies, frozen enemies, shocked enemies, and ignited enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

34.name: Fiery Destruction
34.description: Elemental Nova critical strikes deal more damage.

2.name: Looming Clouds
2.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Storm Bolt} at an additional enemy.

3.name: Concentrated Storm
3.description: Gathering Storm deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you expend {Storm Stacks} more frequently, but {Storm Bolts} target enemies within a smaller area.

4.name: In the Eye of the Storm
4.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to cast {Maelstrom}.

6.name: A Storm Gathers
6.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain a stack instead of losing one.

7.name: Lightning Gale
7.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} you have a chance to gain {Haste}.

8.name: Whirlwind Tactics
8.description:
Whenever you use a companion ability you expend {Storm Stacks} over the next 0.3 seconds.

Storm Bolts triggered this way deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
9.description: Whenever you hit a boss or rare enemy with a {Storm Bolt} you have a chance to cast it again at the same enemy after 0.25 seconds.

10.name: Lagonian Diplomacy
10.description: While wielding a staff the melee attack of Gathering Storm is replaced by a direct ranged cast of {Storm Bolt}, but Gathering Storm costs additional mana.

11.name: Clouds on the Horizon
11.description: {Storm Bolts} target enemies from farther away.

12.name: Friends of the Tempest
12.description: If you have from 1 to 15 {Storm Stacks}, your minions' lightning skill hits have a chance to grant you a {Storm Stack}.

13.name: Thunderous Strikes
13.description: Gathering Storm penetrate enemy lightning resistance.

14.name: Excited Bolts
14.description: {Storm Bolts} now consume a portion of your current mana to deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 10 current mana.

15.name: Two Eyed Storm
15.description: Whenever you expend a {Storm Stack} while dual wielding you now cast {Storm Bolts} at two enemies instead of one.

16.name: Windfury Blows
16.description: Gathering Storm has increased attack speed.

17.name: Manafused Storm
17.description: Whenever you directly use Gathering Storm you gain mana per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

18.name: The Typhoon
18.description: You have increased global stun chance and additional freeze rate multiplier per active {Storm Stack} up to a maximum.

19.name: Energized by the Skies
19.description: Gathering Storm's hits have a chance to consume mana to grant you additional {Storm Stacks}.

20.name: Island Cleaver
20.description: Gathering Storm's melee attack deals damage in a larger area and you have a chance to gain an additional {Storm Stack} if you hit at least 3 enemies with the same melee attack.

21.name: Wings of Lightning
21.description:
Whenever you use Gathering Storm's and hit at least one enemy you gain a stack of {Wings of Lightning}.

Each time one of your {Storm Crows} attack they consume a stack of Wings of Lightning causing their basic attack to chain 2 additional times.

22.name: Jolting Strikes
22.description:
{Storm Bolts'} hits have chance to shock enemies.

28.description: Gathering Storm has a higher chance to freeze enemies per 2 Attunement and it also has additional cold penetration for frostbite per 2 Attunement.

30.description: Gathering Storm has improved base critical strike chance per stack of {Maelstrom} on you from any source.

Howl also grants more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased melee attack speed to all affected allies.

9.description: Wolves deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.description: Your Wolves' melee hits deal more damage, have a greater chance to stun (both multiplicative with other modifiers) and it has improved base critical strike enemies, but has less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

You can have an additional Wolf active at once.

You can have an additional companion active at once.

The extra wolf counts towards your companion limit.

13.description: Wolves have a chance to chill enemies on hit.

14.description: Wolves deal additional cold damage with attacks, and have an increased chance to stun enemies.

16.description: Wolves have additional base health regeneration and increased health regeneration.

18.description: Your Wolves have a chance to retaliate with {Storm Bolt} when hit or when they hit an enemy.

21.description: Your Wolves deal more lightning damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.description: Your Wolves now deal increase damage and have increased health for each point of Attunement you have.

24.description: Wolves have more damage and dodge rating (multiplicative with other modifiers). This bonus is tripled for Wolves that have used {Howl} recently.

25.description: Your Wolves cannot be stunned.

26.description: The buffs granted by {Howl} last longer and wolves have a chance to Howl when they hit a rare or boss enemy. This does not expend Howl's mana cost or put it on cooldown.

27.description: Your Wolves' {Howl} also grant {Haste} for a short duration.

28.description: Bleed inflicted by Wolves lasts longer and wolves have a chance to slow on hit and when hit.

29.name: Frozen Fangs
29.description:
Your Wolves gain the {Ice Bite} ability, which deals higher damage in a larger area, with a 6 second cooldown. 20% of the remaining cooldown is recovered every time the Wolf hits with an ability other than Ice Bite, including their basic attack.

2.name: Infernal Descent
2.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Meteor has reduced cast speed.

3.name: Celestial Celerity
3.description: Meteor has increased cast speed, but costs more mana. Meteors fall faster.

4.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and even more against enemies at full health.

5.description: Meteor has a chance to break into {Shrapnel} on impact, hitting nearby enemies.

6.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

7.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to travel further.

8.name: Piercing Remnants
8.description: {Shrapnel} projectiles pierce (continue through targets they hit), but travel slower.

9.name: Force of Impact
9.description: Meteor has a chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflict last longer.

10.name: Stardust
10.description: Meteors deal more damage of all types except fire (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Rapid Descent
11.description: Meteor falls faster.

12.description: An additional Meteor falls within a 4m radius of the first, but meteor costs much more mana.

13.description: Meteor deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but meteors fall further apart.

14.description: More Meteors fall per cast, but individual Meteors deal damage in a smaller area.

15.description: Meteors fall more frequently. This does not affect the total number of Meteors that fall.

16.name: Infernal Column
16.description: Meteors fall in a line towards where you aim, but Meteor costs more mana.

17.description: Meteor costs less mana.

18.description: Meteors deals damage in a larger area of effect.

19.description: Improves Meteor's base critical strike chance. Meteor has a chance to deal damage in a significantly larger area.

20.description: Meteor critical strikes deal more damage.

22.description: More Meteors fall per cast.

23.name: World Ender
23.description: Meteor always crits if you have more than 400 mana before you cast it.

24.description:
After you cast Meteor you recover a portion of the mana spent over the next three seconds. 

You can only recover mana from one cast at once, so if you cast meteor again within three seconds you lose the remaining mana you would have recovered from the first cast.

25.name: Craterborn
25.description: Casting Meteor grants the {Craterborn} buff, granting additional fire penetration and increased cast speed for a short duration. Craterborn does not stack.

26.name: Cycle of Fire
26.description: Casting Fireball while you have {Craterborn} grants ward and restores your mana.

2.name: Vorpal Reverberation
2.description: Abyssal Decay deals additional spell void damage.

3.name: Rippling Corrosion
3.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst shreds enemy armor.

4.name: Tides of Rust
4.description: Armor shred applied by Abyssal Decay has increased effect.

5.name: Time Compression
5.description: Abyssal Echoes no longer has a cooldown, but costs more mana.

6.name: Abyssal Dispersion
6.description: Abyssal Echoes costs less mana.

7.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes has a chance to cast a {Void Rift} from each nearby {Devouring Orb}.

8.name: Dark Torrent
8.description: Abyssal Echoes can now be cast at the target location.

9.description: Abyssal Decay has increased duration.

10.description: Abyssal Decay now blinds enemies.

11.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to have reduced physical resistance, but it is no longer consumed when the enemy is hit.

12.name: Crumbling
12.description: Abyssal Decay causes enemies to take increased damage over time.

13.name: Impair the Weak
13.description: Abyssal Decay now deals damage when the enemy is hit, rather than over time. Each hit deals a portion of the full damage Abyssal Decay would have dealt over its full duration. This damage still counts as damage over time.

14.name: Embrace the Darkness
14.description: Directly using Abyssal Echoes grants you {Nether Coating} for 5 seconds, granting you increased attack speed with your melee and throwing attacks and causing you to deal more damage to blinded enemies.

15.name: Abyssal Tendrils
15.description: {Nether Coating} also grants you a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on hit.

16.name: Sanguine Eruption
16.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst consumes all stacks of bleed on the enemy, causing their damage to be dealt instantly.

17.name: Crippling Waves
17.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst slows enemies.

18.name: Freedom of Movement
18.description: Abyssal Decay causes Enemies that would apply {Slow} to instead instead grant their target {Haste} for 1 second.

19.name: Void Supremacy
19.description: After casting Abyssal Echoes your next {Erasing Strike} and {Void Cleave} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) to slowed enemies.

20.name: Deep Expanse
20.description: Abyssal Echoes affects a larger area.

21.name: Fiery Chasm
21.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst has a chance to ignite enemies.

22.name: Potent Corruption
22.description: Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now hits and deals spell void damage, but no longer inflicts Abyssal Decay.

23.name: Void Purifier
23.description:
Spell void damage from {Potent Corruption}, {Vorpal Reverberation} and attribute scaling is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to void damage.

Abyssal Echoes' initial burst now also heals you and your allies and…

24.name: Heavenly Gift
24.description: Abyssal Echoes' damage now scales with attunement rather than vitality, and its healing effectiveness is also increased by attunement.

25.name: Vorpal Explosion
25.description: Abyssal Echoes deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer chains.

26.name: Spreading Chaos
26.description: Abyssal Decay now spreads to several nearby enemies after 1 second.

27.name: Overwhelming Doom
27.description: Abyssal Decay spreads to enemies further away and can spread to more enemies when it spreads.

28.name: Shrieking Echoes
28.description: {Abyssal Rifts} cast additional Abyssal Echoes.

29.name: Screaming Rifts
29.description: Abyssal Echoes now creates an {Abyssal Rift} at the target location that casts Abyssal Echoes for you 3 times at its location before expiring.

31.name: Corrupting Harness
31.description:
Abyssal Echoes can chain additional times. 

This effect is tripled for echoed casts.

32.name: Resounding Abyss
32.description: Echoed casts deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Locus Of Resurrection
2.description: {Wraiths} appear at the target location, but Summon Wraith costs more mana.

3.name: Locus Of Death
3.description: {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and have increased melee attack speed, but are unable to move.

4.description: {Wraiths} have more melee attack speed (multiplicative with other modifers).

6.description: Summon Wraith has a shorter cooldown, and there is a shorter delay between each {Wraith} being summoned.

7.name: Army of Wraiths
7.description: Summon Wraith summons additional {Wraiths} per cast, but costs more mana.

8.description: Removes the delay between each {Wraith} being summoned, but fewer Wraiths are summoned per cast (rounded up).

9.name: Haunting
9.description: {Wraiths} have more maximum health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Twin Spirits
10.description: {Wraiths'} health no longer decays, but you are limited to only 2 wraiths.

11.name: Sanguine Spirits
11.description: Bleed inflicted by {Wraiths} has increased effect and duration.

12.name: Sequel of Avarice
12.description: {Wraiths} are larger, deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and hit a larger area with their melee attacks.

13.name: Covenant of Souls
13.description: You can control more {Wraiths} at once.

14.name: Reapers
14.description: {Wraiths} deal additional necrotic damage with attacks and spells.

15.name: Wraith Bringer
15.description: Summon Wraith has increased cast speed and costs less mana.

16.name: Fallen Reclamation
16.description: {Wraiths} move faster.

17.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Flame Wraith}, which casts fireballs. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Spirit Link
18.description: {Wraiths} have more additional strike chance, and when you cast Summon Wraith you gain increased critical strike chance equal to its mana cost for 4 seconds.

21.description: {Wraiths} deal more necrotic damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and leech a portion of the necrotic damage they deal as health.

23.description: {Wraiths}' have additional posion penetration and their melee attacks have a chance to poison enemies on hit.

24.description: You have a chance to instead summon a {Putrid Wraith}, which Poisons enemies from a distance. Additionally all {Wraiths} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

25.name: Delay the End
25.description: {Wraiths}' health decays more slowly.

26.name: Wraith Feast
26.description: Your critical strikes restore health to your {Wraiths}.

28.name: Serrated Scythes
28.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed on hit.

29.name: Spectre of Death
29.description: {Wraiths} have a chance to apply {Damned} to nearby enemies on death.

30.name: One Foot in the Grave
30.description: Gain ward for each {Wraith} summoned, but their health decays more quickly.

2.name: Consuming Path
2.description: Shield Rush deals more damage.

3.name: Will Breaker
3.description: Shield Rush hits deal more damage to enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

5.description: When Shield Rush ends it creates a {Void Beam} that travels back in the direction you came from. Shield Rush costs more mana.

6.description: Shield Rush no longer requires a shield and hits deal additional base void damage, but Shield Rush costs more mana.

7.description: Shield Rush's final hit deals additional melee void damage.

8.description: Shield Rush hits deal additional void damage, but this damage is reduced by your increased attack speed.

9.name: Rush Mastery
9.description: Shield Rush costs less mana.

10.description: You take less damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.description: Shield Rush hits have an increased chance to stun enemies.

12.name: Desynchronous Charge
12.description: When Shield Rush ends, you return to the position you used it from.

13.description: When Shield Rush ends, your mana is restored to the amount you had when it started, but Shield Rush now has a 10 second cooldown.

14.description: Shield Rush gains additional charges, but you take more damage while using Shield Rush (multiplicative with other modifiers).

15.description: Shield Rush no longer has a cooldown, but costs health in addition to mana to use.

16.description: Shield Rush's final attack deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) in a larger area.

19.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final hit deal more damage.

22.name: Critical Echo

23.name: Obliterating Echo
23.description: Critical strikes from Shield Rush's final hit echo deal more damage.

3.description: Volatile Reversal's {Void Rifts} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.description: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Rifts} take increased damage over time for 4 seconds.
