7.description: Volatile Reversal's {Void Rifts} deal damage in a larger area.

8.name: Harbinger of Dust
8.description: Enemies hit by Volatile Reversal's {Void Rifts} take increased damage for 4 seconds.

9.name: Food for Wyrms
9.description:
Volatile Reversal's {Void Rift} hits have a chance to inflict {Time Rot} on enemies.

After casting Volatile Reversal you gain a buff that causes you to deal more void damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of Time Rot on the target. The duration of this buff i…

10.name: Time Sap
10.description: You have a chance to recover a percentage of Volatile Reversal's remaining cooldown when you kill an enemy and when you hit a boss or rare enemy.

11.name: Catching Up
11.description: You gain movement speed after casting Volatile Reversal. The duration of this buff is equal to the length of time you travelled back.

12.name: Warped Time
12.description: You gain increased attack and cast speed after casting Volatile Reversal. The duration of this buff is equal to the length of time you travelled back.

13.name: Timelost Vitality
13.description: Volatile Reversal has a significantly shorter cooldown, but no longer restores health.

14.name: Volatile Travel
14.description: When you cast Volatile Reversal, you have an 80% chance to regain some of your missing health, but a 20% chance to lose some of your current health.

15.name: Traveller's Fatigue
15.description: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown, but you have reduced health regeneration while Volatile Reversal is on cooldown.

16.name: Ancient Reversal
16.description: Volatile Reversal allows you to travel back further in time.

17.name: Traveller's Frailty
17.description: Volatile Reversal has a shorter cooldown, but you take increased damage while Volatile Reversal is on cooldown.

18.name: Timelost Wisdom
18.description: Volatile Reversal has a significantly shorter cooldown, but no longer restores mana.

19.name: Phased Reality
19.description: You gain dodge rating while Volatile Reversal is on cooldown.

2.name: Way of the Sword
2.description: Armament stacks last longer and grant you additional melee physical damage per stack.

3.name: Guarding Stance
3.description: You have additional armor and block effectiveness per stack of Armament.

4.name: Bladed Focus
4.description: When you drop below 0 mana, you consume all stacks of Armament to restore mana per stack.

5.name: Flanking Strikes
5.description: When you have 0 stacks of Armament you have an additional sword when using Multistrike, as if you had 1 stack.

6.name: Hallowed Arsenal
6.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with {Smite}.

Smite cast this way costs its full mana cost per cast.

7.name: Vengeful
7.description:
You have a chance to retaliate with Multistrike swords on block. 

This effect has a 3 second cooldown and doesn't include the initial strike.

8.name: Echoed Warfare
8.description: Multistrike attacks repeated by your {Echoes} have additional swords.

9.name: Initiate
9.description: The initial strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Path of the Knight
10.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 30 armor, up to a maximum.

11.name: Heated Forge
11.description: Directly using {Forge Strike} consumes all stacks of Armament to summon additional {Forged Weapons} per stack.

12.name: Forgemastery
12.description: Multistrike has a chance to consume a stack of Armament while at maximum stacks to summon a {Forged Weapon}.

13.name: Hack and Slash
13.description: You now strike twice with Multistrike, but the full attack takes significantly longer. Each additional sword is now replaced with an axe that strikes its target twice.

14.name: Alpha Cuts
14.description: Improves Multistrike's base critical strike chance.

15.name: Bladestorm
15.description: Multistrike consumes mana per stack of Armament to refresh existing stacks and create an additional sword per stack.

16.name: Relentless Advance
16.description: Multistrike has increased attack speed.

17.name: Determination
17.description: Multistrike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) while you are at maximum stacks of Armament.

18.name: Blitz
18.description: Multistrike penetrates enemy physical resistance.

19.name: Decimate
19.description: Multistrike hits have a chance to bleed enemies per stack of Armament.

20.name: Guillotine
20.description: Multistrike deals more melee damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per stack of bleed up to a maximum.

21.name: Jousting
21.description:
Each additional sword is replaced with a spear, which stabs in an elongated area rather than a slash.

This has no effect if swords are already converted to axes.

22.name: Sweeping Blows
22.description: Created swords can strike enemies further away.

23.name: Victory Strikes
23.description:
If a sword kills an enemy it will create an additional sword to strike another enemy.

This effect cannot be triggered from additional swords created this way.

24.name: Perfect Steel
24.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament.

25.name: Doctrine of the Anvil
25.description: You can have an additional maximum stack of Armament, but Multistrike has less attack speed per stack (multipicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Fiery Justice
26.description: While at maximum stacks of Armament and positive mana, attacking with Multistrike will consume all stacks and 40 mana to use {Forge Strike}.

27.name: Aggressive Cadence
27.description: Multistrike has an additional sword while you are at maximum stacks of Armament and wielding a two-handed weapon.

28.name: Nullifying Carve
28.description: {Void Cleave} consumes all stacks of Armament to gain more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and increased area per stack consumed.

2.name: Thick Smoke
2.description: Applies slow to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

4.name: Eroding Fumes
4.description: Applies armor shred to enemies within the smoke cloud each second.

5.name: Toxic Cloud
5.description: Armor shred applied by Smoke Bomb is converted to poison resistance shred.

6.name: Venom Infusion
6.description: You have a chance to poison enemies with bow attacks while inside the smoke cloud.

7.name: Smokescreen Arrow
7.description: While using a bow you now shoot an arrow that detonates the Smoke Bomb at the target location.

8.name: Swirling Fog
8.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to shred enemy armor each second within the smoke cloud.

9.name: Knives in the Dark
9.description: Smoke Bomb has a chance to inflict a stack of {Shadow Dagger} whenever it applies slow.

10.name: Lingering Fumes
10.description: The smoke cloud lasts longer.

11.name: Shadow Hunter
11.description: Your bow attacks have improved base critcal strike chance and blind enemies while you are inside the smoke cloud.

12.name: Smoke Blades
12.description: You and allies are granted {Smoke Blades} each second for 4 seconds while inside the smoke cloud, granting you additional melee and throwing damage. This effect can stack.

13.name: Blood Bandit
13.description: {Smoke Blades} now also causes melee and throwing attacks to leech a portion of the damage you deal as health.

14.name: Umbral Assault
14.description: The smoke cloud has a chance to create a {Shadow} each second at a random location inside the smoke cloud.

15.name: Concealed in Carnage
15.description: You are granted a stack of {Crimson Shroud} on kill while inside the smoke cloud, granting you bleed chance and less damage over time taken for 4 seconds. This stacks up to 3 times.

16.name: Cloaked Incursion
16.description:
You leap to the target location when you use Smoke Bomb, instead of backflipping away.

Smoke Bomb now has a much shorter cooldown, but counts as a {Traversal} skill.

17.name: Generosity
17.description: The smoke cloud covers a larger area.

18.name: Escape Tactics
18.description:
You backflip away from target direction when you use Smoke Bomb. Smoke Bomb now counts as movement skill.

During Smoke Bomb's movement you are immune to Damage.

19.name: Enfeeblement
19.description: The initial burst applies {Frailty} to enemies, causing them to deal less damage.

20.name: Moonlight Bomb
20.description: The initial burst grants you a stack of {Silver Shroud}, causing you to dodge the next hit and gain ward per stack.

21.name: Cleansing Steam
21.description: The initial burst cleanses negative ailments on you.

22.name: Purging Fumes
22.description: The initial burst also cleanses negative ailments on allies.

23.name: Invigorating Darkness
23.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies health per {Shadow} consumed this way.

24.name: Refreshment
24.description: The initial burst consumes all {Shadows} inside the smoke to grant you and allies mana per {Shadow} consumed this way.

25.name: Engulfed in Flames
25.description: The smoke cloud catches fire at the end of its duration, igniting enemies inside the cloud.

26.name: Hasty Combustion
26.description: Leaving the smoke cloud early causes it to immediately catch fire and end.

27.name: Cleaving Shadows
27.description: You use {Shadow Cascade} when the smoke cloud ends.

28.name: Trapped Shadows
28.description: Your {Decoys} inside the smoke cloud automatically explode when the smoke cloud ends.

29.name: Shrouded in Darkness
29.description: You are granted a stack of {Dusk Shroud} each second for 2 seconds while you are in the smoke cloud, granting you glancing blow chance and dodge rating. This effect can stack.

30.name: Rapid Concealment
30.description: The smoke cloud grants stacks of {Dusk Shroud} more frequently.

31.name: Shared Concealment
31.description: The smoke cloud now also grants {Dusk Shroud} to allies for 2 seconds while inside the smoke cloud.

32.name: Impending Gloom
32.description: The smoke cloud has a larger area and grows faster.

34.name: Hidden Blows
34.description: {Puncture} and {Shurikens} have a chance cause enemies to bleed if used inside the smoke cloud.

0.name: Flurry
0.description: A bow or melee skill that performs 3 rapid attacks.

2.name: Alacrity
2.description: Flurry has increased attack speed.

3.name: Relentless
3.description: You have increased attack speed for each hit you dealt with your previous flurry, up to a maximum.

4.name: Kineticism
4.description: Enemies killed by Flurry have a chance to release a {Kinetic Burst} around the target, dealing physical damage.

5.name: Deep Strikes
5.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifers).

6.name: Blood Revelry
6.description: Flurry leeches a portion of the damage it deals as health.

7.name: Adrenaline Rush
7.description: Flurry strikes have a chance to grant you {Adrenaline Rush}, granting Flurry 5% more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and 5% increased attack speed. This lasts for 4 seconds, can stack up to 4 times.

8.name: Bloodplay
8.description: Each stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants a chance to bleed on hit.

9.name: Giant Slayer
9.description: Eack stack of {Adrenaline Rush} grants Flurry more hit damage against bosses and rare enemies.

10.name: Inexhaustible
10.description: {Adrenaline Rush} lasts longer.

11.name: Strained Reflexes
11.description: {Adrenaline Rush} can have multiple stacks.

12.name: Lethal Vector
12.description: Damaging ailments inflicted by Flurry deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Boundless Blows
13.description: Flurry is now a channelled ability that costs 5 mana per second to maintain. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

14.name: Accelerating Impact
14.description: Flurry deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) for each second channelled up to a maximum.

15.name: Pavise
15.description: You have additional physical and elemental resistances while channelling Flurry.

16.name: Arrow Storm
16.description: If you are using a bow you fire arrows faster, but they are less accurate.

17.name: Vile Tactics
17.description:
Flurry's first strike has a chance to inflict poison.
Flurry's second strike has a chance to cause bleed.
Flurry's third strike has a chance to shred physical and poison resistance.

18.name: Reopened Wounds
18.description: Bleed inflicted by Flurry has additional Physical Penetration.

19.name: Compounding Toxin
19.description: Poison inflicted by Flurry has additional Poison Penetration.

20.name: Shockwave
20.description: If you are using a melee weapon Flurry now causes {Force Waves} to blast forward with each strike, dealing melee physical damage.

21.name: Billowing Waves
21.description: The {Force Waves} travel further.

22.name: Precision
22.description: Improves Flurry's base critical strike chance.

23.name: Incision
23.description: Flurry critical strikes deal more damage.

24.name: Stolen Endurance
24.description: Critical strikes restore health. The amount of health gained is increased by Dexterity.

25.name: Second Wind
25.description: Flurry grants health when hitting at least one enemy.

26.name: Sap Willpower
26.description: Flurry grants mana when hitting at least one enemy.

27.name: Hamstring
27.description: Flurry's third strike Slows enemies hit.

28.name: Crescendo
28.description: Flurry's first and second strike deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but the third strike deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Fusillade
29.description: If you are using a bow, every 6th arrow is replaced with {Multishot}.

0.name: Spirit Plague
0.description: Curses a target with a powerful necrotic damage over time effect. Spreads to a single nearby target on target death.

2.name: Hindering Affliction
2.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are now also slowed.

3.name: Plague Burst
3.description: You have a chance to spread Spirit Plague when you hit an afflicted enemy.

4.name: Putrid Recovery
4.description: You gain ward when hitting an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.

5.name: Agonizing Expanse
5.description: Spirit Plague spreads when you critically strike an afflicted target.

6.name: Enfeeblement
6.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with Frailty.

7.name: Contagion
7.description: Spirit Plague is now cast in an area around the target, but costs more mana.

8.name: Plague's Purview
8.description: Spirit Plague is cast in a larger area.

9.name: Scourge
9.description: Spirit Plague deals significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer spreads.

10.name: Plague of Eyes
10.description: Spirit Plague has additional spell necrotic damage for each point of Intelligence

11.name: Toxic Transmission
11.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with poison for the same duration.

12.name: Gift of Death
12.description: Spirit Plague has a chance to summon a {Poison Wisp} when it kills an enemy, a minion which lasts for 15 seconds and poisons nearby enemies.

13.name: Efficacious Application
13.description: Spirit Plague costs less mana and lasts longer.

14.name: Discharge
14.description: Spirit Plague spreads after a duration. (This does not affect the maximum number of spreads.)

15.name: Perpetuity
15.description: Spirit Plague has increased cast speed and lasts longer.

16.name: Anguish
16.description: Enemies afflicted by Spirit Plague are also feared.

17.name: Conductor of Plagues
17.description: Spirit Plague is now a combo skill. Directly recasting Spirit Plague within 2 seconds will cause up to 3 inflicted enemies to spread Spirit Plague to other enemies around them.

18.name: Pestilence
18.description: You gain increased global damage over time when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

19.name: Plague Bearer
19.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted by {Plague} for the same duration. {Plague} is an ailment that deals poison damage over time, spreads between enemies, and does not stack.

20.name: Queen of Plagues
20.description: {Plague} inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Poison Penetration.

21.name: Endless Decay
21.description: You gain increased poison damage when you afflict an enemy with Spirit Plague. This effect lasts 4 seconds and can stack up to 13 times.

22.name: Rotten to the Core
22.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

23.name: Concentrated Rot
23.description: Spirit Plague deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but spreads in a smaller area.

24.name: Calamitous
24.description: Spirit Plague spreads to additional targets, but costs more mana.

25.name: Hemorrhage
25.description: Enemies you inflict with Spirit Plague are also inflicted with bleeding for the same duration.

26.name: Exsanguination
26.description: Bleed inflicted by Spirit Plague has additional Bleed Penetration, but you are now also inflicted with bleeding.

27.name: Defilement
27.description: You gain mana when Spirit Plague kills an enemy.

28.name: Laceration
28.description: You have a chance to apply bleed when you hit an enemy afflicted by Spirit Plague.

0.name: Shadow Cascade
0.description:
Requires dual wielding.

A circular attack that's also used by your  {Shadows}.

2.name: Shadow Torrent
2.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per active {Shadow}.

3.name: Battle Trance
3.description: You have a higher chance to dodge while directly using Shadow Cascade (multiplicative with other modifiers).

4.name: Incapacitate
4.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to apply {Frailty} to enemies hit, causing them to deal less damage.

5.name: Shadow Flourish
5.description:
If you hit at least 4 enemies with Shadow Cascade, you deal increased physical damage for a short duration.

This effect can be triggered by daggers from {Dagger Dance} as well.

6.name: Maiming
6.description: Shadow Cascade slows enemies for a short duration.

7.name: Rending
7.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.name: Toxic Whirl
8.description: Bleed chance from all sources is converted to poison when using Shadow Cascade.

9.name: Rapid Expanse
9.description: Shadow Cascade deals damage in a larger area.

10.name: Leveraged Momentum
10.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per 1% of increased melee attack speed you have.

11.name: Blade Rush
11.description: Shadow Cascade has more melee critical strike chance (multiplicative with other modifiers) against bleeding and poisoned enemies.

12.name: Precision
12.description: Improves Shadow Cascade's base critical strike chance.

13.name: Carnage
13.description: Shadow Cascade's critical strikes deal more damage.

14.name: Gloomstalker
14.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to create a {Shadow} on kill.

15.name: Fight In The Shadows
15.description: You gain mana on use with Shadow Cascade per active {Shadow}.

16.name: Onslaught
16.description: A portion of Shadow Cascade's mana cost is refunded if used when you have at least one {Shadow}

17.name: Dismantle
17.description: Shadow Cascade has a chance to shred enemy armor.

18.name: Excecution
18.description: Shadow Cascade deals more melee damage to enemies on low health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

19.name: Careful Assault
19.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) if you have a specific number of {Shadows}.

20.name: Crushing Darkness
20.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but no longer scales with attack speed.

21.name: Dagger Dance
21.description: Shadow Cascade now also throws piercing daggers at nearby targets, dealing throwing physical damage.

22.name: Daggerflow
22.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} last longer causing them to travel further.

23.name: Fray
23.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

24.name: Porcupine's Wrath
24.description: {Dagger Dance} throws more daggers which deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shadow Cascade no longer includes a melee attack.

25.name: Hurricane of Blades
25.description: Shadow Cascade is now channeled and throws daggers 3 times a second. It rapidly drains your mana. You do not regenerate mana while channelling.

26.name: Shadow Elegance
26.description: Daggers from {Dagger Dance} inflict enemies with {Shadow Dagger}. This chance is much lower when {Dagger Dance} is used by a {Shadow}.

27.name: Flow State
27.description: Shadow Cascade deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) per sword or dagger you are wielding.

28.name: Shadow Step
28.description:
When you directly use Shadow Cascade while targeting a {Shadow} you swap places with the Shadow.

This effect consumes mana based on how many times you have swapped places with a Shadow in the past 5 seconds.

2.name: Swift Sap
2.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed.

3.name: Rage Sap
3.description: You deal increased damage if you have hit an enemy with Mana Strike recently (past 4 seconds).

4.name: Rune Sap
4.description: Mana Strike hits grant you increased spell damage for 4 seconds. This effect can stack.

5.name: Teleporting Strikes
5.description: Mana Strike hits enemies at a target location, rather than in front of you, but grants significantly less mana.

6.name: Bountiful Victory
6.description: Mana Strike grants mana when it kills an enemy, or when it hits a rare or boss enemy.

7.name: Critical Mana
7.description: Mana Strike grants mana when it critically strikes an enemy.

8.name: Critical Rejuvenation
8.description: Significantly improves Mana Strike’s base critical strike chance, but Mana Strike no longer deals more critical strike damage.

9.name: Mana Drain
9.description: Mana Strike grants you more mana.

10.name: Mana Cleave
10.description: Mana Strike grants twice as much mana on hit and hits in a much larger area, but has a cooldown and less attack speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Repulsing Strikes
11.description: Mana Strike has a chance to knock enemies back on hit.

12.name: Spark Charges
12.description: Mana Strike hits have a chance to attach a {Spark Charge}.

13.name: Celestial Precision
13.description: Mana Strike gains base critical strike chance equal to a percentage of your current mana, but loses a fixed amount of base critical strike chance.

14.name: Mana Spark
14.description: Mana Strike has additional melee lightning damage equal to a percentage of your current mana.

15.name: Starved Strikes
15.description: Mana Strike deals more damage while you are out of mana.

16.name: Avatar of Hunger
16.description: Mana Strike deal more damage when you are out of mana (multiplicative with other modifiers), but also grant less mana.

17.name: Mana Storm
17.description: Mana Strike additionally strikes enemies it hits with {Mana Arc} while you are not out of mana. {Mana Arc} consumes 15 mana.

18.name: Explosive Flurry
18.description: Mana Strike has increased attack speed. {Mana Arc} created by {Mana Storm} costs less mana.

19.name: Essence of Control
19.description: {Mana Arc} created by {Mana Storm} costs less mana.

20.name: Sprite Blade
20.description: Mana Strike deals damage in a larger area.

21.name: Reclamation
21.description: Mana Strike grants more mana on hit while you are out of mana.

22.name: Arcanist's Blade
22.description: Mana Strike grants you more mana if it hits an enemy.

23.name: Ward Strike
23.description: When you attack with Mana Strike and hit at least one enemy you gain ward

24.name: Transfusion
24.description: A portion of mana gained on hit is converted to ward instead.

25.name: Mind Warden
25.description: Mana Strike hits grant more ward.

26.name: Star Guide
26.description: Mana Strike automatically targets the enemy closest to the cursor and has improved base critical strike chance.

2.name: Ricochet
2.description: Shield Throw has increased attack speed and ricochets to additional targets, but Shield Throw costs more mana.

3.name: Aegis
3.description: Shield Throw can target and ricochet to allies other than yourself. Allies are granted armor for 4 seconds when Shield Throw hits them.

4.name: Manifest Inspiration
4.description:
If your {Manifest Armor} is hit by the shield, it performs a sweeping melee attack.
This attack cannot be triggered when the shield has no ricochets remaining.

5.name: Faithguard
5.description: {Aegis} also grants allies stun avoidance when Shield Throw hits them. The amount granted is equal to the armor Aegis provides.

6.name: Testament of Light
6.description: The benefits granted by {Aegis} are increased for each point of attunement you have.

7.name: Eruption
7.description: Whenever Shield Throw ricochets on an enemy it casts {Lava Burst,} a spell dealing fire damage to all enemies near the impact.

8.name: Forceful Breaking
8.description: {Lava Burst} deals damage in a larger area.

9.name: Magma Rage
9.description: {Lava Burst} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

10.name: Forgeborn
10.description: Thrown shields travel faster, and Shield Throw deals additional throwing fire damage.

11.name: Molten Shield
11.description:
Shield Throw's base physical damage is converted to fire. Consequently this damage scales with increases to fire damage, but not increases to physical damage.

All increased stun chance from this tree is converted to added ignite chance.

12.name: Molten Toss
12.description: Shield Throw deals more fire damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

13.name: Burning Crusade
13.description: Shield Throw and {Lava Burst} hits have a chance to ignite enemies.

14.name: Polished Steel
14.description: Shield Throw costs less mana.

15.name: Focused Campaign
15.description: Shield Throw's cooldown is immediately reset when your shield returns to you, but the number of Shield Throw ricochets is halved (rounded down).

16.name: Armoring Aegis
16.description: Shield Throw grants you armor for 4 seconds when it ricochets.

17.name: Colossus
17.description: You have increased armor while Shield Throw is on cooldown.

18.name: Vampiric Shield
18.description: You gain health when Shield Throw ricochets.

19.name: Iron Monger
19.description: Shield Throw steals 10 armor on hit for 4 seconds.

20.name: Hemrin's Technique
20.description: Shield Throw ricochets to additional targets.

21.name: Heavy Shield
21.description: Shield Throw deals additional throwing damage.

22.name: Sharpened Rim
22.description: Improves Shield Throw's base critical strike chance.

23.name: Spiked Plates
23.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 50% of your block chance.

24.name: Rygar's Fury
24.description: Shield Throw deals more hit damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) equal to 100% of your block chance, but you cannot block while Shield Throw is released.

25.name: Crippling Throw
25.description: Shield Throw has a chance to slow and increased chance to stun enemies.

26.name: Throwing Arm
26.description: You are granted global increased throwing attack damage if you have used Shield Throw recently (last 4 seconds).

27.name: Fleet of Foot
27.description: When you cast Shield Throw, you are granted {Haste} for a duration.

28.name: Shield Barrage
28.description: Shield Throw no longer has a cooldown and costs less mana, but shields are smaller and deal less damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

29.name: Avenger's Wrath
29.description: Shield Throw critical hits deal more damage based on your block effectiveness.

0.name: Dense Orb
0.description: Volcanic Orb fires additional {Shrapnel} from its final explosion.

3.name: Frozen Orb
3.description: Volcanic Orb is converted into Frozen Orb. Base fire damage is converted to cold for Frozen Orb and the skill effects it creates. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not with increases to fire damage.

4.name: Winter's Fury
4.description: {Shrapnel}, {Explosive Orb} and {Fire Glyph} have a chance to chill enemies.

5.name: Glacial Might
5.description: {Shrapnels} hits deal more damage against chilled enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

6.name: Volatile Emission
6.description: {Shrapnel} travels faster, causing it to also travel further. Shrapnel is created more frequently.

7.name: Orb of Speed
7.description:
Volcanic Orb core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb has a duration of 2 seconds. 

If you have taken the {Explosive Ground} node, Volcanic Orb leaves Explosive Ground more frequently.

8.name: Pyroclastic Speed
8.description: You have increased cast Speed with Volcanic Orb, and Volcanic Orb travels faster, causing it to also travel further.

9.name: Ash Pelting
9.description: {Shrapnel} has an increased chance to stun enemies.

10.name: Eruption
10.description: {Shrapnel} deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

11.name: Piercing Embers
11.description: {Shrapnel} pierces enemies (continues through enemies it hits).

12.name: Explosive Ground
12.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} as it travels, which explode after 3 seconds, dealing fire damage to enemies within its area of effect. Volcanic Orb costs significantly more mana.

13.name: Tectonic Orb
13.description: Volcanic Orb leaves {Explosive Ground} more frequently, but costs more mana.

14.name: Controlled Eruption
14.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana, but moves slower and has a duration of 2 seconds.

15.name: Explosive Orb
15.description: Volcanic Orb creates a large explosion at the end of its duration, dealing fire damage.

16.name: Glyph of Fire
16.description: Casting Volcanic Orb creates a {Fire Glyph} at your feet which explodes after 1.3 seconds, creating a {Fire Nova}.

17.name: Fiery Runes
17.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

18.name: Mark of the Inferno
18.description: Explosions from {Explosive Orb} and {Glyph of Fire} have a chance to ignite enemies.

19.name: Molten Core
19.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Infernal Caster
20.description: Volcanic Orb's core, {Shrapnel} and {Explosive Orb} hits deal more damage, but Volcanic Orb costs more mana and has less cast speed (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Monolithic Eruption
21.description: Volcanic Orb's core and {Shrapnel} deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Shrapnel is created less frequently.

22.name: Freezing Orb
22.description: Frozen Orb has an increased chance to freeze enemies.

23.name: Volcanic Tether
23.description: Volcanic Orb moves slower for each second it exists.

24.name: Volcanic Acceleration
24.description: Volcanic Orb's core deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), and it accelerates, moving faster for each second it exists.

25.name: Volcanic Frenzy
25.description: Volcanic Orb has a shorter cooldown.

26.name: Concentrated Effect
26.description: Volcanic Orb's core hits deals more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Volcanic Orb no longer creates {Shrapnel} when it ends.

27.name: Lava Flow
27.description: Volcanic Orb costs less mana.

2.name: Soul for a Soul
2.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage but have reduced healing effectiveness.

3.name: Ghastly Flow
3.description: You move faster for 4 seconds after using {Reap} while below half health.

4.name: Sanguine Reaper
4.description: {Reap} deals damage in a larger area and you leech a portion of the damage its hits deal as health.

5.name: Ravenous Doom
5.description: While in Reaper Form you gain health from kills. This bonus is doubled for kills using {Reap}.

6.name: Reaper's Curse
6.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal increased damage and have increased critical strike chance, but lose health when you kill an enemy.

7.name: Death's Door
7.description: {Reap} deal more damage for each percent of health you are missing (multiplicative with other modifiers). You deal increased damage at low health while in Reaper Form.

8.name: Dark Harvest
8.description: {Reap} hits instantly kill enemies that are below a health threshold (a percentage of their maximum health).

9.name: Gravechill
9.description:
All of {Reap}'s base damage and its added melee damage from intelligence are converted to cold. Consequently this damage scales with increases to cold damage, but not increases to necrotic damage.

Poison chance from all sources is converted to {Chill} for Reap, and Reap gains…

10.name: Deathtouch Scythe
10.description: While in Reaper Form, you deal additional necrotic damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

11.name: Executioner
11.description: While in Reaper Form, your critical strikes deal more damage. This bonus is doubled for {Reap}.

12.name: Death Comes Quickly
12.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to gain Swiftness when you kill an enemy. Swiftness lasts 30 seconds, grants 1% increased movement speed, and can stack up to 10 times.

13.name: Sweeping Scythes
13.description: {Reap} moves you further.

14.name: Pestilence
14.description: Reap poisons enemies, but cannot critically strike. It also gains the {Poison} tag.

15.name: Venomous Coating
15.description: {Reap} has a chance to poison enemies, and poisons you inflict while in Reaper Form last longer.

16.name: Herald of Rot
16.description: Entering Reaper Form poisons all nearby enemies. While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to poison enemies that you hit.

17.name: Haunting
17.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance apply {Mark For Death} to enemies on hit. This chance is doubled for {Reap}.

18.name: Rapid Destruction
18.description: You have increased attack and cast speed while in Reaper Form.

19.name: Reaper's Ascendance
19.description: Gain a stack of {Reaper’s Ascendance} every 5 seconds you spend in Reaper Form, which grants you increased spell damage. You can have up to 25 stacks of Reaper’s Ascendance at a time.

20.name: Reaper's Supremacy
20.description: You gain stacks of Reaper’s Ascendence more frequently.

21.name: Mistress of Decay
21.description: While in Reaper Form, your health decays more slowly and you deal increased damage over time.

22.name: Soul Shroud
22.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional armor proportional to your intelligence.

23.name: Elixir of Death
23.description: While in Reaper Form, potions grant twice as much health as normal.

24.name: Vile Shroud
24.description: While in Reaper Form, you gain additional necrotic and poison resistance per point of intelligence.

25.name: Phantom Restoration
25.description: While in Reaper Form, you have more ward retention. {Reap} grants ward on hit.

26.name: Protective Spirit
26.description: {Reaper’s Blessing} also grants ward when you transform back to your human form.

27.name: From the Grave
27.description: Entering Reaper Form summons {Skeletons}, unless you are already at your maximum number of Skeletons.

28.name: Reaper's Blessing
28.description: You gain ward when entering Reaper Form.

29.name: Mercy in Undeath
29.description: Hitting minions with {Reap} heals them for the same amount that Reap would heal you if an enemy was hit.

30.name: Soul Release
30.description: You have a chance to cast {Hungering Souls} whenever you kill an enemy with {Reap}.

31.name: Harbinger of Blood
31.description: While in Reaper Form you have increased healing effectiveness and leech more of the damage you deal. You gain additional health on hit with {Reap}.

32.name: Unholy Dominion
32.description: {Reap} has a much longer cooldown, but no longer shares a cooldown with {Transplant}.

34.name: Blood Tethers
34.description: While in Reaper Form, you have a chance to retaliate with {Blood Tether} when you are hit.

2.name: Brutal Impact
2.description: Fury Leap's critical strikes deal more damage.

3.name: Regain Stamina
3.description:
You have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown whenever you kill an enemy with any other skill.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

4.name: Lagon's Wrath
4.description: Fury Leap creates {Storm Bolts} while you are leaping.

5.name: Storm Bringer
5.description: {Storm Bolts} occur with increased frequency.

6.name: Rejuvenating Storms
6.description:
You have additional spell damage per 2 Attunement while leaping, and kills with {Storm Bolt} have a chance to reset Fury Leap's cooldown.

Fury Leap's cooldown can only be reset once every 5 seconds.

7.name: Warrior's Entrance
7.description: When you land, you and your minions gain additional melee damage and spell damage for 3 seconds. This buff can stack.

8.name: Frenzied Onslaught
8.description: When you land, you and your minions gain {Frenzy} for 3 seconds, which increases attack and cast speed. Frenzy cannot stack.

9.name: Pack Leader
9.description: Your Wolf, Sabertooth, and Raptor companions leap with you.

10.name: Crushing Impact
10.description: Fury Leap has an increased chance to stun enemies and stuns it inflicts last longer.

11.name: Gravity
11.description: Fury Leap pulls enemies when you land.

12.name: Rise
12.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you leap from.

13.name: Poisonous Thicket
13.description: Fury Leap has a chance to cast {Summon Vines} where you land.

14.name: Crater
14.description: Fury Leap's deals damage in a larger area and costs less mana.

15.name: Ambush Predator
15.description: Fury Leap hits deal more damage against enemies at full health (multiplicative with other modifiers).

16.name: Savage Impact
16.description: Fury Leap deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers) and you leech a portion of the damage it deals as health.

17.name: Aspect of the Mantis

19.name: Souls of Rage
19.description: Spirits move faster and deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

20.name: Poisoned Minds
20.description: Spirits deal more damage to poisoned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

21.name: Spectral Putrescence
21.description: Spirits have a chance to cast {Spectral Putrescence} at nearby enemies each second. Spectral Putrescence is a projectile with 100% chance to poison on hit.

22.name: Spectral Scorn
22.description: Spirits cast {Spectral Putrescence} at enemies from further away.

23.name: Soul Of Filth
23.description: Spirits can cast {Spectral Putrescence} more frequently.

24.name: Locus Mortis
24.description: Spirits are now revealed around a target location, rather than around you. Spirits deal more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers).

26.name: Reap the Damned
26.description: Spirits deal more damage to cursed enemies and damned enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

28.name: Song of the Lost Chantry
28.description: Wandering Spirits is now a channelled skill, has a much shorter cooldown, and creates Spirits much more frequently. You can regenerate mana while channelling this skill.

30.name: Spirit Swarm
30.description: Wandering Spirits has a shorter cooldown

31.name: Sins of the Forgotten
31.description: Wandering Spirits inflict enemies around them with {Damned}.

2.name: Bone Knives
2.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} hits deal significantly more damage (multiplicative with other modifiers), but Marrow Shards no longer pierces.

3.name: Marrow Hunger
3.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as health if you have cast Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

4.name: Splintering Impact
4.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone behind the enemy when destroyed, damaging other enemies, but Marrow Shards no longer pierces and costs more health.

5.name: Carving
5.description: {Bone Splinters} deal more damage.

6.name: Ghost Splinters
6.description: {Bone Splinters} travel faster and further.

7.name: Gouging Splinters
7.description: {Bone Splinters} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed.

8.name: Crimson Ivory
8.description: {Bone Splinters} hits deal more damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

9.name: Dark Precision
9.description: Improves {Bone Splinters'} base critical strike chance.

10.name: Ivory Obliteration
10.description: {Bone Splinters} critical strikes deal more damage.

11.name: Dead Weight
11.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} hits deal more damage, but Marrow Shards travels less far.

12.name: Blood Assassin
12.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} have improved base critical strike chance and critical strikes deal more damage.

13.name: Marrow Death
13.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} deal more damage with critical strikes.

14.name: Femoral Offering
14.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} critical strikes deal more damage, but you lose health when you critically strike with Marrow Shards.

15.name: Twin Malevolence
15.description:
If you have exactly two minions when you cast Marrow Shards, you have increased critical strike chance for 2 seconds. 

You cannot have multiple instances of this buff at once.

16.name: Bone Splinters
16.description: Marrow Shards creates {Bone Splinters} in a cone when destroyed, which damage enemies, but Marrow Shards travels less far and costs more health.

17.name: Marrow Caster
17.description: Marrow Shards are destroyed at the location you target if it is within their maximum range. Marrow Shards costs more health.

18.name: Ossumancy
18.description: When you directly cast Marrow Shards, you have a chance to immediately cast a second instance of Marrow Shards. The additional cast does cost health.

19.name: Shredding Bones
19.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} hits have a chance to shred enemy armor.

20.name: Apathy
20.description:
Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} deal more damage, but Marrow Shards can hit and damage your own minions. 

On hit effects, such as health gained on hit, do not proc when you hit your minions.

21.name: Treachery
21.description: You gain health when you kill one of your own minions.

22.name: Dark Reverie
22.description: Grants you increased critical strike chance if you have killed with Marrow Shards or {Bone Splinters} recently (past 4 seconds).

23.name: Blood Reverie
23.description: You leech a portion of physical damage as life if you have killed with Marrow Shards recently (past 4 seconds).

24.name: Soul Blood
24.description: Marrow Shards and {Bone Splinters} have a chance to cause enemies to bleed, but Marrow Shards costs more health.

25.name: Bones Of The Follower
25.description: Marrow Shards hits deal significantly more damage, but consumes one of your minions when you cast it.

26.name: Rip Marrow
26.description: Marrow Shards has a chance to create a {Marrow Orb} on hit that returns 15 health to you.

27.name: Marrow Eater
27.description: {Marrow Orbs} return more health.

28.name: Life Blood
28.description: Marrow Shards hits have a higher chance to create a {Marrow Orb}.

29.name: Spirit Feast
29.description: {Marrow Orbs} have a chance to also replenish mana.

30.name: Demise
30.description: Marrow Shards hits deal more damage against bleeding enemies (multiplicative with other modifiers).

2.name: Long Gaze
2.description: Marks enemies within a larger area.

3.name: Flow of Anger
3.description: Mark for Death costs less mana.

4.name: Lingering Curse
4.description: Enemies are Marked for a longer duration.

5.name: Icy Manipulation
5.description: Enemies in the affected area are also chilled.

6.name: Terror
6.description: Enemies in the affected area are also inflicted with {Fear}.

7.name: Imposing Will
7.description: Chill and fear caused by Mark for Death have increased duration.

8.name: Elemental Weakness
8.description: Marked enemies have less elemental protection.

9.name: Metal Rot
9.description: Marked enemies have less armor.

10.name: Waivering Resolve
10.description: Marked enemies have less necrotic protection.

11.name: Weak Constitution
11.description: Marked enemies have less poison protection.

12.name: Desecration
12.description: Marked enemies take increased damage, but Mark for Death costs more mana.

13.name: Bone Prison
13.description:
A {Bone Prison} is created around the affected area of your curse, which blocks enemies. Bone Prison lasts for a fixed duration or until broken by enemy damage.

Adds a 20 second cooldown.

14.name: Gaze of Granite
14.description: Marked enemies are more likely to be stunned when hit.

15.name: Calcium Infusion
15.description: {Bone Prison} has more armor.

16.name: Enchanted Prison
16.description: {Bone Prison} has additional vitality.

2.name: Master of the Elements
2.description: While Fire Shield is active you have additional elemental resistance.
